gist: Channel disclaimer: no promotion of drugs or alcohol, content is for information and education, community guidelines followed.
Greeting and thanks to viewers for joining the class.
Says that in the class two weeks ago on donation and charity, the case of sign 5 falling in the 9th house was left out, so he will cover it briefly now.
Schedule note: next week a Saturn class, the week after that a break from astrology for a class on how to wish/manifest.

Explains why the manifestation class is coming: people ask repeatedly how to manifest, it is popular worldwide, The Secret book is famous, and it will be taught through cosmic vibration and how planets work.

hindi: पांच नंबर जब नौवें घर में हो जाता है तो यह सूर्य का घर है पांच नंबर राशि जो है यह सूर्य की राशि है नाइंथ हाउस है
says: Sets the case for the donation lesson: when sign number 5 (Leo, the Sun's sign) lands in the 9th house (dharma, luck, temples, guru), the donation scheme is read from the Sun's point of view.
cells_derived_method: Leo in the 9th means Sagittarius rising. The same Sun-sign-in-a-house idea carries to other houses: the donation is judged by what the house stands for (career in 10th, children in 5th, self in 1st) with the Sun as the receiver of gifts.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Sun's sign on the 10th, the giving falls in the karma house, so donations are about work and status, not luck or temple practice.
Derived: Sun's sign in the 5th, donation questions turn to children, mantra and creative intelligence rather than fortune.
Derived: Sun's sign on the ascendant, body and self carry the Sun's light, so the giver is also the receiver.

ambiguity: He says number 5 and then names it Leo/Sun, so it is sign number 5 (Leo). The 9th is a house number.
classical_check: Leo as the 9th sign-house is standard for a Sagittarius ascendant; the donation logic that follows is his own scheme, classical texts are silent.

hindi: नाइंथ हाउस है यह सूर्य के लिए हम आटा दे सकते हैं यहां पर दान
says: For the Sun's sign in the 9th, flour (atta) is the suitable gift to represent the Sun in a donation made at a temple or religious place.
cells_derived_method: The gift is chosen per planet, so the planet-to-item table stays the same in any cell. What changes is which house the giving goes to: in the 9th it is a temple or guru, in the 10th it would be an institution or workplace charity.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: flour given in a work or institution setting rather than a temple, as the Sun's gift to the 10th.
Derived: flour given for the home and mother, as the 4th house is where the Sun's gift lands.

ambiguity: Garbled caption says 'आटा' with 'दान' after; it is a flour gift for the Sun.
classical_check: Wheat and wheat products for the Sun is a classical daan item; the sign-in-house filtering is his own.

hindi: बृहस्पति इसका मित्र है सोना दे सकते हैं
says: Jupiter is a friend of the Sun, so gold can be given in the donation for Leo in the 9th house.
cells_derived_method: Friendship of the gift-planet with the sign lord decides if the gift is allowed. Jupiter is friendly to the Sun, so gold works whenever the Sun's sign is the receiving sign, whatever the house.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: gold given with Sun's sign in the 5th suits gifts for a child's education or mantra initiation.
Derived: gold given with Sun's sign in the 12th is a loss house offering, allowed but it is spending.

classical_check: Sun-Jupiter friendship matches Parashari natural friendship; gold for Jupiter is classical.

hindi: शनि नेगेटिव हो जाएगा शनि की पूजा पाठ दान ऐसा व्यक्ति यदि करेगा जीवन में तो भाग्य की हानि होगी सत्यानाश
says: Saturn is the enemy of the Sun, so Saturn worship or Saturn donation by a person with Leo in the 9th harms luck badly; he calls it ruin of fortune.
cells_derived_method: Sun-enemy planets (Saturn, Rahu, Venus) get blocked as gifts wherever the Sun's sign sits, and the damage lands on the house the sign occupies. In the 9th it is fortune; elsewhere it is that house's matter.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Saturn offerings with Leo in the 10th would damage career standing.
Derived: Saturn offerings with Leo in the 4th would trouble home peace and mother.
Derived: Saturn offerings with Leo in the 7th would strain partnerships.

ambiguity: Saturn rules the 9th-house karma for some lagnas; he judges only by sign (Leo), not by house lordship.
classical_check: Saturn and Sun are natural enemies in Parashara, but classical texts do not forbid Saturn worship for a Leo 9th; this is his rule, and Saturn puja is normally advised.

hindi: प्लूटो यमराज बार-बार मौत की बातें करेगा बार-बार मौत के बारे में सोचेगा और सोचे मरना मारना धर्म है तो मरेगा ही वो किस्मत का सत्यानाश अपने आप ही होगा
says: Pluto (Yamraj) acts as the death-thought planet: a person who keeps speaking and thinking about death while the Sun's sign is in the 9th will wreck their own luck by that thinking.
cells_derived_method: The Pluto-versus-Sun clash applies in any house where the Sun's sign sits: the death-thinking drains that house's matter. In 9th it is luck; in 4th it would be peace of mind and home.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: obsessive thoughts of death or ending would erode home comfort and emotional stability.
Derived: talk of destruction and killing at work would erode reputation and career.

ambiguity: Whether he means literal wishing death on others or morbid thinking generally; he says both (mar jaa and thinking of death).
classical_check: Pluto is not used in classical Jyotish (Yama as a planet is his scheme); silent.

hindi: इसलिए अक्सर जो लोग मानसिक तौर पर मृत्यु की बात करते हैं यानी कि मर जाए स्यापा खत्म हो तू मर जा यह मर जा वह अपने जीवन के अंदर भाग्य की हानि कर लेते हैं किस्मत फूटने लगती है
says: People who mentally wish death on others or on themselves (let the trouble end, die you) damage their own fortune; the luck starts breaking.
ambiguity: Said as general advice, but it follows the Leo-in-9th discussion, so it may apply to that placement mainly.
classical_check: Classical texts are silent; it echoes the karma principle that ill wishes return.

hindi: सूर्य क्या है प्रकाश यानी जीवन एक हमारी स्पिरिट बॉडी एक डेविल बॉडी है डेविल बॉडी मारने के लिए होती है स्पिरिट बॉडी ऊंचा उठाने के लिए
says: Sun means light and life; in the Leo-in-9th placement there are two inner modes, a spirit body that lifts a person upward and a devil body that works to kill or pull down.
ambiguity: 'Spirit body' versus 'devil body' is his own term; not a classical doctrine.
classical_check: Sun as atma karaka (soul) is classical; the spirit/devil body split is his own and not in texts.

hindi: यह हमारी स्पिरिट बॉडी का मींस चिंता नहीं डेविल बॉडी का मतलब चिंता ओनली हाय क्या होगा कैसे करेंगे आपकी भाग्य की हानि होनी शुरू हो जाएगी
says: Spirit body means no worry; devil body means only worry (what will happen, how will I manage). Living in the worrying body starts the loss of fortune.
ambiguity: Caption is broken at the 3:00 boundary; the meaning is clear, worry versus no worry.
classical_check: Silent; this is a psychological reading, not a classical rule.

hindi: मंदिर में जाकर यदि आप यह कहने लग गए करेगा परमात्मा सब सही है वाहेगुरु भगवान फलाना जो भी आपको पसंद आता है अपनी मर्जी का देवता आपके सूर्य की जागृत होने से ऑटोमेटिक पॉजिटिविटी होगी
says: Going to the temple and affirming that God (Waheguru, any deity of one's choice) has everything right awakens the Sun and brings automatic positivity for the Leo-in-9th person.
cells_derived_method: The positive stance works wherever the Sun's sign is the receiver. In the 9th it is expressed at a temple; in the 10th the same trust attitude would show at the workplace.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: calm trust in a higher power at work awakens the Sun's career side and leads to steadier standing.
Derived: for Leo rising, the same affirmation lifts general vitality.

classical_check: Silent; Sun strengthened by devotion is generally accepted, but this specific rule is his.

hindi: अगर आप वहां जाकर भीख मांग रहे हैं यह मंदिर का स्थान है धर्म स्थान है वहां जाकर भीख मांग रहे हैं बर्बाद हो गए जी तबाह हो गए जी हे भगवान बचा लो तो बर्बाद और तबाह यह भी सुन रहा है
says: If at the temple a person only begs, crying that they are ruined and destroyed, then that ruin and destruction is what gets heard and amplified; so he warns against begging in a temple with the Leo-in-9th placement.
cells_derived_method: The spoken words become the vibration in the house that holds the Sun's sign. In other houses the same complaint-prayer would feed the matter of that house.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: ruin talk at work or in business prayers feeds the career problem.
Derived: complaining about partner in prayer feeds the relationship problem.

classical_check: Silent; this is a manifestation-style principle, not a classical rule.

hindi: वो यह दोनों चीजें वहां गुंजायमान होंगी इसलिए आपको बहुत ध्यान देना है कि ऐसी राशि मंदिर में यदि बड़ी है आपके नाइंथ हाउस में पड़ी है तो धर्म स्थान में अपने घर के मंदिर में जाकर यह वाइब्रेशंस आपके अंदर नहीं होनी चाहिए
says: The negative and positive words both echo in the place of worship, so a person with this sign in the 9th must keep ruin-and-begging vibrations out of any temple, including the home temple.
ambiguity: 'Badi hai' may be a garble of 'padi hai' (sits in the 9th); the sense is Leo placed in the 9th.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: चंद्रमा जल का यहां हिसाब किताब देंगे चंद्रमा जल का जल का पानी होता है चंद्रमा तो आप ध्यान देंगे य छह नंबर राशि हो गई य सात यहां आठ चंद्रमा यहां नीच का होता है यह हाथ से गया हुआ दान है
says: Moon's gift is water. Counting the signs from the Sun's sign in the 9th (6, 7, then 8 = Scorpio), the Moon is debilitated in sign 8, which here is the 12th house, the house of things going out of the hand; so the Moon's gift is a gone-from-the-hand donation.
cells_derived_method: With Leo in the 9th, the 12th house holds Scorpio, the Moon's debilitation sign. For other cells the Moon's gift must be judged by where Scorpio falls: in 8th for Taurus rising it would be longevity matters, in 4th for Aquarius rising it would be the home.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: water gifts when Scorpio sits in the 8th are a weak-Moon gift tied to sudden loss and secrecy topics.
Derived: water gifts when Scorpio sits in the 4th are a weak-Moon gift touching mother, home and peace of mind.

ambiguity: He counts 'six, seven, eight' as sign numbers, 6=Virgo, 7=Libra, 8=Scorpio, which are also houses 10, 11, 12 when Leo is the 9th; both readings agree on Scorpio and the 12th.
classical_check: Moon debilitated in Scorpio and the 12th as loss house are classical; the donation use is his.

hindi: और चंद्रमा यहां धर्म स्थान में आप प्याऊ लगवा देते हैं तो आपकी जिंदगी नर्क है आप तबाह हो जाएंगे कि हम तो जी पानी का दान करने में लगे हुए हैं आपका जीवन तबा है
says: A person with Leo in the 9th who sets up a water-giving stall (pyau) at a place of worship, Moon's gift, makes their life hell; he says that serving water this way leads to ruin.
cells_derived_method: The Moon's water gift is blocked wherever the Moon would be debilitated in the receiving house. In other layouts check where Scorpio falls and whether the Sun's sign shares the same house.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: water charity may bring sudden unexpected losses if Scorpio is on the 8th and the Moon is the gift planet.
Derived: water charity may feed disputes and debts if Scorpio is on the 6th.

ambiguity: Strongly worded; a classical reading would treat water donation as generally auspicious, so this is a placement-specific warning.
classical_check: Classical texts praise water donation (jaladaan); this is a specific reversal in his scheme.

hindi: मंगल मीठा मंगल आप दे सकते हैं बड़े आराम से कोई दिक्कत नहीं है सर वहा प चंद्रमा नीच का तो नीच वाले घर में हो गया हां एक्शन यहां होगा जो भी आप दे रहे हैं एक्टिविटी यहां से होगी
says: Mars's gift, sweets, can be given freely without any problem. He adds that the Moon is in its debilitated house here, so the real action of giving happens from that 12th house.
cells_derived_method: Mars is a friend of the Sun, so its gift is allowed in any cell where the Sun's sign is the receiver. The action (giving) is tied to the 12th from the Sun's sign house, since expenditure sits there.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: sweets given for a child's cause with Leo on the 5th are fine under Mars's friendship with the Sun.
Derived: sweets given at work or an institution with Leo on the 10th are fine.

ambiguity: The caption in the middle is broken (the 'dete aa rahe hain' lines); the claim that the Moon is in the debilitated house is clear.
classical_check: Mars-Sun friendship is classical; sweets for Mars is a common daan item.

hindi: अगर चंद्रमा एक्शन य है देना यह देना है जो गया हाथ से सब यहां है मोक्ष भी यही है मुक्ति भी यही है बेड कंफर्ट यही है नींद यही है खर्चे यहां है बहुत कुछ है ये कंबाइंड होता है
says: The 12th house combines many things: giving, what leaves the hand, moksha, liberation, bed comfort, sleep and expenses; all are combined in that one house.
cells_derived_method: The 12th's topics (loss, moksha, sleep, bed pleasure, expenses) flavour every sign that falls there. Fire signs make the loss active, water signs make it emotional or spiritual.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: expenditure in the 12th through Scorpio is hidden, intense and emotional.
Derived: 12th in Sagittarius links loss with travel, foreign lands and spiritual teachers.
Derived: 12th in Cancer links sleep and bed comfort to the mother and home mood.

classical_check: Agrees with classical 12th house significations (vyaya, moksha, shayya sukha, sleep).

hindi: मंगल देते हैं मीठा बहुत सुंदर है लाल मीठा देंगे ज्यादा अच्छा काला मीठा नहीं लाल गुलाब जामुन दान किए जाते हैं काले गुलाब जामुन नहीं दान किए जाते वो हाईली नेगेटिव होते हैं
says: For Mars give red sweets; red gulab jamun are right for donation and black ones are not, because black is highly negative for this Sun-sign case.
ambiguity: Black gulab jamun is a colour reading, not a different sweet.
classical_check: Red items for Mars are classical; the red versus black gulab jamun point is his own.

hindi: बुध बुध के लिए हरी चीजें दे सकते हैं रुपया दे सकते हैं सूर्य के साथ मित्रता है कोई परेशानी नहीं है
says: Mercury's gifts, green things and money, are allowed for the Sun's sign in the 9th, because Mercury is friendly with the Sun.
ambiguity: Mercury is a neutral to friendly planet to the Sun in Parashara tables; he calls it a friend.
classical_check: Parashara treats Mercury as a friend of the Sun; green items for Mercury are classical.

hindi: 101 पर मजे में बृहस्पति का सोना दे सकते हैं पीला बेसन दे सकते हैं सूर्य नमक होता है यहां नमकीन बेसन भी दे सकते हैं मीठा बेसन भी दे सकते हैं बूंदी के लड्डू दे सकते हैं
says: Jupiter's gifts, gold and yellow gram flour, are fully allowed; the Sun is salt, so salty or sweet besan items and boondi laddu are all fine.
ambiguity: '101 पर' is a caption slip meaning a full yes ('hundred percent'), not a number.
classical_check: Gram flour and yellow food for Jupiter is classical; Sun as salt is his own taste assignment.

hindi: शुक्र घी इत्यादि होता है दही होता है यह नहीं देना है ये बिल्कुल नष्ट कर देगा शुक्र आपके जीवन का वैभव और रोमांस है
says: Do not give Venus's items (ghee, curd) in this case, they would destroy; Venus is the luxury and romance of life.
ambiguity: Ghee and curd in a Venus list is his assignment; classical Venus items are usually white things, rice, sugar, silk.
classical_check: Differs from classical practice where ghee and curd are usually auspicious gifts.

hindi: नए कपड़े नई चीजें जितने भी घर में नई नवेली चीजें पड़ी हुई है यदि आप इस प्रकार का दान करेंगे मंदिर गुरुद्वारे इत्यादि धर्म स्थान में ऑटोमेटिक घर में पड़े पड़े पर्स टूट जाएंगे कपड़े कट जाएंगे परेशानी होगी
says: If new clothes and new things (Venus items) are donated to a temple or gurdwara, the household items at home will start to break: purses will tear and clothes get cut.
ambiguity: The donated item and the damage are different things, he links them as cause and effect through Venus.
classical_check: Classical texts are silent; the clothes cut effect is his claim.

hindi: लोग कहते हैं कपड़े कट रहे जी हमारे घर में किसी ने कुछ किया कराया है अ ये एनर्जी है नेगेटिव काम करती हैं और हमें समझ नहीं आता हम ये बहाना समझ लेते हैं किसी ने कुछ किया कराया किय कराए का सारा ड्रामा केतु के पास होता है
says: People think cut clothes mean someone did black magic on the house, but he says it is negative energy from our own act, and that the whole drama of black magic belongs to Ketu.
classical_check: Ketu with occult and tantra is classical; denying black magic here is his argument.

hindi: शुक्र हो गया शनि नेगेटिव बिल्कुल कोई सिक्का तेल नहीं दे सकते राहु हो गया हाईली नेगेटिव अगर आप यहां चाय की पति देते हैं किसी और किस्म की चीज करते हैं
says: After Venus, he repeats Saturn is fully negative so no coin or oil may be given, and Rahu is highly negative so tea leaves or any Rahu item should not be given at the temple.
ambiguity: 'चाय की पति' is tea leaves (chai patti).
classical_check: Oil and iron are classical Saturn gifts, forbidding them here is a placement-specific claim of his.

hindi: अगर ऐसा व्यक्ति मानसिक तौर पर ऐसा हो कि जो राहु की चीज को लेकर के यहां सोच के बैठा है कि भैया मैं तो अपने जीवन के अंदर दारू भी पिऊंगा तो मंदिर में पिऊंगा तो उसका जीवन टोटली नर्क है
says: If a person with this placement has the Rahu mindset of 'I will drink liquor, even in the temple', their life becomes total hell, because liquor is a Rahu thing.
ambiguity: He is giving an extreme example of Rahu items offered at a religious place, not a literal prescription to drink.
classical_check: Rahu with intoxicants is classical; the temple-drinking penalty for the Sun is his.

hindi: क्योंकि वह इतना भयंकर रूप से अपने सूर्य को नष्ट कर देगा कि तबाह तो बहुत से ऐसे लोग लोग जो मंदिरों के बाहर जाकर के भी दारू पीते रहते हैं बर्बाद कर देते हैं खुद को उनका जीवन नर्क ही पड़ा रहता है चाहे कुछ भी हो
says: Such behaviour destroys one's own Sun so severely that people who keep drinking outside temples ruin themselves and their life stays hell, whatever else they do.
ambiguity: A moral statement about drinkers rather than a chart rule.
classical_check: Silent; Rahu-Sun conflict is classical (eclipse) but this reading is his.

hindi: केतु हो गया किसी किस्म का कंबल इत्यादि केतु कंबल होता है यह चीजें दान करते हैं
says: Continuing the Leo-in-9th donation list, Ketu's gift is a blanket of any kind; he names blanket as the Ketu item among the things people donate.
cells_derived_method: The Ketu gift rule needs the Sun-Ketu relation; Ketu is an enemy-type shadow planet for the Sun, so the gift is blocked in every Sun-sign cell. Other houses change only what is damaged (9th luck, 10th career, 4th home).

derived_examples.reading: Derived: blankets given as gifts with Leo on the 10th would hurt work standing rather than luck.
Derived: blankets given with Leo on the 4th would trouble home comfort.

ambiguity: The caption begins mid-sentence ('जाए केतु हो गया'); the verdict (allowed or not) for blanket is given only in the next sentence, which says all these are forbidden.
classical_check: Blanket is a classical Ketu daan item; forbidding it for Leo in the 9th is his own rule.

hindi: धूप बत्ती दिया इत्यादि जो भी चीजें यह सारा कसारा यहां पर देना वर्जित है
says: Giving incense sticks, wicks, lamps and similar items at a temple is forbidden for a person with this sign in the 9th.
ambiguity: Unclear whether the ban covers only giving these as gifts or also using them; he clarifies right after that lighting a diya is allowed.
classical_check: Incense and lamps are usual worship items in classical practice; this ban is placement-specific and his own.

hindi: इसलिए आपको देखना है कि आप मंदिर जाते हैं तो आप दिया बत्ती जला सकते हैं मंगल का काम होता है अग्नि सरसों के तेल का
says: At the temple one may still light a lamp (diya) with mustard oil, since fire is Mars's work and Mars is friendly to the Sun, so lighting is allowed while giving the items is not.
ambiguity: Mustard oil is generally a Saturn item, which he earlier banned as a gift for this case; lighting is allowed while giving oil is not.
classical_check: Mustard-oil lamps are generally Saturn remedies in tradition; assigning the lamp to Mars is his own reading.

hindi: वहां बैठ कर के धूप अगरबत्ती ना करें तो सर वो धुआ यहां पर
says: Do not sit in the temple burning incense and agarbatti; the smoke is the problem for Leo in the 9th.
ambiguity: Caption breaks at 'तो सर वो धुआ यहां पर'; the reason (smoke) is partly garbled but the instruction is not to do incense.

ambiguity: 'ड फ' is garbled compass (likely west); the Asura is placed next to Varuna.
classical_check: Varuna in the west and Asura beside him is classical.

hindi: एसपी रन एंड मेड बैचलर स्वीट बैचलर सुंदर बना दिया उसको स्प्रेस प्रूफ मार के सेट कर दिया बंदे को यह शोष है अ कोप भवन केकई के कोप भवन का इलाका है
says: Fourth memory sentence: 'SP Ran and Made Bachelor Sweet' covers the last group, starting with Shosha, whose area is Kaikeyi's kop bhavan (anger room).
ambiguity: 'स्प्रेस प्रूफ' is garbled. Shosha is his 'S' of the SP.
classical_check: Agrees that Shosha is a devata on the west/north-west edge; the anger-room link is his image.

gist: He asks who this deity is and comments that knowledge is spreading; says the next one is Papayakshma, but the caption is cut.

hindi: ये अगला रोग और नाग य नाग है नाग कामदेव की पत्नी रति कही जाती है यह एन एन डब्लू का एरिया बन जाता है
says: Next come Roga (disease) and Naga, whom he identifies with Rati, the wife of Kamdev; this is the north-north-west area.
ambiguity: 'नाग' as Rati is his own claim; classically Naga is a serpent deity. Compass 'एन एन डब्लू' read as north-north-west.
classical_check: Differs from classical texts where Naga is a serpent devata and Rati is not equated with Naga.

hindi: मुखिया भल्ला सोम भुजग यह आपके देवता है ठीक है जी वेरी गुड ये हमारे को छोटे तौर पर याद करने के लिए आपने कोप भवन
says: The last of the ring are Mukhya, Bhallata, Soma and Bhujaga; with the mnemonic one remembers these in short, and he ties them back to the kop bhavan picture.
classical_check: Agrees with the north side devatas Mukhya, Bhallata, Soma, Bhujaga.

hindi: कोप भवन का इलाका है किसी का बेडरूम हो तो बेडरूम है तो बहुत फ्रस्ट्रेशन रहेगी बहुत तनाव रहेगा मानसिक रूप से डिप्रेशन के पेशेंट हो जाएंगे थायराइड इत्यादि यहीं पर होता है
says: If a bedroom falls in the kop bhavan area (the north-west edge), residents will have much frustration and tension; he says depression and thyroid trouble arise there; this is a traditional claim, not a diagnosis.
ambiguity: Compass of the area is 'w67', garbled; he seems to mean the Shosha-Papayakshma zone. Health items are flagged as his claim only.
classical_check: Classical Vastu warns against bedrooms in the north-west for some persons; the specific mental and thyroid claims are silent.

hindi: सारा लोगों को परेशानी बनती है कहीं ना कहीं य डिस्टर्ब होता तो घर में समस्या बनती है गर्ल्स के लिए बहुत बड़ी समस्या है
says: Trouble for people arises from a disturbance in this zone, and he says girls in the house suffer more.
ambiguity: Which zone is disturbed is not named in this sentence beyond the kop bhavan area.
classical_check: Silent; north-west is linked with women in some Vastu texts.

gist: Recites the four memory sentences again (DSP social service, Bachelor of Arts and Philosophy yielded gas, Bachelor made police angry, SP ran and made bachelor sweet).

hindi: यह भी अध्याय बड़ा सुंदर हमारा यह बड़ा जरूरी था बहुत टाइम से कि कैसे करेंगे मोटे तौर पर फिर समझेंगे इसको हर देवता के बारे में जानेंगे तो बड़ा सुंदर खुद ही हम एनालाइज कर सकते हैं
says: Knowing each deity roughly, and later in depth, lets one analyse a home by oneself; he stresses this chapter was overdue.
classical_check: Silent.

gist: Moves on to the next topic, students and studies; says the topic he needs keeps shifting and now children's studies are being discussed.
Remark that educating children is the big issue of today's life.
Joke about marriage, waiting for the baby, proving fertility, and parents dreaming of their lives through children.
Joke about school as a jail sentence of fifteen years, the child asking why he is being beaten into maths, and parents saying study to become something.
Parents spend on tuition and the best education yet the child does not study; their worry becomes odd.
Parents' wish that the child at least graduates so the passport does not need ECNR and he does not end up in labour work.

hindi: अब बच्चे की पढ़ाई के मुद्दे के लिए उसकी कुंडली के अंदर एक घर यह और दूसरा घर यह यह रिस्पांसिबल घर है इन दो घरों से उसकी पढ़ाई का हिसाब
says: For the child's study, two houses in the birth chart are responsible, and study is judged from these two; he points at them on the board and does not name the house numbers in the caption.
cells_derived_method: The two study houses will be named later; typically these are the 4th and 5th (education and intelligence) in classical texts, so the sign on each house colours how studies go, for example an airy sign on the 5th for a quick mind.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Gemini on the 5th suggests quick, curious learning, if the 5th is one of his two houses.
Derived: Pisces on the 4th suggests imaginative but unfocused schooling, if the 4th is one of the two.

ambiguity: House numbers are not in the text; pointing gestures only, so cells_stated stays open.
classical_check: Classically the 4th and 5th are the education houses, with the 2nd for early learning; consistent but not stated here.

hindi: अब उसके साथ उसका व्यक्तित्व है उसका भाग्य है यह सारा का सारा साथ-साथ काम करता है अकेले दो घरों की बात नहीं लेकिन यह दो घर मुख्य हैं जो उसकी पढ़ाई के बारे में उसको जीवन में आगे उठाते बढ़ाते
says: Along with the two study houses, the child's personality and luck also work together, so it is not only two houses, but those two are the main ones that lift the child ahead in life through education.
cells_derived_method: Personality is the 1st house and luck the 9th; the sign on each changes how strong the support is, for example a fire sign on the 1st gives drive and an earth sign on the 9th gives steady luck.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Aries on the 1st gives a competitive student personality that supports study.
Derived: Capricorn on the 9th gives slow, earned luck for higher studies.

ambiguity: He says personality and fortune but does not state the house numbers; the 1st and 9th are assumed from the usual meaning, so confidence is lower.
classical_check: Agrees with classical practice of reading education from the 4th/5th with support from the 1st and 9th.

hindi: ग्रहों के अनुसार यदि हम सादे तौर पर बात करें तो अगर बच्चा अपनी कुंडली के अंदर बुध और बृहस्पति का दोष लेकर आया है या तो यह अस्त है या वक्री है
says: Taking the planets in a simple way, if a child's chart carries a fault of Mercury and Jupiter, meaning either combust (asta) or retrograde (vakri), then studies are affected.
cells_derived_method: The fault is a state of the planet, not a house or sign, so it travels to every cell; its strength depends on which house the planet sits in (the 4th and 5th matter most for study) and which sign, since a friendly sign softens the flaw.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: combust or retrograde Mercury in its own sign Gemini on the 5th has some sign support, but the quick mind may still slip in exams.
Derived: retrograde Jupiter in own sign Sagittarius on the 4th keeps school learning but concentration drops.
Derived: combust Mercury in Virgo on the 12th gives study troubles tied to loss, distance or boarding school.

ambiguity: He starts the section with 'planets according to' with no sign or house given.
classical_check: Combust and retrograde as weakening states of Mercury and Jupiter are classical; the specific study outcomes are his.

hindi: अस्त का मतलब समझ लीजिए सूर्य के साथ पड़ा है ग्रह और बेचारे की जान ही निकल गई है बहुत अच्छी ताकत का ग्रह है बहुत सुंदर यानी कि उच्च का बैठा मान लो कोई ग्रह
says: Combustion means a planet sitting with the Sun; the poor planet loses its life even if it was strong, even if it sat in its exaltation.
ambiguity: He says an exalted planet also loses strength when combust; classical texts agree that combustion damages even an exalted planet.
classical_check: Agrees with the classical idea of asta (combust planets losing strength), with an orb as stated next.

hindi: लेकिन सूर्य की 10 डिग्री के घेरे के अंदर-अंदर आ गया है सूरज 4 डिग्री का है दूसरा ग्रह 7 डिग्री का है तो वो अस्त है उसकी जान निकल गई है कर ही नहीं पाएगा काम अच्छा फल दे ही नहीं पाएगा तो सूर्य ने उसको खा लिया
says: A planet within 10 degrees of the Sun is combust: for example, Sun at 4 degrees and another planet at 7 degrees in the same sign means the Sun has eaten it and it cannot give good results.
cells_derived_method: A fixed 10 degree orb is used for every planet. The planet and Sun share a house and sign, so the damage falls on that house's matter; for example a combust planet on the 4th hits home and schooling, on the 10th it hits career.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: a combust planet within 10 degrees of the Sun on the 10th in Aries has a strong Sun, so the planet is badly overpowered at work.
Derived: a combust planet with a debilitated Sun in Libra on the 4th is overpowered by a weak Sun.

ambiguity: The 3 degree difference in his example is well inside 10; whether the sign is shared is assumed.
classical_check: Differs from classical orbs, which are planet-specific (about 17 Mars, 14 Mercury, 11 Jupiter, 10 Venus, 15 Saturn, 12 Moon); a single 10 degree rule is his simplification.

hindi: अब सूर्य किस राशि का है यदि सूर्य खराब है और अच्छा ग्रह उसके साथ अस्त हो गया तो उसकी जान निकल गई कर ही नहीं सकता
says: The condition of the Sun's sign matters: if the Sun is itself in a bad state and a good planet is combust with it, the planet is fully drained and can do nothing.
cells_derived_method: With the Sun weak (Libra debilitation), the combust planet is hit harder; with the Sun in Aries or Leo it is a strong Sun, which burns it but may still give some power.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: debilitated Sun in Libra on the 5th with a combust Mercury, the study houses are doubly weak.
Derived: Sun in own sign Leo on the 9th with a combust Jupiter, the Sun's strength burns it hard but gives it a source of luck.

ambiguity: 'Sun kharab' may mean debilitated, afflicted, or in an enemy sign; he does not say which.
classical_check: Classical texts weigh the combust planet's strength with the Sun's dignity only loosely; this is a reading of his own.

hindi: इसलिए ऐसे बच्चे लगते हैं बड़े मेधावी हैं यार बड़ा कमाल करेंगे 10 से 16 साल की एज तक बच्चा लगता है लाजवाब परफॉर्मेंस करेगा लेकिन लाजवाब परफॉर्मेंस की ऐसी तैसी जाती है और उसकी पढ़ाई में मार्क्स गिरने शुरू हो जाते हैं
says: Children with a combust Mercury or Jupiter look brilliant and promising between ages 10 and 16, but then the performance collapses and marks start to fall in study.
ambiguity: The age window 10 to 16 is his claim; no dasha is named, so the mechanism is not stated.
classical_check: Silent on the exact age window.

gist: Remark that today's measure of study is marks, and these children cannot get good marks (the sentence continues at 23:02).

hindi: बृहस्पति यदि वक्री है तो एक गारंटी है कि 15 और 16 साल की एज के ऑनवर्ड यह बच्चा कंसंट्रेशन लैप्स करेगा ही करेगा कंसंट्रेशन डाउन जाएगी ही जाएगी
says: If Jupiter is retrograde, he guarantees the child's concentration will lapse from ages 15 or 16 onward.
cells_derived_method: Jupiter's own sign (Sagittarius, Pisces) or exaltation (Cancer) softens the effect, while Capricorn debilitation worsens it.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: retrograde Jupiter in own sign on the 5th keeps wisdom, but focus drops after 15.
Derived: retrograde debilitated Jupiter in Capricorn on the 4th, the concentration loss is sharper and begins early.

ambiguity: 'Guarantee' is overstated by his own words; sign and house conditions are not weighed.
classical_check: Classical texts treat retrograde Jupiter as strong in some views (cheshta bala), so the claim differs.

hindi: बुद्ध यदि वक्री है या अस्त है तो मैथ्स में आंख मूंद के देख लो बच्चा सिली मिस्टेक्स करेगा
says: If Mercury is retrograde or combust, the child will make silly mistakes in maths, you can bet on it.
cells_derived_method: Mercury in Virgo or Gemini softens the flaw (own signs), while Pisces debilitation makes it worse.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: retrograde Mercury in own sign on the 5th, quick mind but careless slips in sums.
Derived: debilitated and retrograde Mercury in Pisces on the 4th, confused calculations and foggy school work.

classical_check: Mercury as the maths karaka is classical; the silly-mistake claim for retrograde is his.

hindi: दोष कहते हैं तो दोष में वो नेगेटिव राशि में है ये भी माना जाएगा अभी तो राशियों प हम जाएंगे बहुत डेप्थ हो जाएगी
says: A fault also includes a planet sitting in a negative sign, which he will count later; for now the signs are put aside because it would become too deep.
ambiguity: 'Negative sign' is not defined here.
classical_check: Planet in an enemy or debilitated sign as a dosha is classical.

hindi: अच्छा तो जब हम दोष कहते हैं इन दोनों में दोष तो अभी सिर्फ ये दो ही लेके चले हां एक-एक करके दोष बढ़ाते जाते हैं अभी हम ये लेते हैं अगर आपके बच्चे की कुंडली के अंदर बृहस्पति और बुध वक्री है या अस्त है तो बच्चा पढ़ाई में डिक्लाइन होएगा ही होएगा आप कुछ भी कर लो
says: Starting with just two faults, retrograde or combust in Jupiter and Mercury, he builds the case up one fault at a time; if both are retrograde or combust the child's study will decline whatever the parents do.
ambiguity: Whether both planets must be faulty or either one is not clear; he says 'Jupiter and Mercury retrograde or combust'.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: उसे पीटो मत आप बच्चा खो दोगे बड़े होकर बच्चा नहीं तो आपको नफरत करेगा प्यार नहीं करेगा
says: Do not beat such a child; you will lose the child, who will grow up and dislike you instead of loving you.
ambiguity: Parenting advice, tied to the astrological reading.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: नीच का नीच का होने से कोई लेना देना नहीं है वक्री और अस्त की बात हो रही है नीच वाला अगर नीच पड़ा तो फेल कराएगा भी आएंगे उसपे
says: The retrograde and combust faults are separate from debilitation; he says a debilitated planet can make the child fail, and he will come back to that.
ambiguity: Whether debilitation worsens the study effect or is a separate matter is left for later.
classical_check: Debilitation as a separate weakness is classical.

hindi: यह बुध और बृहस्पति इनके वकृत्व यह मैथमेटिक्स को रूल करता है इसके पास केमिस्ट्री है इसके पास फिजिक्स है यह आपके फिजिक्स को डाउन कर देगा फिजिक्स नहीं चलेगी बच्चे की
says: Mercury rules mathematics, and with its retrograde flaw the child's physics is brought down and does not run; chemistry goes with Jupiter in the next lines.
ambiguity: The pronouns are unclear; chemistry is clearly Jupiter later, physics and maths are taken as Mercury's.
classical_check: Mercury for maths and Jupiter for higher knowledge are classical; subject-wise physics and chemistry are his own assignment.

hindi: अगर इस बच्चे का मंगल बहुत अच्छा है तो यह शार्प होगा 100 नंबर लाने वाला बच्चा फिजिक्स में मैथ्स में लेकिन नंबर नहीं आएंगे क्योंकि बुध में दोष है
says: If the same child has a very good Mars he will be sharp, a 100-marks type in physics and maths, yet the marks will not come because of the Mercury fault.
cells_derived_method: Mars in own signs (Aries, Scorpio) or exaltation (Capricorn) gives the sharpness; a Mars in Cancer weakens it.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: strong Mars in Aries on the 3rd gives courage and a sharp analytical mind, yet exam marks are lost to the Mercury flaw.
Derived: debilitated Mars in Cancer on the 5th, no sharpness to offset the Mercury fault, so marks fall more.

classical_check: Mars for technical sharpness is classical.

hindi: केमिस्ट्री डाउन हो जाएगी बृहस्पति के डाउन होते ही केमिस्ट्री कंसंट्रेशन डिक्लाइन और सबसे बड़ी बात होगी सिली मिस्ट आता है लिखने में मार्क्स नहीं आते
says: When Jupiter is down, chemistry and concentration decline, and the biggest result is silly mistakes in writing, so marks do not come.
ambiguity: 'Down' is used loosely for combust, retrograde or weak.
classical_check: Jupiter for chemistry is his assignment; classical texts are silent.

hindi: करना तो है मम्मी को करके दिखा दिया टीचर को करके दिखा दिया पेपर को दोबारा करा के दिखा दिया घर में हो गया लेकिन पेपर के टाइम पर उसके यह दो ग्रह उसके ऑन हो जाएंगे
says: The child can solve the paper at home, show it to mother and teacher, and redo it, but at exam time these two planets switch on and the mistake happens.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: ऐसी स्थिति में वो बच्चा घर से निकलते हुए ना पीला खाए कुछ और ना हरा हरा और पीला नहीं खाना है गलती से भी यदि वो ले लेता है तो यह दो ग्रह एक्टिवेट हो जाते हैं और पेपर के टाइम उसकी बैंड बच जाती है
says: Remedy: such a child should not eat anything yellow or green when leaving home for an exam, because yellow and green activate Jupiter and Mercury and the paper goes badly.
ambiguity: 'Yellow and green food' is taken as foods of those colours; he does not say how long before the exam.
classical_check: Colours for planets are classical; avoiding them for a weak planet before an exam is his own idea.

hindi: आपका शुक्र अस्त है वक्री है तो आपकी लाइफ के अंदर बायोलॉजी गया बायोलॉजी को बचाने के लिए सिर्फ यही चांस है कि उसका मंगल अच्छा हो लेकिन अटके जरूर
says: If Venus is combust or retrograde, biology is lost for the child; the only chance of saving it is a good Mars, and even then the child will stall.
cells_derived_method: Venus in Taurus, Libra or Pisces is in own or exalted dignity and gives some resilience; Virgo is debilitation and worsens it.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: combust Venus in own sign on the 5th keeps liking for life sciences but marks suffer.
Derived: debilitated and retrograde Venus on the 4th makes biology hard and school life unsettled.

ambiguity: Venus is combust only within a few degrees of the Sun, so it is always near the Sun; he does not mention that.
classical_check: Silent on biology; Venus as life, body and nature is a general karaka.

hindi: तो अगर अटक जाता तो नो प्रॉब्लम ऐसी स्थिति में टेंशन नहीं करने का है कि यार टेंशन हो गई है यह उसके शुक्र के दोष के कारण होगा किसी हालत में सुधार नहीं होगा
says: If the child gets stuck in biology, do not worry: it is due to the Venus fault and no effort will improve it.
ambiguity: Fatalistic claim, 'no improvement under any condition'.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: अगर उस बच्चे का चंद्रमा अस्त है डाउन है कुंडली में 6 आ 12 में तीसरे घर में बैठा है तो उसको हिंदी और इंग्लिश में राइटिंग गंदी होगी
says: If the child's Moon is combust, weak, or sitting in the 6th, 8th or 12th, or in the 3rd house, the handwriting in Hindi and English will be poor.
cells_derived_method: The 3rd is the house of hands and writing, so the writing flaw is stronger there; in the 6th, 8th and 12th the Moon is in a trik house, so expression is blocked. The sign adds how: Moon in Cancer or Taurus keeps neat shape, Scorpio breaks it.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Moon in Gemini on the 3rd, the handwriting is restless and quick, hard to read.
Derived: debilitated Moon in Scorpio on the 8th, the writing may be very cramped and the expression suppressed.
Derived: Moon in Pisces on the 12th, writing is dreamy and flowing, but sloppy.

ambiguity: '6 आ 12' is probably 6, 8 (आठ) and 12, which the caption has garbled; the 3rd is also included. 'Down' may mean debilitated or combust.
classical_check: Classical texts link writing to the 3rd and Mercury, and the Moon in dusthana weakens the mind; handwriting claim is his.

gist: Jokes about his own handwriting and doctors being allowed to write badly, a chemist reading a cancer medicine from a doctor's scribble.

hindi: चंद्रमा के दोष हो जाने से उसकी राइटिंग खराब होगी लेखनी बहुत गंदी होगी चंद्रमा एक्सप्रेशन है
says: A fault in the Moon spoils the child's handwriting, because the Moon is expression.
classical_check: Moon as mind and expression is classical; the handwriting link is his.

hindi: मंगल बहुत अच्छा है और ग्रहों में कोई दोष नहीं कोई वक्र नहीं बोल के नहीं बता पाएगा एक्सप्रेशन नहीं है तो ऐसे बड़े सुम बच्चे होते हैं सुम चुप है पूछो कोई आंसर क्वेश्चन नहीं आएंगे
says: A child with good Mars and no other fault but a flawed Moon cannot express what he knows; such children are quiet and silent and give no answers when asked questions.
ambiguity: 'सुम' is a quiet child (sum); the Moon flaw is implied from the context of the previous lines.
classical_check: Silent.

gist: Joking about a child who talks far too much and what that Moon would be; caption broken ('Oh my God anyhow') .

hindi: यह राइटिंग को खा जाता है आपके अगर आपकी कुंडली के अंदर शनि महाराज की जय हो यह आपके वक्री हो गड़बड़ हो अस्त हो डिस्टर्ब हो 1 लाख परट वह बच्चा अपनी लाइन चेंज करेगा पढ़ाई में ए लाइन से बी लाइन में शिफ्टिंग करेगा ही करेगा
says: If Saturn is retrograde, combust or otherwise disturbed in the chart, the child will for certain change his line of study, shifting from stream A to stream B.
cells_derived_method: Saturn in Capricorn, Aquarius or Libra is in own or exalted dignity and holds the line longer; Aries debilitation changes the course early.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: debilitated Saturn in Aries on the 5th, abrupt change of stream and unsettled study.
Derived: disturbed Saturn in own sign on the 4th, the change of line comes late and with delay.

ambiguity: '1 लाख परसेंट' is a figure of speech for certainty.
classical_check: Saturn as delay, change and hindrance is classical; the stream shift claim is his.

hindi: यह सब बात तब हो रही है जब चौथे और पांचवें घर से इन ग्रहों का संबंध है कैसे ना कैसे पर
says: All of these study effects hold when the planets are related in some way to the 4th and 5th houses, which are the study houses.
cells_derived_method: The sign on the 4th and 5th colours how: earth signs make study steady, air signs make it restless, water signs make it emotional.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Virgo on the 4th gives careful, structured schooling, so the planet faults are felt as perfectionism errors.
Derived: Aquarius on the 5th gives unconventional thinking and sudden shifts of subject.

ambiguity: 'Connection' is not defined (placement, aspect, lordship).
classical_check: Agrees with the classical use of the 4th for school and the 5th for intelligence.

hindi: जो लोग ज्योतिष नहीं जानते हमारा बच्चे ने लाइन क्यों चेंज कर ली भैया कहीं ना कहीं किसी ग्रह का ही लोचा है उसे मत पीटो उसे गालियां मत बको बच्चा खुद कंफ्यूज है
says: Parents who ask why the child changed his line should understand that some planet is behind it; do not beat or abuse the child, who is himself confused.
ambiguity: Advice to non-astrologers; the planet is left unnamed.
classical_check: Silent.

gist: Acted story of a young child upset that his friend became a pilot and his girlfriend moved to another college while he wanted to be an engineer.

hindi: अल्टीमेटली उसका शनि उसको लाइन ए में डालता है लाइन ए में डालेगा फिर बी में डालेगा ऐसा देखा गया है कि ग्रहों के कॉमिनेशन के अंतर्गत वो सी और डी में भी जाता है
says: Ultimately his Saturn first puts him in line A, then moves him to B, and with planet combinations he is seen going on to C and D as well.
ambiguity: 'Line A, B, C, D' are example streams, not specific subjects.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: वो बचपन में छोटी उम्र में ए लाइन में कुछ करना चाहते थे पढ़ना चाहते थे लेकिन सब्जेक्ट बी का ले लिया पढ़ते-पढ़ते और जब सब्जेक्ट बी का ले लिया तो अल्टीमेटली जब हायर स्टडी में गए तो सी कर लिया और जॉब डी का
says: Many adults wanted line A in childhood but took subject B, then C in higher studies, and ended in a job of type D, so their career does not match their degree.
ambiguity: This is his observation of people, not a chart rule.
classical_check: Silent.

gist: People complain that their job and business do not match their studies and say they did a big degree but achieved nothing.
Example of a person who did an MBA but works in his father's shop, used to show how the Saturn effect plays out.

hindi: ऐसी स्थिति के अंतर्गत आपका शनि ग्रह जैसा होता है प्लेनेट जो एक्टिवेट होता है प्रॉब्लम क्रिएट करता है इसके रहते आपको बच्चे से नहीं लड़ना है उसके बुध राहु बृहस्पति मंगल इनके उपाय करने हैं
says: When an active Saturn is creating the trouble, the parent should not fight the child but should do remedies for the child's Mercury, Rahu, Jupiter and Mars.
ambiguity: He does not say here what the remedies are.
classical_check: Planet-wise upaya are classical; this particular four-planet set for study is his.

hindi: बच्चे के लिए ऊपर लाखों रुपए फूक रहे हैं खर्चा कर रहे हो उसकी पढ़ाई के लिए इन्वेस्टमेंट कर रहे हैं उसका पेट भी पाल रहे हैं उसको प्ले स्टेशन दे रहे हैं मोबाइल भी दे रहे हैं क्यों नहीं उसके उपाय कर रहे सिर्फ यह कह देना इन चीजों में हमें विश्वास नहीं है व्यर्थ की बात है
says: Parents spend lakhs on fees, keep the child fed, and buy a PlayStation and mobile, so he asks why they do no remedies and simply say they do not believe in these things, which he calls a waste.
ambiguity: A challenge to non-believing parents; no specific remedy is named in this sentence.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: इसलिए आपके बच्चे का दोष नहीं है आप उसे मत कूटो पीटो उसे प्यार करो क्योंकि अल्टीमेटली ऐसी स्थिति में एक प्रॉब्लम होगी यदि इन ग्रहों का दोष है वो फ्रस्ट्रेट हो रहा है
says: It is not the child's fault but the planets'; do not beat him, love him, because with these planet faults he is frustrated and suffering inside.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: बेचारा परेशान है काम कमाई कर नहीं पा रहा पढ़ाई भी उसकी कमाई है वह काम कमाई नहीं कर पा रहा है उसके मन में क्लेश आएगा
says: For a child, study is his earning; when he cannot earn that, he feels distressed and conflict rises in his mind.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: बुद्ध के दोष के कारण यदि वो 6 आठ 12 में बैठा है या वक्री है बोलने में बदतमीज हो जाएगा बहुत ज्यादा तेज बोलेगा
says: If Mercury has a fault by sitting in the 6th, 8th or 12th, or is retrograde, the child becomes rude in speech and talks very loudly.
cells_derived_method: Mercury's speech is shaped by the house and sign. In the 6th the speech becomes argumentative, in the 8th secretive and sharp, in the 12th muddled or hidden; fire signs add loudness, water signs add moodiness.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Mercury in Aries on the 6th, speech is blunt and combative, like picking fights.
Derived: Mercury in Scorpio on the 8th, speech is cutting and sarcastic with hidden motives.
Derived: Mercury in Gemini on the 12th, restless talk that is hard to follow and ends in withdrawal.

ambiguity: Caption says 'six eight twelve'; clearly 6, 8 and 12. Retrograde is an alternative trigger independent of the house.
classical_check: Mercury in dusthanas weakens speech and learning in classical texts; the rude and loud claim is his.

hindi: बृहस्पति के दोष के कारण वक्री या अस्त होने के कारण किसी के बाप की नहीं सुनेगा और बदतमीजी से पलट के जवाब देगा कंसंट्रेशन गई तेल लेने पढ़ाई लिखाई की ऐसी की तैसी पेपरों के टाइम उग्रता चलेगी
says: With a retrograde or combust Jupiter the child listens to nobody, answers back rudely, loses concentration and study, and becomes aggressive at paper time.
cells_derived_method: The effect shifts with the house of Jupiter: on the 4th it shows at home, on the 5th with teachers and in learning, on the 9th towards elders and the guru.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: flawed Jupiter in own sign on the 9th, defiance towards the guru and elders, but some innate wisdom remains.
Derived: debilitated, flawed Jupiter on the 4th in Capricorn, defiance at home and a cold relationship with the mother.

classical_check: Jupiter as the guru and elder karaka makes the disrespect claim consistent with its logic; no text says it.

hindi: ऊंचा बोल बोल के बात करेगा शुक्र का दोष यदि आ जाता है सेम वक्री अस्त उसके मूड स्विंग्स रहेंगे हमेशा लड़की होगी तो ज्यादा बड़ी समस्या हार्मोनल इंबैलेंस भी हो जाएगा अत्यधिक चिड़चिड़ा हट और मानसिक रूप से कलह कचहरी बन जाएगी
says: If Venus has the same fault (retrograde or combust) the child has constant mood swings; for a girl the problem is bigger, with hormonal imbalance, extreme irritability and mental strife. This is his claim only, not a medical diagnosis.
ambiguity: 'Ucha bol bol ke baat karega' belongs to the previous Jupiter sentence (speaking loudly); the Venus part starts after it.
classical_check: Venus as mood and the female hormones is a modern association; classical texts say Venus rules fluids and the reproductive system, so partly consistent.

hindi: चंद्रमा का दोष यदि आ गया तो हाइपर सेंसिटिव हाइपर हाइपर को हम सनक बोलते हैं चंद्रमा के दोष के कारण ही लोगों को भूत नजर आते हैं
says: A Moon fault makes the child hypersensitive, which he calls a whim or craze; he adds that people who see ghosts do so because of a Moon fault.
ambiguity: Not a medical diagnosis; he calls the seeing of ghosts an effect of a weak Moon.
classical_check: Moon as mind and weak Moon with mental fears is classical.

hindi: लगता है रात को कुछ है मुझ पर कुछ किया कराया है मुझे शक है तुझ पे मेरी किताब के अंदर ये रख दिया उसने वो मोर पंख रख दिए मैं सांप की कचली रख दूं ये सब उसके दोष के कारण होता है
says: A person with a Moon fault suspects black magic, thinks something is in the room at night, and suspects someone put peacock feathers or snake skin in his book; he says this is caused by the Moon's fault.
ambiguity: Caption mixes the suspecting person's voice; the claim is that the suspicion comes from the Moon's flaw.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: ये हो जाएगा तो बच्चा बहुत हाइपर हो जाएगा आपका बच्चा पढ़े लिखेगा तो नहीं है लेकिन आप बच्चा भी खो दोगे आपके जीवन से बच्चा गया बड़े होकर के आप रोगे
says: Once the Moon fault acts, the child becomes very hyper; he will not study and the parents may also lose the child, who will leave their life and make them cry when grown.
ambiguity: 'Lose the child' means estrangement, not death.
classical_check: Silent.

gist: The grown child, aged 25 in the caption, abuses and fights with his parents, who wonder what happened.

hindi: आपने बजाय यह करेक्शन करने के उसे समझाना शुरू कर दिया बृहस्पति का दोष हो तो वो बाप होता किसी की नहीं समझेगा किसी की नहीं समझेगा
says: Instead of correcting the planet's problem the parents started lecturing the child; with a Jupiter fault he will not understand what anyone says, so explaining does not work and remedy is needed.
ambiguity: 'वई बिकॉज' is a filler, not a reason.
classical_check: Silent.

gist: Says many clients who showed their charts had these flaws, and when he lectured them strongly they realised they never listen to anyone and think they know everything.

hindi: शनि का वक्र यदि आ जाता है तो आप महा आलसी होंगे आपके बच्चों को आलसी होना ही है अगर वो आलसी नहीं है तो शनि का लेना देना कोई नहीं है
says: A retrograde Saturn makes a person very lazy, so a child must be lazy; if the child is not lazy, Saturn has no involvement.
cells_derived_method: Saturn on the 1st or 5th makes laziness show as personal delay and learning drag; on the 10th it appears as postponed work.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: retrograde Saturn in own sign Capricorn on the 1st, slow and heavy, lazy start but disciplined later.
Derived: retrograde exalted Saturn in Libra on the 5th, learning is slow yet deep, the laziness is mostly procrastination.

ambiguity: Retrograde Saturn is classically strong; his laziness reading is a modern one.
classical_check: Differs from the classical view where retrograde Saturn gains strength; laziness for Saturn is generally accepted.

gist: Mock dialogue of a Saturn child waking at 12 noon, the mother asking why he gets up so late, and the parent not getting up either.

hindi: मजे मजे चल रहा है ढीलू ढाल चल रहा है वो ऐसा ही रहेगा आप उसे मत कूटो पीटो उसका भाग्य उठाओ रॉकेट की तरह कमाए
says: A Saturn-lazy child will remain easygoing, so do not beat him; raise his fortune so that he earns like a rocket.
ambiguity: 'Raise his fortune' likely means doing remedies for the 9th and luck; the method is promised later.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: याद रखें पढ़ाई करा के आप अपने बच्चे को नौकर बना रहे हैं नौकरी करेगा पढ़ाई के स्ट्रेस पे शार्प बनेगा विजडम वाला बनेगा तो पढ़ेगा चाहे नहीं पढ़ेगा यहीं से कमा लेगा
says: Remember that by pushing study you are making the child a servant (a job-holder); if he becomes sharp and wise he will earn from that, studies or not.
ambiguity: An opinion on education and jobs, partially mixed with astrological advice.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: स्मार्ट लोग रूल करते हैं दुनिया को पढ़े लिखों को जॉब करवा के सेटिंग करा के वही कराते हैं यदि उसकी कुंडली में बिजनेस का योग है तो वो अपने र ही पढ़े लिखे एंप्लॉय करेगा
says: Smart people rule the world and make the educated work for them; if the child's chart has a business yoga, he will himself employ educated people.
ambiguity: 'Business yoga' is not defined here.
classical_check: Silent on this specific claim.

hindi: इसका यह मतलब नहीं है कि पढ़ना लिखना नहीं चाहिए पढ़ना लिखना आवश्यक है लेकिन यह जीवन की अंतिम यात्रा नहीं है क्योंकि पढ़ाई पढ़ाई पढ़ाई के चक्कर के अंदर हम कई बार अपना यवन खो देते हैं अपनी एंजॉयमेंट मस्ती खो देते हैं और ओवर सीरियस हो जाते हैं
says: This does not mean one should not study; study is necessary but not the final destination, since in the chase for study people lose their youth, enjoyment and become over-serious.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: दूसरा हम कंपैरिजन सीख जाते हैं कंपैरिजन करने की कला आपके चंद्र बुध बृहस्पति के दोष के कारण आती है आप कंपैरिजन करते ही रहोगे शनि महाराज इतना बर्बाद कर देंगे
says: The habit of comparing oneself with others comes from faults in Moon, Mercury and Jupiter, and Saturn then ruins the person further, keeping him in comparison.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: आपको गड्ढों में ले जाकर करके कि भैया कंपैरिजन ही करता रह तू और इस चक्कर के अंदर कभी भी इंसान ठीक नहीं हो सकता आप ध्यान ऊर्जा खींचते रहोगे और इसी परेशानी के अंदर रहोगे
says: Comparison drags a person into pits; he can never be at peace in this habit, because attention and energy keep being drained and one stays in the same trouble.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: यदि आपका केतु का दोष आ गया तो आप कई कोर्सेस में एडमिशन लोगे एडमिशन के कई जगह फॉर्म भरते हैं हम डीडीए का फ्लैट निकलेगा डीडीए का प्लॉट निकलेगा निकलता है नहीं फीस बीमारी जाती है
says: If Ketu has a fault, the child takes admission in many courses and fills forms at many places, like people applying for a DDA flat, and the fees get wasted.
ambiguity: 'फीस बीमारी जाती है' is read as 'fees are lost'; the word 'bimari' looks like a caption slip.
classical_check: Ketu as detachment and incompletion is classical; the many-admissions claim is his.

hindi: वो बच्चा एडमिशन तो लेगा कोर्स पूरा करेगा ही नहीं कभी तो अगर किसी बच्चे ने ऐसा कर दिया कि उसकी एडमिशन हो रहा है कोर्स पूरा नहीं हो रहा मत कूटो उसका केतु एग्जॉस्ट हो रहा है होने दो कोई मौत नहीं पड़ रही है
says: The Ketu-flawed child takes admission but never completes the course; do not beat him, his Ketu is being exhausted, let it be, nothing fatal is happening.
ambiguity: 'Ketu exhausting' means the Ketu urge to leave things burns out; he gives no time frame.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: जितनी अकल आ गई आ गई होना फिर भी वही है जो लिखा है अल्टीमेट बात आप अपना भाग्य बनाते हैं दो हफ्ते बाद क्लास होगी इसके ऊपर वो कैसे बनता है
says: Ultimately what is written happens anyway, and you make your own fortune; a class two weeks later will explain how fortune is made.
ambiguity: Fate versus self-made fortune is stated in one breath; he does not reconcile them here.
classical_check: Silent; fate and effort together is the usual Jyotish position.

gist: Garbled phrase ('72 per se d on karte hain, wo ho nahin hai') that cannot be understood.

hindi: अपना जीवन अपने बच्चे का और अपना प्यार नर्क मत करो प्यार से जियो नहीं तो बाहर जाकर प्यार ढूंढता फिरे का बच्चा फिर आप कहोगे बिगड़ गया बिगड़ा नहीं है उसके ग्रह ही ऐसे होंगे
says: Do not turn your own life, your child's and your love into hell; live with love, or the child will go out searching for love, and then you will call him spoilt when it is his planets that are such.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: मंगल एक ऐसा मजेदार प्लेनेट है हनुमान कॉन्शसनेस है जिसकी दृष्टि यदि चौथे पांचवें घर से लिंक हो गई तो यह बच्चा जिस पेपर में कम पढ़ेगा उसमें मार्क्स ज्यादा आएंगे
says: Mars is an interesting planet, Hanuman consciousness; if Mars's aspect links to the 4th and 5th houses, the child scores more marks in the papers he studied less.
cells_derived_method: Mars aspects the 4th, 7th and 8th houses from where it sits. Mars on the 1st or 10th hits the 4th; Mars on the 2nd hits the 5th. The sign Mars is in sets how well it gives.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Mars in own sign Aries on the 1st aspects the 4th, a strong lucky Mars gives gain in the papers he did not prepare.
Derived: exalted Mars on the 10th aspects the 1st, 4th and 5th, so the result of little study is big marks and a quick career.
Derived: debilitated Mars in Cancer on the 2nd aspects the 5th, so the luck is unreliable and marks are erratic.

ambiguity: 'Link' to the 4th and 5th is taken as aspect or association; he says 'drishti'.
classical_check: Mars's 4th, 7th and 8th aspects are classical; the little-study-big-marks claim is his.

hindi: वो पढ़े नहीं जिस पेपर में पास हो गए और जिसमें वो पढ़ के गए सोचा ये तो बेस्ट होएगा लाजवाब उसमें फेल हो गए बल्कि बिल्कुल कॉर्नर पर जाके पास हुए
says: The Mars-linked person passes in papers he did not study for and fails or barely passes the paper he prepared best.
ambiguity: Continues the Mars-4th/5th discussion; the two opposite results are the claim.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: चाहे उस दिन वो ग्रह उहे बीमार डाल देगा बच्चे को सुबह-सुबह उसका पेन टूट जाएगा टीचर यूंही पकड़ लेगा पीछे देख रहा था टीप रहा है किसी को उसके पास किसी दूसरे का फर्रा मिल जाएगा
says: On the exam day, the planet may make the child ill, break his pen in the morning, get him caught by the teacher for looking back, or have someone else's slip found near him.
ambiguity: 'वो ग्रह' is likely Mars from the earlier lines; illness is only his claim, not a diagnosis.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: मंगल महाराज उसको कम पड़े पर ज्यादा देंगे यानी आपने कम मेहनत करी ज्यादा पाया जो लोग कमाई में रॉकेट बन जाते हैं वह मंगल और शनि की कृपा से बनते हैं
says: Mars gives more for less study, meaning little effort brings a large gain, and people who rocket in earning do so by the grace of Mars and Saturn.
cells_derived_method: Mars and Saturn do best from the 3rd, 6th, 10th and 11th (houses of effort and gain); in own or exalted signs (Aries, Capricorn, Aquarius, Libra) the effect is cleanly good.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: exalted Mars on the 10th with Saturn in its own sign gives rapid career rise.
Derived: Saturn in Aquarius on the 11th with a supportive Mars gives big gains with a moderate effort.

ambiguity: 'Kripa' of Saturn is an odd phrase since Saturn usually brings delay; he is speaking of earning.
classical_check: Mars and Saturn in the upachaya houses (3, 6, 10, 11) giving gain over time is classical.

gist: Describes people with big cars and buildings who did not study yet give lectures; the sentence is cut off at 'toh aise'.

hindi: ये मंगल की कृपा से है मंगल के पास सारा ल्ट है
says: The occult-minded people and unusual connections a native meets come through Mars's grace; he says Mars holds the whole occult department (the caption word is garbled but reads as occult).
cells_derived_method: Mars as karaka of occult is not tied to a particular house or sign in this sentence. Its expression would depend on which house Mars occupies (what area of life the occult touches) and the sign nature (fire sign: ritual and energy work, water sign: psychic or healing work).

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Mars in its own sign Scorpio in the 8th (lagna Aries) is a classic occult placement, hidden-knowledge and tantra interest.
Derived: Mars in Sagittarius in the 12th (lagna Aries) would show occult or spiritual interest worked out in isolation, foreign places or retreats.

ambiguity: Caption word for occult is garbled (ल्ट); the preceding clause is cut off so who the people are is unclear.
classical_check: Mars is not a classical karaka of the occult (Ketu, Saturn, Rahu are); this is his own attribution.

hindi: अगर पांचवें भाव से मंगल का लिंक हो गया ये वाला घर ये पितरों का घर है पंचम भाव मंगल का लिंक इस पे हो गया आपके पास इंटूटिव पावर्स होंगी
says: If Mars is linked to the 5th house (the house of ancestors), by sitting there or aspecting it, the native gets intuitive powers.
cells_derived_method: The 5th house is touched by different signs depending on lagna; the intuition shows through that sign's nature. Fire/air sign in 5th: quick mental hunches; water sign in 5th: feeling-based, psychic type. The link can be by occupation or by Mars aspect (4th, 7th, 8th) from another house.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Mars in own sign Aries in the 5th (lagna Sagittarius), strong sharp intuition, speaks first and is proved right.
Derived: Mars in Pisces in the 5th (lagna Scorpio), intuition of the dreamy, feeling kind; psychic impressions rather than logic.

ambiguity: He says link (लिंक) without defining it here; later in the same passage he means conjunction in 5th or aspect to 5th.
classical_check: Classics treat Mars in 5th as a mixed placement (harming children and mind), not as intuition; this is his own reading from the 5th as the house of purva-punya.

hindi: आप आकाश रिकॉर्ड्स खंगाल लोगे पढ़ने की जरूरत नहीं है आपके पास सरस्वती सिद्ध होगी अपने आप मुंह से बोल दोगे काम हो जाएगा
says: With Mars linked to the 5th the native can reach the akashic records without studying; speech-power (Saraswati siddhi) comes, what he says spontaneously happens.
cells_derived_method: Same Mars-5th link as the previous sentence. The speech power would differ by sign on the 5th and by whether Mercury or Jupiter also supports; air sign gives fluent speech, water sign gives intuitive sayings.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Gemini in 5th (lagna Aquarius) with Mars linked: ready speech that proves true.
Derived: Scorpio in 5th (lagna Cancer) with Mars there: deep, secretive insight, a person who says little but his words are taken as prophecy.

ambiguity: Whether this needs Mars alone or any strong Mars link is not said.
classical_check: Classics are silent on akashic records; the idea of vak-siddhi is attached by tradition to Jupiter/Mercury/5th-9th.

gist: Examples of miracle healers: doctors, mounds (tile) where bowing the head solves things, doctors who give water and the work is done.
Examples of baba who give puriya (powder packets), jaundice medicine still famous, peacock-feather exorcism, asthma medicine given inside a fish.
Says holy water is made by dipping in the Ganga, Gangajal does not rot, and pickle made in it gets no fungus.
Concludes that there must be some unique power somewhere behind these strange happenings.

hindi: यह पंचम भाव से मंगल का लिंक हो जाने मात्र से चाहे नीच का ही हो कोई फर्क नहीं
says: Merely a link between Mars and the 5th house is enough for these miracle abilities, even if Mars is debilitated; dignity of Mars does not matter for this effect.
cells_derived_method: Debilitated Mars is in Cancer (sign 4). Linked to the 5th by occupation or aspect. Which cell: Mars in Cancer in the 5th (lagna Pisces) or Mars in Cancer in 2nd, 10th, 11th aspecting the 5th. The 4th, 7th, 8th aspects of Mars decide which houses count.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: debilitated Mars sitting in the 5th itself (lagna Pisces); by his rule the intuition still comes though other results suffer.
Derived: debilitated Mars in Cancer in the 10th (lagna Libra) throws its 8th aspect on the 5th (Aquarius); still counted as a link.
Derived: debilitated Mars in Cancer in the 11th (lagna Virgo) sends its 7th aspect to the 5th (Capricorn); intuition via friends or networks.

ambiguity: He may be saying only that sign dignity is irrelevant for the occult link, not that debilitation causes no harm elsewhere.
classical_check: Classics reduce planetary strength sharply for debilitation; this is a departure.

hindi: मंगल महाराज अगर यहां बैठे हैं यहां से यहां दृष्टि है यहां से यहां दृष्टि है यहां से यहां है इससे लिंक हो गया
says: Mars links to the 5th in four ways: sitting in the 5th itself, or aspecting it from other houses with its special aspects (shown on the chart pointing to the 5th from three different houses).
cells_derived_method: Mars aspects the 4th, 7th and 8th houses from itself. To hit the 5th it must be in the 2nd (4th aspect), 11th (7th aspect) or 10th (8th aspect). The sign Mars occupies in each of those houses sets the quality of the aspect.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Mars in Leo in the 2nd (lagna Cancer) aspects the 5th (Scorpio, its own sign) by 4th aspect; strong link.
Derived: Mars in own sign Scorpio in the 11th (lagna Capricorn) aspects the 5th (Taurus) by the 7th aspect.
Derived: Mars in Capricorn in the 10th (lagna Aries) aspects the 5th (Leo) by its 8th aspect.

ambiguity: The positions are pointed out on a board; the house numbers come from later words (8th and 7th aspect) so the 4th aspect case is inferred.
classical_check: Agrees on Mars special aspects 4, 7, 8 (Parashari).

hindi: 100% या तो रेकी करोगे या आप हर हालत के अंदर कोई टैरो करोगे ज्योतिष में घुसो कहीं ना कहीं ल्ट में जाओगे ही जाओगे
says: With Mars linked to the 5th he claims the person will certainly take up some occult practice: Reiki, tarot or astrology, he will end up in the occult field in some form.
cells_derived_method: The type of occult field follows the sign on the 5th: air signs lean to tarot and astrology (analysis), water signs to Reiki and healing; Mars adds energy-type work.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Libra in 5th (lagna Gemini) with Mars link: tarot/astrology via talk and counselling.
Derived: Cancer in 5th (lagna Pisces) with Mars link: Reiki or healing-type energy work.

ambiguity: The 100 percent is a strong claim; no mention of other conditions like affliction by Saturn.
classical_check: Silent in classics; modern pattern-claim.

hindi: अगर इसी के साथ यहां भी लिंक हो गया मंगल का वो यहां बैठे और यहां बैठे मंगल का लिंक होगा दोनों से तो आपकी इंटू बहुत पावरफुल होंगी
says: If Mars is also linked to a second house along with the 5th, so that Mars connects to both, the intuition becomes very powerful; the second house is shown on the board and is probably the 9th, since he goes on to talk of the 9th and the 5th together.
cells_derived_method: One Mars can touch both the 5th and the 9th by aspect: from the 2nd house it hits the 5th by its 4th aspect and the 9th by its 8th aspect. Mars sitting in the 5th itself aspects the 8th, 11th and 12th, so it cannot reach the 9th; the double link by one Mars needs Mars in the 2nd.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: debilitated Mars in Cancer in the 2nd (lagna Gemini) aspects the 5th (Libra) by 4th aspect and the 9th (Aquarius) by 8th aspect, a double link.
Derived: Mars in own sign Aries in the 2nd (lagna Pisces) hits the 5th (Cancer) and the 9th (Scorpio): strong intuitive and fortunate combination.

ambiguity: The second house is not named in the caption; the 9th is inferred. Could be a different house.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: आप यूं ही तुक्के मार दोगे यहां से आठवी दृष्टि हो गई यहां से सातवी हो गई यहां बैठे यहां भी देख रहा है
says: With these Mars links the native's casual guesses will come true; he restates that Mars aspects the 5th by 8th aspect from one house and 7th aspect from another, and also sits in one of them.
cells_derived_method: 8th aspect to the 5th means Mars in the 10th; 7th aspect means Mars in the 11th. Sign of Mars in the 10th or 11th gives the flavour of the hunches.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Mars in own sign Aries in the 10th (lagna Cancer) aspects the 5th (Scorpio) by 8th aspect; hunches shown in profession.
Derived: Mars in Virgo in the 11th (lagna Scorpio) aspects the 5th (Pisces) by 7th aspect; hunches through friends and gains.

ambiguity: Partly a repeat of the aspect statement; kept because it states the 7th and 8th explicitly.
classical_check: Agrees on the aspect geometry; the guess-turns-true claim is his.

hindi: आप सोच के चलिए कितने लोग चमत्कारिक रूप से सफल है कैसे कोई कृपा है उनके ऊपर यह कृपा का खाना है पंचम भाव
says: People who become successful in a miraculous way have some grace on them; the 5th house is the slot of grace (kripa).
cells_derived_method: The 5th house as house of grace applies to all signs on it. Which sign sits on the 5th and who rules it show the type of grace (Jupiter-ruled: wisdom, Sun-ruled: authority, Moon-ruled: public).

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Sagittarius on the 5th (lagna Leo) with Jupiter well placed: grace as guidance from teachers and blessings.
Derived: Leo on the 5th (lagna Aries) with Sun strong: grace in the form of fame and authority coming almost unearned.

classical_check: Agrees that the 5th is the house of purva-punya (past merit) and grace.

hindi: यहां से कृपा मिलती है आशीर्वाद पित्रों की कृपा कैसे काम हो जाते हैं
says: The 5th house is where blessings and the grace of ancestors (pitris) come from, and this is why some people's work gets done on its own.
cells_derived_method: The 5th is house of ancestral blessing in every lagna; its strength is judged by sign on it, lord and planets in or aspecting it.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Taurus on the 5th (lagna Capricorn) with benefic Venus: ancestral blessing shows as material ease and family wealth.
Derived: Aquarius on the 5th (lagna Libra): ancestral grace mixed with Saturn's delay, grace comes late and through discipline.

classical_check: Agrees: 5th is the house of purva-punya.

hindi: ऐसी स्थिति में ही हम किसी गुरु को पकड़ते हैं भगवान हमारा धर्म गुरु मंदिर गुरुद्वारा हम किसी गुरु को पकड़ते हैं वहां से नौवा यह हमारा नौवा घर है
says: When the 5th is active we take a guru, God or a dharma guru, a temple or gurudwara; that is a function of the 9th house, which he identifies as our 9th.
cells_derived_method: The 9th house governs gurus and dharma in all lagnas. The sign on the 9th and its lord show which type of guru: fire sign teacher, water sign devotional path, earth sign ritual and temple.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Pisces on the 9th (lagna Cancer): devotional guru path, temples and surrender.
Derived: Capricorn on the 9th (lagna Taurus): disciplined, structured religion, serious teachers.

ambiguity: The sentence is spoken in pieces; reads as 9th-house = guru, linked to 5th by the next sentence.
classical_check: Agrees: 9th is house of guru and dharma.

hindi: नौवे से नौवा पंचम डबल डबल इंपैक्ट डबल इंपैक्ट है यानी प्रबल भाग्यशाली
says: The 5th is the 9th from the 9th, so it carries a double impact of fortune; a strong 5th means a very lucky person.
cells_derived_method: Using bhava-from-bhava: 5th is the 9th counted from the 9th. So whatever is good for the 9th lifts the 5th and the 5th is the lucky house of the lucky house. The sign on both houses should be read together.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Sagittarius on the 5th (lagna Leo) with Aries on the 9th: both trines are fire signs, fortune doubled by fire.
Derived: Pisces on the 5th (lagna Scorpio) with 9th Cancer: water trine, fortune through faith and emotion.

ambiguity: None.
classical_check: Agrees with the bhavat bhavam concept.

hindi: यहां पर ग्रह अच्छा है भाग्यशाली
says: A good (benefic or well placed) planet in the 5th makes the native fortunate.
cells_derived_method: A good planet in the 5th shows luck in the matters of its own nature; the sign gives the area, e.g. Jupiter in a water sign gives luck of children and faith.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Jupiter exalted in Cancer in the 5th (lagna Pisces) gives luck through children and learning.
Derived: Venus in own sign Libra in the 5th (lagna Gemini) brings luck in creativity and romance.

ambiguity: 'Good planet' is not defined.
classical_check: Agrees in general; classics also warn that natural malefics in the 5th harm children.

hindi: मान लो ये दो नंबर राशि लिखी है यहां और यहां शुक्र बैठ गया तो नौवे का मालिक नौवे में चला गया परम भाग्यशाली है
says: Example: if sign 2 (Taurus) is on the 9th and Venus sits there, the 9th lord is in the 9th, which makes the person supremely fortunate.
cells_derived_method: For any lagna, the 9th lord sitting in the 9th is the principle; here Taurus on the 9th gives lagna Virgo, so Venus is both the 9th lord and in own sign. For other signs the same pattern holds: lord of sign on the 9th in the 9th.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Virgo, Venus in own sign Taurus in the 9th, 9th lord in the 9th, fortune and religion strong.
Derived: lagna Aries, Jupiter in own sign Sagittarius in the 9th, same pattern with Jupiter, very strong dharma.

ambiguity: He points at the board; the 2 on the 9th is the only reading that makes sense of 'lord of the 9th in the 9th'.
classical_check: Agrees: lord of a bhava in its own bhava strengthens it.

hindi: कोई सी भी राशि का कोई भी ग्रह हो
says: This 9th-lord-in-9th result is not limited to Taurus and Venus; it works for any sign and any planet that rules the 9th.
cells_derived_method: For any sign on the 9th, its lord placed in the 9th. Strength differences come from the planet's nature: benefic lord (Jupiter/Venus) gives smooth fortune, malefic lord (Saturn/Mars) gives luck with effort.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Capricorn on the 9th (lagna Taurus); Saturn in own sign Capricorn in the 9th: fortune by hard work, delayed but stable.
Derived: Scorpio on the 9th (lagna Pisces); Mars in own sign Scorpio in the 9th: fortune through courage and risk.

ambiguity: Short sentence; applies to the previous example.
classical_check: Agrees in principle.

gist: Garbled aside about what you will do after studying and wanting to become a rocket; cannot tell the meaning.

hindi: बहुत से लोग पढ़ लिख नहीं पाएंगे इसलिए बच्चे की पढ़ाई के मुद्दे को लेकर इतने सारे ग्रह इन्फ्लुएंस करते हैं
says: Many people will not manage to complete studies; that is why so many planets influence the issue of a child's education.
cells_derived_method: Education is read from the 5th (and 4th, 9th); multiple planets by aspect or placement on it disturb the course. Sign on the 5th decides which planets are friendly.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Virgo on the 5th (lagna Taurus); Mercury-ruled, study usually fine unless Saturn or Mars hit it.
Derived: Sagittarius on the 5th (lagna Leo); with Saturn's aspect, studies break despite the good sign.

ambiguity: It is a general lead-in for the aspects that follow.
classical_check: Agrees that the 5th is the education house, with the 4th.

hindi: शनि की दृष्टि यहां पर आ गई शनि महाराज ने यहां लिंक ले लिया यहां से शनि ने दृष्टि दे डाली यहां से दे डाली
says: Saturn linking to the 5th house, by occupation or by its aspects from different houses (it throws its aspect onto the 5th from two or three places), is the start of an education problem.
cells_derived_method: Saturn aspects the 3rd, 7th and 10th from itself. To hit the 5th it sits in the 3rd (3rd aspect), 11th (7th aspect) or 8th (10th aspect). The sign Saturn occupies sets friendliness.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Saturn exalted in Libra in the 3rd (lagna Leo) aspects the 5th (Sagittarius) by 3rd aspect.
Derived: Saturn in own sign Aquarius in the 8th (lagna Cancer) aspects the 5th (Scorpio) by 10th aspect.
Derived: Saturn in own sign Capricorn in the 11th (lagna Pisces) aspects the 5th (Cancer) by 7th aspect.

ambiguity: Which aspects (3, 7, 10) are used is inferred from the board gestures, not named in this sentence.
classical_check: Agrees on Saturn special aspects 3, 7, 10.

hindi: 1 लाख पर बंदा लाइफ के अंदर फ्रेंच स्पैनिश जर्मन में एडमिशन लेगा ही लेगा
says: With Saturn aspecting the 5th, the person is nearly sure (he says one lakh percent) to take admission in a foreign-language course like French, Spanish or German at some point in life.
cells_derived_method: Same Saturn-5th link. The type of course varies with the sign on the 5th (Gemini or Virgo: languages, Taurus: arts) but he states languages generally.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Gemini on the 5th (lagna Aquarius) with Saturn aspect: language course is a natural choice that gets started but dropped.
Derived: Taurus on the 5th (lagna Capricorn) with Saturn aspect: admission to a course (art, music, language) that gets abandoned.

ambiguity: The caption number 'one lakh' is an exaggeration for certainty.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: कोई सी भी लैंग्वेज चाइनीज कर ले वो पढ़ेगा नहीं पूरा एडमिशन 101 पर लेगा
says: Any language, even Chinese: the person will enroll but will not complete the study; he will enroll for sure while the study itself is not finished.
cells_derived_method: Saturn's aspect on the 5th gives starts without finish. Sign on the 5th only changes the subject chosen.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Libra on the 5th (lagna Gemini) with Saturn aspect (Saturn is exalted in Libra, strong): enrolls, studies half, stops.
Derived: Pisces on the 5th (lagna Scorpio) with Saturn aspect: enrolls in many courses, never completes any.

ambiguity: '101' is a figure of speech for certain.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: अगर यह अन्य ग्रह की दृष्टि है मंगल इत्यादि या भाव अच्छा है तो पूरी करेगा लेकिन वो एडमिशन जरूर लेगा
says: If another planet such as Mars also aspects the 5th, or the house itself is good, the person will complete the course, but he will still be sure to take admission anyway.
cells_derived_method: Completion is helped by a supportive second aspect (Mars gives push) or a strong 5th house. Strong sign on the 5th (own or friendly sign for its lord) counts as good house.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Aries on the 5th (lagna Sagittarius) with Mars lord in own sign: house strong, course completed despite Saturn's aspect.
Derived: Leo on the 5th (lagna Aries) with Sun strong: completes the course.

ambiguity: 'Good house' is not defined.
classical_check: Agrees in principle with balancing benefic aspects.

hindi: जो लोग एडमिशन लेते हैं करते नहीं कहते हैं पढ़ता नहीं है बच्चा ऐसा नालायक है नालायक नहीं है भैया उसका ग्रह एग्जॉस्ट होने दो
says: Parents who say the child enrolls but does not study and call him useless are wrong; it is the planet, so let the planet's effect get exhausted.
cells_derived_method: None; a general counsel. The planet is the one aspecting the 5th as discussed; no house or sign dependence.
ambiguity: Planet not named in this line; contextually Saturn on the 5th.
classical_check: Silent; consistent with dasha-based waiting.

hindi: जब ग्रह एग्जॉस्ट होता है तो बचते हैं आप
says: When the planet's effect is exhausted, the native is saved from its trouble; the planet takes its due first and only then releases.
cells_derived_method: None; a general principle on how malefic results end.
classical_check: Silent.
