hindi: यह आपका पंचम भाव है इस भाव के अंदर आपका नीच का एक ग्रह बैठा हुआ है मान लो मंगल नीच का बैठा है चार नंबर का मंगल नीच होता है
says: Setup for the next example: a debilitated planet in the 5th house, say Mars in sign 4 (Cancer), where Mars is debilitated.
cells_derived_method: Cancer on the 5th gives lagna Pisces. Same idea for any debilitated planet in the 5th; the body part and result varies with the planet.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Pisces with debilitated Mars in the 5th, 2nd and 9th lord weak in the house of children and study.

ambiguity: None; confirms Cancer = 4 for Mars debilitation.
classical_check: Agrees: Mars is debilitated in Cancer.

hindi: यह सर्जरी कराएगा कमर में या घुटने में सर्जरी कराएगा ही कराएगा
says: Debilitated Mars in the 5th will definitely cause a surgery, on the waist or the knee. He states this as sure; recorded as his claim, not a medical statement.
cells_derived_method: Medical claim by him; body area is not derived from sign here. Flag only: surgery is Mars's signification, and the 5th (belly/stomach area) could be linked.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Pisces; he says debilitated Mars here shows surgery on the waist or knee.

ambiguity: Which person (child or native) has the surgery is not stated; the context is a child.
classical_check: Silent on knee or waist surgery for this combination.

hindi: लड़की है तो उसको गायनी प्रॉब्लम देगा ओवेरियन सिस्ट देगा ही देगा उसको हर हालत में सिजेरियन ऑपरेशन करा सकता है कराएगा नहीं करा सकता है और भी कॉमिनेशन है
says: If the child is a girl, the same Mars will give gynecological problems and ovarian cysts; it may lead to a caesarean operation, though that is only possible not certain, and other combinations also matter. This is his medical-type claim, recorded only.
cells_derived_method: Female-specific reading; sign Cancer relates to the female organs. Other signs of 5th would alter the body-area reading.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Pisces; debilitated Mars in Cancer (breast/womb sign) in the 5th: he links it to womb-area surgery for a girl.

ambiguity: He says 'may do, will not do' in the same breath, so certainty is low.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: अब यहां पढ़ाई का भी खाना है अब पढ़ाई में वो बच्ची फेल हो गई या लड़का फेल हो गया फेल हो गया मंगल कहता है बली ले ली मैंने
says: The 5th is also the study slot; if the child fails in studies, Mars says he has taken his sacrifice (bali), and the failure itself is the price paid.
cells_derived_method: Failure in studies stands in for the bali Mars demands from a 5th-house link; sign on the 5th does not change this logic but changes the type of loss.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Pisces; debilitated Mars here takes bali as a failed exam instead of a surgery.

classical_check: Silent; the bali idea is his own.

hindi: फिर दोबारा करा दिया किसी कोर्स में एडमिशन ले लिया वेस्ट हो गया मंगल कंज्यूम सर्जरी नहीं होगी लगेगा और बच गए
says: If the child is put in another course again and that too is wasted, Mars's demand is consumed, no surgery will be needed and the family is saved.
cells_derived_method: Wasted fee and time buys off the Mars sacrifice. Unchanged across signs.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: एक बच्चे की मृत्यु होगी जिंदगी भर आपने बच्चे को डंडे मार मार के पास कराया साले कैसे नहीं करेगा
says: If you instead force the child to pass by beating him all through life, he warns the planet will take a heavier sacrifice; the caption mentions a death of a child, which is garbled and not a prediction.
cells_derived_method: None; no house or sign dependence beyond the 5th.
ambiguity: The mention of death looks like a caption error or hyperbole. No death statement is recorded as a prediction.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: बली दी तन मन धन मन की और धन की बलि दी तन की बलि दी हर हालत के अंदर पढ़ा के छोड़ा उसकी तगड़ी सर्जरी होगी किडनी में स्टोन डाल देगा किडनी की ही खराबी कर देगा किडनी पकड़ता है
says: If the family pays the sacrifice of mind and money but forces the child through study, the body pays: a serious surgery, kidney stones or kidney trouble, because Mars holds the kidneys. This is a medical-type claim, recorded only.
cells_derived_method: Mars is linked to the kidney (water-sign Scorpio area) and blood. Sign on the 5th matters little; he reads it from the planet.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Cancer; Mars in own sign Scorpio in the 5th: strong Mars, kidney or urinary issue via forced pressure.

ambiguity: Whose kidney (child or native) is not stated.
classical_check: Silent; Mars-blood and Scorpio-urinary links are traditional but the kidney claim here is his.

hindi: इसलिए बच्चे का फेल होना बहुत श्रेयस्कर है हम कहते हैं कि बच्चों को फेल हो जा अटक के कर रुक के कर गैप ले ले
says: Therefore a child failing is much better in such a chart; he advises letting the child fail, study slowly, stop, or take a gap year rather than push through.
cells_derived_method: Remedy to be applied when Mars or Saturn burdens the 5th; no sign dependence.
ambiguity: It is advice on parenting, not a ritual; classed as a remedy because it substitutes a smaller loss for a bigger one.
classical_check: Not found in classics.

gist: Parents cry that the child must get admission in Delhi; if the planet is against it, it will not happen.

hindi: चॉइस की जगह तो शनि होने ही नहीं देगा शनि की क्लास अगली बार देखेंगे
says: Saturn will not allow admission at the place of one's choice when it is linked with the 5th; he leaves details of Saturn for the next class.
cells_derived_method: Saturn denies the preferred institution via the 5th link (education). Sign on 5th changes the field only.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Sagittarius; Saturn debilitated in Aries in the 5th denies the preferred institution strongly.
Derived: lagna Virgo; Saturn in own sign Capricorn in the 5th: gets a place only late and by effort.

classical_check: Silent.

hindi: क्या करें अब एक जगह फेल भी होना है भर दो भाई सब जगह भर दो पैसे जा रहे हैं जाओ बली तो देनी पड़ेगी ग्रह की
says: Practical advice: where a failure is due anyway, fill admission forms everywhere; the money that goes is the sacrifice owed to the planet.
ambiguity: Financial advice is not investment advice; it is about admission fees.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: हम कहते हैं उपाय कर लो कोई महंगा उपाय होना है पत्थर पहनना है लोग कहते पैसे नहीं है बच्चे के एडमिशन के लिए
says: He recommends doing a remedy (possibly costly, like wearing a gemstone) for the child's admission; people reply they have no money for it.
cells_derived_method: None; the stone depends on the planet found afflicting, not stated.
ambiguity: Which stone is not said.
classical_check: Gem remedies exist in later tradition, not in the early classics.

hindi: बली तो देनी पड़ेगी बच्चा पैदा करो पढ़ाओ लिखा हो बड़ा करो तब तक बलि ही देनी है मकान खरीदना बलि ही देनी है भगवान फ्री में कुछ नहीं देता
says: Sacrifice must be paid in every big thing: raising and educating a child, buying a house; nothing comes free from God, there is always a price.
cells_derived_method: None; a general philosophy of cost for gain.
classical_check: Silent.

gist: Aphorism that when we eat bread our breath goes on, meaning every gain has a cost.
Story of a child getting a seat in Bangalore, fee of lakhs paid by the 15th, then later admission in Delhi.

hindi: पैसे रिफंड नहीं लेने वो बली है उसको मरने देना है वो ग्रह ने बली ली है
says: Do not claim a refund of the fee for the seat that is lost; that money is the bali the planet has taken, so let it go.
ambiguity: A financial do/don't; recorded as his claim only, not advice.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: वो बली लिए बिना छोड़ेगा नहीं बड़े-बड़े लोग बली नहीं देके राजी वापस रिफंड करा लेते हैं यहां बच्चा फेल हो जाता है एक साल वेस्ट होता है कंपटीशन होता है कोई ना कोई लफड़ा होता है रैगिंग
says: The planet will not leave without its sacrifice; people who avoid paying by taking a refund then suffer a failed exam, a lost year, competition trouble or ragging instead.
ambiguity: The sentence runs into the next slice at the word ragging.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: में कुछ ना कुछ पंगे कराता ही है छोड़ेगा नहीं वो
says: Finishing the thought from the last class: the planet that is owed a sacrifice will keep creating some kind of trouble around the child's study and will not let go until it has been paid.
cells_derived_method: none; a general statement not tied to a house or sign.
ambiguity: The planet is not named in this fragment; from the previous slice it is the Mars (or Saturn) link on the 5th.
classical_check: Silent; the idea of a planet demanding a bali is his own framing.

hindi: आपको बलि देनी है बलि देने में कंजूसी मत करो देने वाले भी यही ग्रह हैं लेने वाले तो
says: You must pay the sacrifice and not be stingy about it, because the planets that take from you are also the ones that give to you.
ambiguity: Sentence is cut at the end; reads as 'the takers are also the givers'.
classical_check: Silent.

gist: Rhetorical complaint in the voice of an unwilling donor: what death is this, we have been robbed, looted; nobody has taken anything.

hindi: अगर आप खुद लुटने को राजी नहीं होते तो हम यही उपाय बताते जाओ गुरुद्वारे में सोना दान करके आओ धर्म के नाम पर भी लुटवा
says: If a person is not willing to be 'looted' by the planet through losses, his remedy is to donate gold at a gurudwara or otherwise give away wealth in the name of dharma, so the loss is taken voluntarily.
cells_derived_method: none; the remedy is generic for any sacrifice-demanding planet. A sign or house split would need the planet: e.g. Mars in the 5th would point to a Mars-related offering, which he does not say.
ambiguity: He does not give the quantity of gold; it is also the donation of any wealth.
classical_check: Gold donation (swarna-daan) exists in the tradition, mostly linked to Jupiter; he does not link it to a planet here.

hindi: कुछ भी कर ले तू देता ही नहीं है कहां से दे है ही नहीं नहीं है जो है वो तो दो उसमें से दो
says: To the person who says he has nothing to give, he replies: give out of whatever you do have, even a small part of it; the planet's sacrifice is counted from what you possess.
ambiguity: An imagined dialogue; recorded because the rule 'give from what you have' follows.
classical_check: Silent; in line with the general dana tradition.

hindi: तुम्हारे में गुर्दा होना चाहिए बढ़ेगा जितना बढ़ा सकते हो कोटा बढ़ाओ ऊपर वाले से हम करते ही नहीं हमारी ना बहुत ज्यादा है
says: Have the courage to raise your offering quota to the higher power as much as you can; he complains that people mostly refuse and their 'no' is very big.
ambiguity: The caption is partly garbled; 'kidney' is an idiom for courage here, not the body part.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: यही हमारे पितरों का स्थान है
says: Pointing again at the house on the board, he says this is the seat of our ancestors, which sets up the next test for education problems.
cells_derived_method: The seat of ancestors is the 5th house in every lagna; which sign touches it changes which ancestors' side or which type of blessing shows.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Cancer on the 5th (lagna Pisces): ancestral blessing runs through the mother's side and emotional memory.
Derived: Capricorn on the 5th (lagna Virgo): ancestral blessing via discipline and the family's duty tradition.

ambiguity: He says 'this' without a number; context from the previous class is the 5th.
classical_check: Agrees: 5th as house of purva-punya and lineage.

hindi: अगर बच्चा पढ़ाई में सेट नहीं हो रहा है कोई ग्रह का वकृत्व नहीं है ना अस्त है 1 लाख पर कहीं ना कहीं पितरों की कृपा नहीं हो रही है
says: A diagnostic: if a child is not settling in studies and no planet is retrograde or combust to explain it, then he says with certainty the ancestors' grace is not flowing.
cells_derived_method: Check first the 5th house, its sign and lord for obvious damage (retrograde, combust). If none, the cause is attributed to the pitri link instead. The sign on the 5th tells where to look: fire or air signs show breaks as restlessness, earth or water signs show them as heaviness or confusion.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Virgo on the 5th (lagna Taurus): Mercury lord has no retrograde or combustion, yet study fails to settle, so ancestors are blamed.
Derived: Scorpio on the 5th (lagna Cancer): Mars lord is clean, yet studies stall, which he reads as a missing pitri blessing.

ambiguity: Not said whether to check Jupiter (karaka of children) too.
classical_check: Classics blame the 5th lord, Jupiter and malefic aspects first, and also mention pitri-dosha; he says retrograde and combust only.

hindi: पितरों को याद करना सिखाओ इसीलिए
says: Remedy for the above: teach the child to remember the ancestors regularly.
cells_derived_method: none; same remedy for any sign on the 5th.
ambiguity: No method stated here (naming them, offering water); explained loosely in the next lines.
classical_check: Agrees with shraddha and tarpan tradition in a general way.

gist: In earlier times children went to ashrams under the brahmacharya stage; the aim was to educate, not to make the child celibate.

hindi: बचपन में इतना ज्ञान दे दिया कि वो नाभी को समझ जाए और पितरों से कृपा लेना सीख जाए मजे में पड़ेगा
says: Give the child enough early knowledge to understand the navel (the family source) and to learn to take grace from the ancestors; then he will study happily.
ambiguity: 'Nabhi' (navel) could mean the family root or the navel chakra; not explained.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: आपको क्या लगता है जो बहुत सफल लोग हैं बहुत ऊंचे बन गए हैं बहुत लाजवाब पैसा धन मान पद इज्जत कमा रहे हैं इन पर कृपा नहीं है
says: Rhetorical claim: do you think the highly successful people, who earn great wealth, status and respect, have no grace on them; he says they certainly do.
cells_derived_method: none; success is traced to the 5th-house grace discussed above.
classical_check: Silent as written; fits the idea of purva-punya.

hindi: एक आदमी एक जन्म के अंदर 24 घंटे में कैसे कर सकता है इतने काम ऊपर वाले का हात है बिना कृपा के इंपॉसिबल असंभव है
says: One person in one lifetime and 24-hour days cannot do so much by effort alone; the hand of the higher power is behind it and it is impossible without grace.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: इसलिए उस कृपा को लेने के लिए आपको पितरों की कृपा लेनी है इसलिए बच्चों को याद दिलाओ
says: To receive that grace you have to take the ancestors' grace first; hence keep reminding the children to do so.
classical_check: Agrees in spirit with pitri-puja before other worship.

gist: Notes that everyone tells a child to remember Mother Saraswati before studying; sets up the critique that follows.

hindi: माता सरस्वती राहु तीन नंबर का जब होता है वह सरस्वती है
says: In his scheme the deity Saraswati is Rahu when it is in sign number 3 (Gemini); that is the Saraswati form.
cells_derived_method: Rahu in Gemini can be in any house depending on lagna, and the area where the Saraswati-like power shows is that house's topic: 3rd = writing and speech, 5th = study and intellect, 10th = career in communication.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Rahu in Gemini in the 3rd (lagna Aries): Saraswati energy shows as writing, communication and courage.
Derived: Rahu in Gemini in the 5th (lagna Aquarius): the Saraswati force acts on study, but with Rahu's restlessness.
Derived: Rahu in Gemini in the 10th (lagna Virgo): the Saraswati force goes into profession, media or sharp business talk.

ambiguity: 'Teen number' could be sign number 3 or house number 3; in this series signs are numbered, and the logic of Gemini as Mercury's sign fits.
classical_check: Classics link Saraswati with Mercury or Jupiter, not Rahu; this is his own mapping.

hindi: अब बताइए छ नंबर का बुध जब होता है तो यह दुर्गा है
says: Mercury in sign number 6 (Virgo) is the Durga form in his deity mapping.
cells_derived_method: Mercury in Virgo (own and exalted sign) in any house: the Durga force acts on the topic of the house where it stands.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Mercury in Virgo in the 1st (lagna Virgo): the Durga force shows in the native's own personality and intellect.
Derived: Mercury in Virgo in the 7th (lagna Pisces): the Durga force expresses through partnership and business dealings.
Derived: Mercury in Virgo in the 10th (lagna Sagittarius): Durga energy in career, service and analytical work.

ambiguity: Number 6 could also be a house number; the sign reading is used since he is mapping signs to deities.
classical_check: Classics assign Mercury to Vishnu and Durga to Mars or Rahu; this is his mapping.

hindi: अब यहां पर आपकी कुंडली में नौ नंबर पड़ा हुआ है यह गणेश का है केतु
says: If sign number 9 (Sagittarius) is what falls on that house of the child's chart, this is the Ganesh sign, ruled by Ketu in his scheme.
cells_derived_method: Sagittarius on any house makes that house's topic Ganesh-linked: e.g. on the 5th education is Ganesh/Ketu-governed; on the 9th dharma is.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Sagittarius on the 5th (lagna Leo): the child's study area is Ganesh/Ketu-governed, so Ganesh is the right deity for exams.
Derived: Sagittarius on the 9th (lagna Aries): the dharma and luck area is Ganesh-linked.

ambiguity: Sign 9 vs house 9; here he means the sign on a given house. The Jupiter-rules-Sagittarius view is not mentioned; he uses Ketu.
classical_check: Classics say Jupiter rules Sagittarius; Ketu-Ganesh is a popular but separate link.

hindi: आपने यहां राहु इवोक कर दिया सरस्वती की पूजा करा रहे हो बच्चे से उसके पेपर की बैंड बज जाएगी 100% बैंड बज जाएगी
says: If the house carries the Ganesh-Ketu sign (9) and you make the child worship Saraswati (Rahu), you invoke Rahu there, and the child's paper will be ruined for sure.
cells_derived_method: The mismatch is between the deity of the house's sign (Ketu on sign 9) and the deity worshipped (Rahu, sign 3, Saraswati). On other signs the same mismatch logic means worshipping the wrong planet's deity activates the wrong planet; here Gemini and Sagittarius are an opposite pair, like the Rahu-Ketu axis.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Sagittarius on the 5th (lagna Leo); exam worship of Saraswati (Rahu) instead of Ganesh (Ketu) misfires on the paper.
Derived: Sagittarius on the 4th (lagna Virgo): home and basic schooling are Ganesh-governed, so Saraswati worship misfires in school exams.

ambiguity: He says 100% for the paper going wrong; no condition on Rahu strength is given.
classical_check: Classics do not forbid Saraswati worship for Sagittarius lagna houses; this is his own deity-matching rule.

gist: Analogy: paracetamol is very good for headaches but giving it for no reason loads the liver.
Analogy: Disprin is very good, but for body pain you need Combiflam; each medicine has its use.

hindi: दवाइया तो सारी अच्छी है देवता तो सारे अच्छे लेकिन आपको कौन सा चाहिए यही तो इष्ट का खेल है आपने गलत नेगेटिव देवता को पूज लिया
says: All medicines and all deities are good in themselves, but which one you need is the whole game of the ishta (personal deity); worshipping a deity wrong for your chart acts as a negative for you.
cells_derived_method: The correct ishta is chosen by the planet and sign in the relevant house; he links this to the previous deity-sign mapping (Rahu 3, Mercury 6, Ketu 9).
ambiguity: How the ishta is picked in general is not given here.
classical_check: Classics pick the ishta from the 5th house or the atmakaraka; he does not give a rule here.

gist: Story of a child asking permission to go out: mother will allow and even get money from father, but asking father directly earns a slap at 150 km per hour.
So you pick the right authority, the mother, who can persuade even the father; the joke leads into the right-deity point.

hindi: आप ऐसे ही अपना सही देवता पकड़ेंगे आप सरस्वती को यूं ही पूजने में लगे हुए बे फालतू के अंदर कोई सिर नहीं कोई पैर नहीं
says: In the same way, find your correct deity from the chart rather than worshipping Saraswati by habit, which he calls pointless, with no head or tail.
cells_derived_method: none; deity follows the chart (see the sign-deity mapping above).
classical_check: Silent.

gist: Mothers tell the child in the morning, my child, eat something sweet before you go; sets up the Mars example.

hindi: मंगल महाराज यहां पर या यहां पर खराब है नीच यहां से दृष्टि है कहीं से दृष्टि है नीच दृष्टि है मंगल का दोष है
says: Mars dosha is defined here: Mars is bad when it is placed in a bad house, is debilitated, or aspects or is aspected by a debilitated or afflicted planet; then the child has Mars dosha.
cells_derived_method: Debilitated Mars is in Cancer (sign 4). In each house Mars's debilitation hits a different topic: 1st body, 5th mind and study, 10th work.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Mars debilitated in Cancer in the 1st (lagna Cancer): low drive and unsteady energy for the native's own self.
Derived: Mars debilitated in Cancer in the 5th (lagna Pisces): study concentration and sports drive both weakened.
Derived: Mars debilitated in Cancer in the 10th (lagna Libra): career action weak or interrupted.

ambiguity: He points at unnamed houses on the board and says 'neech drishti'; reading as a debilitated Mars or its aspect.
classical_check: Debilitation as weakness is classical; the dosha language here is his.

hindi: आप मीठा पेल रहे हो मुंह के अंदर मंगल पेपर ही छूट जाएगा बच्चे का उसको दिखेगा ही नहीं आंखों के आगे
says: With Mars dosha, sweets given before an exam activate Mars and the child may leave out parts of the paper, not even seeing them in front of his eyes.
cells_derived_method: Sweet food as the activator of Mars is his mapping; the effect applies when Mars is afflicted, where its house decides the area (5th: exam concentration). Other houses with Mars afflicted would show the same activation in the topic of that house.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Mars debilitated in Cancer in the 5th (lagna Pisces): sweets before exams push the child to skip questions.
Derived: Mars debilitated in Cancer in the 4th (lagna Aries): sweets before school tests cause carelessness.

ambiguity: Sweet as the Mars substance is his claim; classics link sweet taste to Jupiter and Venus.
classical_check: Differs: sweet (madhura) is of Jupiter, Venus and Moon; Mars has pungent taste.

hindi: 12 एक्टिवेट करते ही पेट खराब हो जाएगा पेपर तो दे आएगा बच्चा पेट खराब हो जाएगा उसका यह गारंटी है
says: Drawback of the grey thread: activating sign 12 (Pisces, Ketu) will upset the child's stomach on the exam day; the child will still sit the paper but the stomach upset is guaranteed. This is his claim about a health effect, not a diagnosis.
cells_derived_method: The stomach effect depends on the house Pisces holds: it bites more where Pisces sits in a house connected with digestion or illness, and less elsewhere.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Pisces in the 12th house (lagna Aries), Ketu activation hits sleep and gut.

Derived: Pisces in the 4th house (lagna Sagittarius), the 4th is comfort and inner stomach, so it can also unsettle peace at home.

ambiguity: Caption 'एक दोती केतु' is garbled; read as 'activating 12, Ketu'. Whether the stomach effect is due to Ketu or the sign Pisces is not clear.
classical_check: Ketu is traditionally linked to stomach and intestinal trouble, so this agrees broadly; the guarantee is his own strong wording.

hindi: तो क्या करेंगे हम छह नंबर यहां लेफ्ट में ग्रे धागा डालेंगे
says: To avoid that stomach problem, use the sign 6 (Virgo) position instead: tie the grey thread on the left side.

Derived: Virgo as the 11th house (lagna Scorpio): grey thread shifts gains and network matters.

classical_check: Classical texts are silent on this; Virgo is the sign of the belly in kalapurusha so choosing it for stomach safety is only loosely supported.

hindi: चार नंबर यहां पर ग्रह धागा डालेंगे बाए पैर में भी डाल सकते हैं कहीं ना कहीं ये ग्रह ऐसे से काम कर लेगा
says: At the sign 4 (Cancer) position a grey thread can be used too, and it may be tied on the left leg as well; somewhere on that side it will do its job.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Cancer as the 4th house (lagna Aries): grey thread on left side works on home peace and inner comfort.

classical_check: Classical texts give no thread rules by body side.

hindi: एक नंबर एक नंबर यहां पर लाल धागा यदि डाल लिया तो चार नंबर पेट खराब कर देगा पेपर वाले दिन ही बच्चे के पेट की गुड़गुड़िया

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Aries in the lagna and Cancer in the 4th: red thread stirs Mars and the 4th house of stomach and comfort.

ambiguity: Link from sign 1 to sign 4 may be the Mars aspect or the 4th-from-it count or just that Cancer is the stomach sign; he does not say. The sentence runs into the next chunk.
classical_check: Aries rules the head and Cancer the chest or stomach in kalapurusha; Mars in Cancer being weak is classical, but the guaranteed exam-day effect is his own.

hindi: तीन नंबर हरा धागा ग्रीन राइट कलाई पर ग्रीन धागा आ जाएगा लेफ्ट पर भी जा सकता है

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Cancer as the 4th house (lagna Aries): red would unsettle peace of mind and study at home.

hindi: न्यूट्रल आप न्यूट्रल कलर वाइट ले सकते हैं वाइट डाल दो चंद्रमा का अपना घर है संभाल लेगा

ambiguity: It says 'यहां राइट पर' (here on the right); it is not clear whether this is the right biceps or a different spot. The sentence runs into the next chunk.
