hindi: लाल रंग यहां भी रॉकेट की तरह काम भी उठा देगा इसका शानदार तरीके से एकदम बढ़िया
says: Red colour here also shoots the person's work and career up like a rocket, in a splendid way.
cells_derived_method: Mars colour lifts action matters; in the 4th house it works first on home and property, later on work through the friend's sign Leo.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Mars in Leo in the 4th (lagna Taurus): red works well as the sign is the Sun's.
Derived: Leo in the 10th (lagna Scorpio): red boosts career directly.

ambiguity: 'काम भी उठा देगा' could mean work or the whole of life; 'यहां भी' links it to the previous Leo case.
classical_check: Mars as an energy giver is classical.

hindi: यहां लेते हैं हम तीन यहां आ गया छह ब्लू कलर आएगा ब्लैक भी आ सकता है दोनों लाजवाब है पढ़ाई भी लाजवाब पेट भी छाती भी लाजवाब प्रॉपर्टी जमीन जायदाद हर चीज लाजवाब
says: Case lagna sign 3 (Gemini), whose 4th house is sign 6 (Virgo): blue colour comes, black can also come, both are excellent, giving good study, stomach, chest and property.
cells_derived_method: Virgo's Saturn-friendly colours suit Mars in the 4th for Gemini lagna; for other houses Virgo holds, the same colours serve different life areas.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Mars in Virgo in the 4th (lagna Gemini): blue or black supports home, chest, property and study.
Derived: Mars in Virgo in the 10th (lagna Sagittarius): blue or black supports career and service.
Derived: Mars in Virgo in the lagna: blue or black strengthens the body and body energy.

ambiguity: 'तीन' is taken as lagna 3, which with Mars in the 4th gives sign 6; it is not stated by him as a house.
classical_check: Mars in Virgo is not especially favourable in classical texts; this claim is his own scheme.

hindi: चार है सात ब्लैक आएगा यहां पर ओनली ब्लैक इसको प्रोटेक्ट करने का रेमेडी अलग चलेगी
says: Case lagna sign 4 (Cancer), whose 4th house is sign 7 (Libra): only black comes here, and a separate remedy is needed to protect it.
cells_derived_method: Libra is Saturn's exaltation sign so black is the only colour that suits; the protection remedy depends on house.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Mars in Libra in the 4th (lagna Cancer): only black works and the chest is guarded separately.
Derived: Libra in the 7th (lagna Aries): black supports partnership.

ambiguity: Lagna 4 and sign 7 as 4th house is assumed from the sequence.
classical_check: Saturn is exalted in Libra, which agrees with black suiting Libra.

hindi: राइट पैर में इस बंदे के येलो धागा बांध दो ये यहां प्रोटेक्शन देगा पूर्ण रूप से छाती बच गई
says: Protection remedy for the sign 7 case: tie a yellow thread on the person's right leg; it fully protects and saves the chest.
cells_derived_method: Yellow is Jupiter, which guards the chest and heart, so the same thread could guard other houses by area.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: yellow thread on the right leg for lagna Cancer with Mars in the 4th: chest protected.
Derived: for Libra in the 5th (lagna Gemini) yellow would guard children and intelligence matters.

ambiguity: The caption start ('सा 8 न') is garbled. Claim of complete protection is his own and is not a medical statement.
classical_check: Jupiter as protector is classical; the right-leg thread is his own.

hindi: यहां काला टैटू प्रॉपर्टी का ढेर बनेगा मौज करेगा बंदा
says: A black tattoo here will build a heap of property and the person will enjoy life; this is a property prediction, not investment advice.
ambiguity: 'यहां' is read as the Libra case just discussed.
classical_check: Saturn favours property accumulation through hard work in some texts; the tattoo link is his own.

hindi: हम एलिमेंट्री सीख रहे हैं यहां सात नंबर अकेला कभी काम करेगा ही नहीं या छ और सात कर रहा है या छ सात या सात आठ
says: We are learning only the elementary level: sign 7 never works alone; it always works together with 6 and 7, or with 7 and 8, because each house holds two neighbouring signs.
cells_derived_method: Each house spans two signs, so a remedy for Libra also touches Virgo or Scorpio depending on the house cusp.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: for lagna Cancer the 4th house is Libra mixed with Virgo or Scorpio, so remedies need the second sign too.
Derived: Libra in the 8th (lagna Pisces) is shared with Virgo or Scorpio at the house edge.

ambiguity: 'सात नंबर' is read as sign 7. This is his multi-sign house idea.
classical_check: Bhava chalit shifts planets between houses, which agrees broadly; two signs per house is his own wording.

hindi: अभी इस कुंडली पर आएंगे हम पर एलिमेंट्री जानकारी एक राशि कभी भी काम नहीं करती
says: We will come back to this chart later, but the basic fact is that a single sign never works by itself in a house.
ambiguity: Repeats the previous multi-sign point as a principle; no specific cell.
classical_check: Houses holding two signs through bhava chalit supports this.

hindi: कस्प कुंडली वाले ही चलते हैं ऑलवेज लाइफ लॉन्ग
says: Only cusp-based charts work, and always for life: the house is judged by its cusp, which carries two signs.
ambiguity: 'कस्प कुंडली वाले ही चलते हैं' is read as 'only cusp charts work'; the caption is short.
classical_check: KP and bhava chalit use cusps, in agreement.

hindi: या आठ नंबर आ गया लाल चलेगा
says: Case lagna sign 5 (Leo), whose 4th house is sign 8 (Scorpio): red colour works.
cells_derived_method: Scorpio is Mars's own sign; the house changes the matter.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Mars in Scorpio in the 4th (lagna Leo): red supports home and property.
Derived: Mars in Scorpio in the 8th (lagna Aries): red works through stamina and research.

ambiguity: Sequence assumed from lagna 5 and Mars in 4th.
classical_check: Mars in own sign Scorpio is strong, so red agrees.

hindi: नौ नंबर आ गया ब्लू नहीं चलेगा आपका यहां ग्रीन चल सकता है ग्रीन कलर नौ नंबर में फर्स्ट क्लास है ब्लैक अच्छा है
says: Case lagna sign 6 (Virgo), whose 4th house is sign 9 (Sagittarius): blue will not work, green can work and is first class, and black is also good.
cells_derived_method: For Sagittarius the Mercury-green and Saturn-black colours serve different houses: 4th for home, 9th for fortune.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Mars in Sagittarius in the 4th (lagna Virgo): green works for home and property.
Derived: Sagittarius as the 9th house (lagna Aries): green would feed Mercury and not suit the Jupiter-ruled fortune house.

ambiguity: Number 9 is read from 'न नंबर' in the caption after the sequence.
classical_check: Mercury and Jupiter are neutral to each other, so green in Sagittarius is not a clear classical match.

hindi: 10 नंबर आ गया ब्लैक लाजवाब चलेगा ब्लैक एंड रेड ऐसा बंदा बना के देखो ब्लैक एंड रेड क्या रॉकेट की तरह जाएगा
says: Case lagna sign 7 (Libra), whose 4th house is sign 10 (Capricorn): black works superbly, and black and red together will make the person rise like a rocket.
cells_derived_method: Capricorn is Saturn's sign where Mars is exalted, so black and red are both natural; the house changes the area.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Mars exalted in Capricorn in the 4th (lagna Libra): black and red give strong home and property.
Derived: Mars exalted in Capricorn in the 10th (lagna Aries): black and red lift career strongly.

ambiguity: The 'rocket' is figurative.
classical_check: Mars is exalted in Capricorn, so red and black working here agrees.

hindi: रेड का फायदा क्या है चार नंबर है मंगल नीच नीच मंगल नीच बुध नीच बृहस्पति खुद को नष्ट नहीं करते यह भी पॉजिटिव ही है
says: The benefit of red: debilitated planets (Mars, Mercury, Jupiter) do not destroy themselves, so even a debilitated Mars placement is positive.
cells_derived_method: A debilitated planet harms its significations but does not destroy itself; the result depends on the house.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Mars debilitated in Cancer in the 4th (lagna Aries): the placement is damaged but self-preserving.
Derived: Mercury debilitated in Pisces in the 12th (lagna Aries): loses efficiency but the placement survives.

ambiguity: 'चार नंबर है' is read as Cancer; the claim about not destroying themselves is loose.
classical_check: Debilitation weakens the planet and neecha bhanga can raise it, so 'does not destroy itself' is his own framing.

hindi: 11 नंबर टैटू लाल टैटू ओनली रेड बहुत ऐड करना है ब्लू कर सकते हैं मेजर कलर्स यही यूज होंगे
says: Case lagna sign 8 (Scorpio), whose 4th house is sign 11 (Aquarius): a red tattoo, only red, adds a lot; blue can also be used, and these are the major colours used.
cells_derived_method: Aquarius is Saturn's sign; red feeds Mars and blue calms Saturn, with the house deciding the matter.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Mars in Aquarius in the 4th (lagna Scorpio): red is the main colour, blue second.
Derived: Mars in Aquarius in the 11th (lagna Aries): red works on gains.

ambiguity: 'ओनली रेड बहुत ऐड करना है' is partly garbled.
classical_check: Mars in Saturn's sign is not specially favourable; his scheme.

hindi: 12 नंबर आपका आ गया ब्लू कलर बड़े ध्यान से करना है
says: Case lagna sign 9 (Sagittarius), whose 4th house is sign 12 (Pisces): blue colour is used, and must be done very carefully.
cells_derived_method: Pisces is Jupiter's sign; blue works but needs care; the house decides the area.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Mars in Pisces in the 4th (lagna Sagittarius): blue supports home and property with caution.
Derived: Mars in Pisces in the 12th (lagna Aries): blue supports sleep and expense control.

ambiguity: Care needed is explained in the next sentence (skin tone).
classical_check: Silent.

gist: Practical tattoo note: we are brown-skinned, not white, so a good artist will keep blue looking blue, otherwise blue turns greenish on our skin; the sentence is cut off.

hindi: गया तो बंदे को फेफड़ों की प्रॉब्लम होएगी
says: Warning about the blue tattoo: if the blue turns greenish on the skin, Mercury gets activated in a Pisces 4th house and the person will have lung trouble. This is his tradition claim about a health effect, not a diagnosis.
cells_derived_method: Green is Mercury, which is debilitated in Pisces, so the penalty is worst when the blue remedy sits on a Pisces area; in a Mercury-friendly sign a greenish tinge would be milder.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Pisces in the 4th (lagna Sagittarius): greenish tattoo feeds a debilitated Mercury, so chest and lung trouble is the risk.
Derived: Pisces in the 6th (lagna Libra): the same tinge would show more as illness and daily-routine disturbance.

ambiguity: The sentence starts mid-way ('...गया तो'), which is the end of 'if it turns greenish'. That the case is the Pisces 4th house is inferred from the previous line (sign 12 and blue).
classical_check: Mercury debilitated in Pisces is classical; lungs and chest under Mercury is a loose tradition; the tattoo-tinge claim is his own.

hindi: बुध एक्टिवेट क्या करता है अस्थमेटिक प्रॉब्लम चेस्ट की प्रॉब्लम दांत खराब हड्डियां वीक मदर से रिलेशनशिप अपसेट प्रॉपर्टी में डिस्प्यूट्स और प्यार दोस्ती सब खत्म
says: What an activated Mercury does here: breathing and chest trouble, bad teeth, weak bones, upset relationship with the mother, property disputes, and love and friendship ending. These are tradition claims, not medical statements.
cells_derived_method: Mercury is weak in Pisces, so a Mercury activation in a Pisces 4th harms the 4th-house topics (chest, mother, home, property); in a Mercury-strong sign in the same house the same activation would be helpful.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Mercury debilitated in Pisces in the 4th (lagna Sagittarius): chest, mother and property matters suffer together.
Derived: Mercury exalted in Virgo in the 4th (lagna Gemini): the same activation would instead support home, property and mother.
Derived: Mercury in Pisces in the 7th (lagna Virgo): the friendship and love part of the list is the one most felt.

ambiguity: Which of the items belong to Mercury and which to the 4th house is not separated; the list mixes both.
classical_check: The 4th house covers chest, mother and property (classical); teeth and bones to Mercury is partly traditional; the list as a package is his own.

gist: Says this point is very important to watch and pay attention to.

hindi: यहां पर आप ब्लैक कर सकते हैं बहुत शानदार रहेगा
says: At this position you can use black and it will turn out very well.
ambiguity: 'यहां' is not tied to a sign or house; it follows the Pisces 12 case and may point to the next lagna in the sequence or to the body area.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: हर उपाय के साथ कुछ काउंटर रेमेडीज चलती हैं
says: With every remedy a few counter-remedies run along, meaning each remedy has a side effect that has to be balanced by a second measure.
ambiguity: None.
classical_check: Classical texts warn that an upaya for one planet can trouble another, so this is in line with tradition.

hindi: यह आपका टैटू करने से भी काम हो जाएगा बच्चे की पढ़ाई के लिए वहां भी हेल्पफुल हैम हो जाएगा
says: Getting the tattoo done will also serve the purpose and be helpful for the child's studies.
ambiguity: The end of the sentence ('हेल्पफुल हैम हो जाएगा') is garbled; the meaning that the tattoo helps study is a best reading.
classical_check: No classical basis for tattoos as remedy.

gist: Says the interview-related remedy for all this comes later and will need another class, with a joke about having to pay dakshina again and an apology.
Banter and a cheer ('long live Sani sahib') about the work being done; caption is partly garbled.
Many viewers are following the class, some do not understand, some are trying, some are getting a new jolt.
It all depends on the positioning of this house and that house in your chart and how quickly you grasp things (continues into the next chunk).
Some will be attracted, some will draw out the essence; viewers take different things from the class.
Our fight is not about what we eat or drink; a doctor's fight is only to fix all your organs so you become fully well (an analogy for what remedies aim at).

hindi: हमारा उद्देश्य यह है कि हम यहां पर जो ठीक कर सकते हैं वह सब ठीक कर दें तो जिंदगी ठीक हो जाएगी
says: The aim of this work is to repair everything that can be repaired in the chart's areas, and then life will be set right.
ambiguity: None.
classical_check: Silent; a general stance on remedies.

hindi: जितना यह अलाव करेंगे 12 प्र में जो अलाव होगा वही अलाव होगा एक लिमिट तक ही बॉडी लिवर किडनी और हार्ट को सेट कर सकते हैं पर वोह लिमिट में रहते हुए भी बहुत ज्यादा डैमेज कंट्रोल हो जाता है
says: Only as much improvement happens as the 12 planets allow; remedies can set the body, liver, kidney and heart only up to a limit, but even within that limit a great deal of damage control is achieved.
ambiguity: '12 प्र' is read as the 12 planets in his scheme; 'अलाव' is read as 'allow'.
classical_check: Classical texts say karma limits what upaya can change; this agrees broadly.

hindi: यहां पर भी हम जबरदस्त डैमेज कंट्रोल की बात कर रहे हैं आपकी पढ़ाई डैमेज नहीं होती आपका किरदार डैमेज हो जाता है
says: For the exam case too the goal is strong damage control: marks and study are not what gets damaged, it is the child's character and confidence that get damaged.
ambiguity: This is his view on exam stress and not a chart rule.
classical_check: Silent.

gist: Children are told that without education they are trash, so the child cannot bear bad time, cannot succeed and cannot feel happiness (parenting comment).
Says these situations are very complex and mentally very painful (end of the parenting comment).
How much you grasp depends on this and that; viewers are confused because different things are told at different times.

hindi: आपको पहले अपना बृहस्पति बुध शुक्र शनि कोई ना कोई ग्रह के डिस्टरबेंस करेक्ट करने की जरूरत है
says: Before anything else you must correct the disturbance of one of your own planets, whichever of Jupiter, Mercury, Venus or Saturn is troubled.
ambiguity: These four planets are probably those that govern thinking and understanding in his view; he does not say why only these four.
classical_check: Jupiter and Mercury as karakas of intellect and learning is classical; the specific list is his own.

hindi: आप क्या समझ रहे हैं उतना ही जितना ये अलाव कर रहे हैं इससे ज्यादा समझ नहीं सकते असंभव किसी हालत में समझ नहीं सकते
says: You can understand only as much as your planets allow; beyond that it is impossible to understand under any condition.
ambiguity: 'ये अलाव कर रहे हैं' means 'these planets permit'.
classical_check: Buddhi depending on Mercury and Jupiter is classical; the absolute 'impossible' is his emphasis.

hindi: तो करेक्शन क्या करो आप मत समझो यह ठीक करो
says: So the correction is: do not try to understand more, fix the troubled planet first.
ambiguity: 'यह' refers to the planetary disturbance mentioned just before.
classical_check: Silent.

gist: Tea analogy: if kidney, liver and stomach are fine, twenty teas cause no acidity; if not, one sip does, so the fault is the stomach and not the tea; a fit stomach digests anything.

hindi: आपके ग्रह ठीक है तो आपकी किस्मत मौज ले रही है आप जो कर्म करते हो ठप्पा लग जाता है
says: If your planets are in good order your fortune enjoys itself, and whatever action you do gets a stamp of success.
ambiguity: None.
classical_check: Agrees with the general idea that strong grahas give results from effort.

hindi: मिडास टच यार पत्थर को हाथ लगाया भाई सोना बन गया इस बंदे का आपके तुक्के भी फिट हर हालत में आपको लाइफ में सक्सेस मिलेगी
says: With strong planets one has the Midas touch: touch a stone and it becomes gold, even random guesses turn out right, and success comes in life in every situation.
ambiguity: A figurative statement; no specific placement named.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: ऐसे लोग जिनके अपने खुद ग्रहों की वीकनेस होती है लेकिन ग्रह उन्हे लाभ नहीं देने के लिए तैयार बैठे होते हैं यह लाभ का खाना है कि ग्रह वीक है लाभ देने के लिए नॉलेज के लिए बढ़िया
says: People whose own planets are weak and unwilling to give benefit have their gains house (11th) affected: the planet is too weak to give gains for themselves, but it is fine for giving knowledge to others.
cells_derived_method: The 11th house is gains; a weak planet there can still show good knowledge. The signs change which planet is weak: a debilitated planet in a gain sign gives knowledge without personal profit.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Aquarius in the 11th (lagna Aries): Saturn weak here gives good advice for others but personal gains are held back.
Derived: Virgo in the 11th (lagna Scorpio): Mercury's knowledge is good, but own gains are slow if Mercury is afflicted.

ambiguity: 'लाभ का खाना' (house of gains) is read as the 11th house, though it could simply mean 'the box of benefit'. The caption is rough.
classical_check: The 11th house is gains (classical); a weak planet giving knowledge but not income is his own reading.

hindi: ऐसे लोग दूसरे को कहते हैं ओ ये वाला शेयर खरीद लो जब वो खरीदता है रॉकेट और जब वो खुद खरीदते हैं लॉकेट किसी लायक नहीं कुछ भी नहीं खाली हो गए
says: Such people tell others to buy a certain share, and it turns into a rocket when the others buy; when they buy it themselves it becomes a locket, they lose everything and end up empty. This is an illustration only and is not investment advice.
ambiguity: A joke-like example; 'लॉकेट' is wordplay on rocket. It is not a chart rule on its own.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: आपकी कुंडली डिपेंड करके बताएगी आप राय देने लायक हैं लेने लायक हैं आप स्वयं को लाभ दे पा रहे हैं फिर आगे आप लाभ पहुंचा सकेंगे
says: Your chart will show whether you are fit to give advice or to receive it, whether you can benefit yourself, and only then can you go on to benefit others.
ambiguity: None.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: इसके लिए जरूरी है कि आप पर कृपा हो आपको सही डॉक्टर मिल जाए सही ज्योतिषी मिल जाए सही अध्यापक मिल जाए
says: For that to happen you need grace: meeting the right doctor, the right astrologer and the right teacher.
ambiguity: No planet or house is tied to the three guides.
classical_check: Silent; Jupiter as the karaka of gurus is classical but not named here.

hindi: यह सही वाले कुछ विशेष है कम है यह तभी मिलेंगे जब आपके जीवन के अंदर यह तीनों गतिमान होंगे
says: The right ones are special and few; they are met only when all three (doctor, astrologer, teacher) become active in your life.
ambiguity: The sentence runs into the next chunk, which says the condition is dropping ego.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: इन तीनों को गतिमान होने के लिए आपको बहुत जरूरी है कि आप ईगो ना रखें ईगो ना रखें मैं ना रखें
says: For these three to become active you must not keep ego; the 'I' must be dropped.
ambiguity: Behavioural advice rather than a chart rule; repeated for emphasis.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: सबसे बड़ी प्रॉब्लम आपका खुद पर भी काबू नहीं है किसी व्यक्ति की एक जन्मपत्रिका है और उसे रीड करने के तरीके हो गए हजार बथेरे
says: The biggest problem is that you lack control even over yourself: a person has one birth chart but there are a thousand different ways to read it.
ambiguity: The link between self-control and many reading methods is loosely drawn.
classical_check: Many dasha and chart systems exist in tradition; agrees that readings differ by method.

gist: Complains that astrologers each say different things and everyone runs his own Ramayana.

hindi: जब भी एक जन्मपत्री बनती है तो उस जन्मपत्री के अंतर्गत 30 30 डिग्री के 12 खाने बनाकर 360 डिग्री किया गया है
says: Every birth chart is made of 12 boxes of 30 degrees each, adding up to 360 degrees of the zodiac.
ambiguity: None.
classical_check: Agrees: 12 signs of 30 degrees make the 360 degree zodiac.

hindi: यह लगन कुंडली है तीन नंबर यह लगन कुंडली है किसी बंदे की मान लेते हैं इस व्यक्ति का तीन नंबर लगन है
says: He takes an example lagna chart of a person whose lagna is sign number 3 (Gemini).
ambiguity: 'तीन नंबर लगन' is read as lagna in sign 3, which he later calls a '3 degree' lagna, so sign 3 versus 3 degrees could be mixed.
classical_check: Silent; this is an illustration.

hindi: डिग्री का 15 मिनट बाद डिग्री जाएगी 20 मिनट बाद और बढ़ जाएगी 30 मिनट बाद दो घंटे तक यही लगन है
says: The ascending degree keeps advancing as minutes pass, but the same lagna sign stays on for about two hours.
ambiguity: The quoted minutes (15, 20, 30) are loose; the caption is garbled.
classical_check: A sign takes roughly two hours on average to rise (about 4 minutes per degree), so two hours is right, but his 15 to 20 minute steps per degree are not accurate.

hindi: 500 लोग पैदा हुए सबका यही रामायण है लाख पैदा हुए तब भी यही है तो कुंडली तो सेम ही हुई जीवन क्यों अलग-अलग है
says: If 500 people, or even a lakh, are born in that same lagna window they would all have the same chart, so why are their lives different? This is the problem he poses for the single-chart method.
ambiguity: Oversimplified because planets and degrees also differ within a lagna window, but he treats the chart as the same.
classical_check: The same-lagna problem is the classical reason for D9, D60 and finer divisions.

hindi: यह भाग्य के अलग-अलग प्लेटफॉर्म्स की वजह से
says: The lives differ because of different platforms of fortune, meaning additional charts layered over the main chart.
ambiguity: 'प्लेटफॉर्म्स' is not defined here; the next lines suggest it means other chart types.
classical_check: Agrees in spirit with using varga and cusp charts to separate same-lagna people.

gist: Lead-in: the point is about a 3 degree lagna, what a 3 degree lagna means, and now another chart comes whose name he cannot recall.
Joke on naming: calling it the BG chart would feed the ego since Brajesh Gautam puts his name on everything, and ego will come sooner or later.
Decides to name the chart after Munna Bhai, since in class he plays the Munna Bhai role.
Banter that the trick is Brajesh Gautam's 'bhaiya' has come into it, a cheeky aside.

hindi: तो मुन्ना भाई की एक कुंडली बनती है यह केपी कुंडली चलित कुंडली रण भाव सब कुंडलियों में एक और एडऑन कुंडली है एमबी कुंडली
says: The Munna Bhai (MB) chart is an add-on chart on top of all the others (KP, chalit chart and the bhava-type charts).
ambiguity: 'रण भाव' is garbled, probably a bhava chart such as Sripati; 'MB' stands for Munna Bhai, a joke name for his own invention.
classical_check: MB chart is not a classical chart; KP and chalit are classical or semi-classical.

hindi: मुन्ना भाई की कुंडली क्या कहती है कि जब ये 3 डिग्री का लगन है तो यहां पर सायन कुंडली बनती है एक सायन बनती
says: The Munna Bhai chart says that when the lagna is at 3 degrees, a sayana (tropical) chart is drawn here, one sayana chart being made (the sentence is cut off).
ambiguity: The sentence is incomplete at the end of the chunk. '3 डिग्री' versus 'sign 3' is unclear.
classical_check: Vedic practice uses the sidereal (nirayana) zodiac; the project default is Lahiri, so a sayana layer differs from the usual and needs checking when it is explained.

hindi: चलित बनती है निर भाव केपी यानी कि धरती और अंतरिक्ष में ग्रह घूम रहे हैं वो यह कुंडली है
says: Besides the main chart, other charts are made (chalit, a nir-bhava chart, KP), because planets keep moving in earth and space, and each of these charts records that movement differently.
ambiguity: The sentence starts mid-way and 'निर भाव' is garbled, possibly a Sripati or another bhava-type chart; the exact meaning of nir-bhava is not given here.
classical_check: Bhava chalit and KP are recognised cusp-based systems; nir-bhava is not a standard term, so it is his usage or a caption error.

hindi: धरती के परिप्रेक्ष्य में ग्रह कहां बैठे हैं यह चलित है ग्रहों के अनुसार हमारी धरती कहां है यह निर् भाव है
says: The chalit chart shows where the planets sit as seen from the earth; the nir-bhava chart shows where the earth sits as seen from the planets.
ambiguity: His 'where is the earth according to the planets' sounds like a heliocentric view; not a standard definition of any named chart.
classical_check: Chalit is not defined classically as a geocentric versus heliocentric split; it is a cusp-based house shift. This definition is his own.

hindi: यह कई किस्म की कुंडलियां बनती हैं तो ग्रह क्या कर रहे हैं खिसक रहे हैं आगे पीछे आगे पीछे खिसक रहे हैं राशियां खिसक रही हैं
says: Many kinds of charts result from this, and in them the planets and the signs slide one step forward or backward, so the position seen in the main chart is not fixed.
ambiguity: None.
classical_check: Planets moving to the previous or next house in bhava chalit is classical; signs sliding is his own wording.

hindi: जब तीन नंबर है तो 3 डिग्री का लगन है ये 3 डिग्री के लगन में दो नंबर की कुंडली काम कर रही है
says: When the lagna is sign 3 (Gemini) at only 3 degrees, the chart of lagna sign 2 (Taurus) is also working along with it.
cells_derived_method: A lagna near the start of its sign also runs the previous sign's chart, a lagna near the end runs the next sign's chart, and so each house of the chart is the sum of two neighbouring lagnas.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Leo lagna at about 3 degrees would also run the Cancer lagna chart.
Derived: Aries lagna at about 3 degrees would also run the Pisces lagna chart, wrapping back past the first sign.
Derived: Scorpio lagna at about 28 degrees would also run the Sagittarius lagna chart, the next sign.

ambiguity: '3 डिग्री का लगन' is read as the ascendant at about 3 degrees of the sign; 'तीन नंबर' is sign 3.
classical_check: Classical lagna sandhi treats a lagna within a few degrees of a sign boundary as unstable, which supports the idea, but running two full charts is his own.

hindi: यह लगन अभी अभी एंटर हुआ है ये दो नंबर की कुंडली थी दो नंबर खिसक करके गया और तीन नंबर इतना सा एंटर किया है 3 डिग्री एंटर है तीन नंबर तीन नंबर का मिथुन इतना सा एंटर हुआ
says: The lagna has only just entered Gemini: until a moment ago it was the sign 2 chart, sign 2 has slid away and Gemini has entered by just 3 degrees.
ambiguity: None; this repeats and illustrates the previous rule with a hand sketch.
classical_check: Silent; this illustration is his own.

hindi: 3 डिग्री तो काउंट हमने इसको कर लिया तीन नंबर ही लगन है जबकि इसमें अभी 27 डिग्री 27 नहीं होता है क्योंकि 30 डिग्री की कोई भी लगन या कोई भी खाना नहीं होता एग्जैक्ट नहीं होता
says: We counted it as lagna 3 although sign 2 still has about 27 degrees; even that is not exactly 27, because no lagna or box is exactly 30 degrees.
ambiguity: The sentence continues into the next chunk with the reason ('because the earth goes in an oval').
classical_check: A sidereal sign is exactly 30 degrees; the ascendant takes unequal time per sign, which is probably what he means, so 'not exactly 30' is true for rising times and wrong for the zodiac.

hindi: धरती गोल में नहीं घूमती वो अंडाकार घूमती है तभी मौसम बदलते हैं और टेढ़ी चलती है
says: His reason: the earth does not go round in a circle but in an oval and tilted path, which is why the seasons change, so the 12 boxes cannot be exactly 30 degrees each.
ambiguity: Seasons change because of the axial tilt, not because the orbit is an ellipse; he mixes the two.
classical_check: The tilt and ellipse do make house sizes unequal in the Placidus-type systems, but sidereal signs remain 30 degrees each, so his reason is only partly correct.

hindi: 27 डिग्री कहने को तो दो नंबर भी यह एक्टिवेटेड है यहां दो नंबर चल रहा है
says: So sign 2 with its remaining roughly 27 degrees is also activated here; the sign 2 chart is running as well.
ambiguity: The caption is clipped; it repeats the idea that two lagnas are active together.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: ये लगन तीन नंबर 3 डिग्री का नहीं है यह लगन मान लो 11 डिग्री का है तीन नंबर का यहां क्या लफड़ा होगा दो नंबर भी है तीन भी है और चार भी है यहां दो भी काम करेगी राशि तीन भी करेगी और चार भी
says: If the sign 3 lagna is at 11 degrees instead, three signs work together: sign 2 (Taurus), sign 3 (Gemini) and sign 4 (Cancer), so each of them contributes to the lagna.
cells_derived_method: A mid-sign lagna draws in both neighbours; the same logic applies to other lagnas, with the neighbours changing with the sign.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Leo lagna at about 11 degrees would blend Cancer, Leo and Virgo lagna readings.
Derived: Pisces lagna at about 11 degrees would blend Aquarius, Pisces and Aries lagna readings.

ambiguity: Why an 11 degree lagna reaches a full next sign (Cancer) is not explained; in a normal chalit it would reach back to Taurus only.
classical_check: In an equal-house chalit a lagna at 11 degrees of Gemini spans late Taurus to late Gemini, not Cancer, so including sign 4 differs from the classical treatment.

hindi: यह हो गए मुन्ना भाई की कुंडलियां अब मुन्ना भाई की तीन कुंडलियां है वैसे मुन्ना भाई की दो कुंडली तो चलेगी कुछ भी कर लो सिंगल लगन तो चलता ही नहीं असंभव
says: These are the Munna Bhai charts: there are three of them, and whatever you do at least two lagna charts will always run; a single lagna working alone is impossible.
ambiguity: 'तीन कुंडलियां' (three charts) is taken as lagna 2, 3 and 4 in the 11 degree case; two is the minimum.
classical_check: Houses sharing signs in bhava chalit supports the idea that a single sign never carries a house alone; MB charts themselves are his own.

hindi: चलित और निर भाव में भी या केपी कुंडली में भी आपका एक बार राशि या सिंगल एक ग्रह आगे पीछे खिसक जाता है
says: In the chalit, nir-bhava and KP charts as well, a sign or even a single planet can slide one step forward or backward from where the main chart shows it.
ambiguity: None.
classical_check: Planets shifting house in chalit is classical; a whole sign sliding is his own wording.

hindi: हमने देखा लगन में तीन नंबर है चार बृहस्पति और केतु है बुध है यहां चंद्रमा आ गया शुक्र नीच है बुध उच्च है सूर्य है प्लूटो है नेप्चून फलाना डिमका सारे आ गए
says: The example chart: lagna is sign 3 (Gemini); Jupiter and Ketu are in sign 4 (Cancer); Mercury is exalted and Venus debilitated (both only possible in Virgo); the Sun, Moon, Pluto, Neptune and the rest are all placed.
ambiguity: Only Jupiter and Ketu in sign 4 are placed explicitly; Venus and Mercury being in Virgo follows from the dignity words. The Moon, Sun, Pluto and Neptune signs are not stated in this sentence.
classical_check: Silent; Jupiter in Cancer is exalted, which he does not mention here.

hindi: अब हमारी ले रही है 2 बती कुंडली अब हम दो नंबर से पूरी कुंडली भी ऐड करेंगे देखने के लिए
says: Now the sign 2 lagna chart is taken up, and the full chart starting from sign 2 will also be added so that both can be viewed together.
ambiguity: '2 बती कुंडली' is garbled; read as the sign 2 chart.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: मुन्ना भाई की कुंडली क्या कहती है कि इसमें दो नंबर भी है यहां तीन है चार है पांच छ सात 89 10 11 12 एक
says: The MB chart says the chart now contains sign 2 as well, followed by signs 3, 4, 5 up to 12 and 1, that is two lagna wheels laid over each other, one starting at sign 2 and one at sign 3.
ambiguity: He is reading numbers off a drawn chart; it is a listing of the second wheel.
classical_check: Silent; this overlay is his own.

hindi: दो नंबर का मंगल कहता है गजब का कर्जा लेगा आदमी
says: Read through the sign 2 lagna, Mars (sitting in Aries, sign 1, the 12th from that lagna) says the man will take an enormous loan.
cells_derived_method: Mars in the 12th is expense and debt; in its own sign Aries it acts with force, and in other signs the same house would show a different type of outflow.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Mars in its own sign Aries in the 12th (lagna Taurus): big expenses and borrowing.
Derived: Mars in Aries in the 6th (lagna Scorpio): debts handled with fighting energy and often cleared.
Derived: Mars in Aries in the 11th (lagna Gemini): borrowing helps income instead of harming it.

ambiguity: 'दो नंबर का मंगल' could be Mars in sign 2 or Mars seen from the sign 2 lagna; the following lines show he means the sign 1 Mars, which is the 12th from lagna 2.
classical_check: Mars in the 12th is traditionally expense and loss; the loan reading is his own.

hindi: एक नंबर का मंगल भी काम कर रहा है कितना कर रहा है ज्यादा कर रहा है क्योंकि 27 डिग्री 27 नहीं है समझाने के लिए मात्र 27 डिग्री का दो नंबर था तीन नंबर लगन सिर्फ 3 डिग्री है
says: The sign 1 Mars is also working, and working more, because the sign 2 lagna covers about 27 degrees (this number is only for explaining) while the Gemini lagna is only 3 degrees.
cells_derived_method: The heavier lagna gets the larger weight, so the house position of Mars is read mostly from the lagna that holds more degrees.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Mars in Aries as the 12th (lagna Taurus, the heavier 27 degree chart): its loan and expense reading gets the larger weight.
Derived: Mars in Aries as the 11th (lagna Gemini, only 3 degrees): its gains reading gets the smaller weight.

ambiguity: He says 27 degrees only to explain, and says 27 is not exact; 'ज्यादा कर रहा है' (works more) is read as a weight, not a measured number.
classical_check: Silent on weighting two lagnas.

hindi: यह मंगल जो सत्यानाश करना चाहिए था ये एक नंबर का है इस बंदे को कर्जा लेना ही चाहिए कर्जा लेते ही इसके पैसे अरेंज हो जाएंगे क्योंकि मंगल एक नंबर का कहता है अपने घर मैं कर्जा अरेंज करा के दूंगा
says: This Mars, which should have ruined him, is a sign 1 Mars (its own sign); so this person should take a loan, and the money will be arranged as soon as he does, because Mars in its own house says it will arrange the loan. This is a claim about borrowing and not financial advice.
cells_derived_method: Mars in own sign Aries can turn a 12th house debt into support; in a non-own sign the same debt would carry more trouble.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Mars in Aries in the 12th (lagna Taurus): borrowing gets arranged easily but expenses rise.
Derived: Mars in Aries in the 8th (lagna Virgo): borrowing arrives through sudden or hidden channels.

ambiguity: Whether this holds only in this one chart is not said; it is a worked example.
classical_check: A planet in its own sign supporting its house matters is classical; the loan reading is his own and not general advice.

hindi: जहां इसने कर्जा लिया जो मर्जी बना लो 10 लाख रप हाथ में है एक करोड़ की प्रॉपर्टी ले रहा है कर्जा ले ले 90 लाख
says: As an illustration he says: with 10 lakh rupees in hand and a one crore property being bought, such a person can simply take a 90 lakh loan. This is an example of how he reads the chart and is not investment advice.
ambiguity: The example is spoken casually; the instruction applies only to a Mars-in-Aries case and carries financial risk.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: पागल ही होते हैं जो ऐसा करते हैं इतना बड़ा पागल चाहिए हमें अगर वो डरे जा रहा है मरे जा रहा है तो फिर मरो और नहीं तो ये मंगल को पावर दो
says: Only bold, almost mad people do such a thing and that is the kind needed; if he keeps fearing, then he suffers, otherwise he should give power to Mars.
ambiguity: The 'give power to Mars' remedy is not specified here; the next line links it to the navel.
classical_check: Strengthening Mars for courage is traditional.

hindi: मंगल की पावर किसम मंगल नाभी कॉन्शसनेस है हनुमान कॉन्शसनेस ये नाभी पे होता है
says: Mars power means Mars consciousness, which is navel consciousness, Hanuman consciousness, located at the navel.
ambiguity: 'किसम' is garbled, and the navel centre is read as the body seat of Mars.
classical_check: Mars and Hanuman worship is traditional; the navel link matches the fire centre in yogic tradition, not a classical graha text.

hindi: भाड़ में जाए किस्ते कौन देगा भाड़ में जाए सब अरेंज हो जाए
says: The attitude of Mars consciousness is reckless confidence: who will pay the instalments, forget it, everything will get arranged.
ambiguity: The lead-in 'क्या शब्द है इसका' (what is the word for it) shows he is hunting for a word.
classical_check: Mars as the planet of boldness is classical.

hindi: भगवान ने रोटी से कमी कभी छोड़ी नहीं और रोटी से ऊपर उठने नहीं दिया लेकिन मकान भी बन गया गाड़ी भी बन गई सब हो गया
says: Such people say God never let them lack bread and never let them rise above bread; the house and the car got made and everything was done, but they stayed at the level of meeting their needs. A strong Mars says it will fulfil all your expenses and you should not worry.
ambiguity: This is his description of a type of person under strong Mars, not a placement.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: अब यहां पर इसका दो नंबर का लगन तीन केतु नीच हो गया रिश्तों से कंगाल राहु नीच हो गया ससुराल की ओर से भी झगड़े झंझट
says: In the sign 2 lagna version, Ketu in sign 3 is debilitated, leaving the person poor in relationships, and Rahu (opposite, in sign 9) is debilitated too, bringing quarrels and trouble from the in-laws side.
cells_derived_method: The Ketu-Rahu axis in Gemini and Sagittarius falls in different houses as the lagna changes; the relation topics move with it.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Ketu debilitated in Gemini in the 2nd (lagna Taurus): empty family and speech relationships.
Derived: Rahu debilitated in Sagittarius in the 8th (lagna Taurus): hidden friction with in-laws.
Derived: Ketu debilitated in Gemini in the 7th (lagna Sagittarius): marital partnership feels empty.

ambiguity: Which houses he means is inferred from the sign 2 lagna; he says only sign numbers.
classical_check: Ketu debilitated in Gemini and Rahu in Sagittarius is one school's view; others reverse it, so the dignity claims are not universal.

hindi: लड़का चाहे लड़की है कलेश रहेंगे
says: Whether the child is a boy or a girl, there will be conflicts with the child.
ambiguity: The cause is not named in this sentence; it seems linked to the debilitated Ketu and Rahu just before.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: छह नंबर का था लड़की होती तो इसको हार्मोनल इंबैलेंस होते सूर्य पावर पकड़ के बैठ गया कोई हार्मोनल इंबैलेंस नहीं होगा भले ही शुक्र नीच का है कुछ ना होगा
says: Because of the sign 6 placement, a daughter would have had hormonal imbalance (Venus is debilitated in Virgo), but the Sun has taken power, so no hormonal imbalance will occur. This is his tradition claim and not a medical statement.
cells_derived_method: Venus debilitated in Virgo hits the reproductive side wherever it falls; the Sun's strength offsets it, and the house changes the area stressed.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Venus debilitated in Virgo in the 5th (lagna Taurus): the daughter's cycle and children matters carry the stress.
Derived: Venus debilitated in Virgo in the 4th (lagna Gemini): the stress shows more at home and in comfort.

ambiguity: Whether the Sun is in sign 5 or another sign here is not stated in this sentence; the next chunk puts it in sign 5.
classical_check: Venus governs reproductive matters in tradition and is debilitated in Virgo; a Sun offsetting it is his own reading.

hindi: पढ़ाई में फेलियर देता है
says: A debilitated Venus gives failure in studies for a year.
cells_derived_method: The education house for each lagna decides whether the failure is felt as study trouble or in another area.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Venus debilitated in Virgo in the 4th (lagna Gemini): trouble in schooling and basic education.
Derived: Venus debilitated in Virgo in the 5th (lagna Taurus): trouble with intelligence and higher study.

ambiguity: 'एक साल' (one year) comes from the next chunk, saying the failure lasts one year.
classical_check: Silent on year-specific study failure.

hindi: एक साल बुध कहता है फेल नहीं होने दूंगा शुक्र कह रहा है फेल करूंगा बुध उच्च हो गया शुक्र नीच हो गया
says: For one year, Mercury says it will not let the child fail while Venus says it will; Mercury is exalted and Venus debilitated, so they pull in opposite directions.
cells_derived_method: Both planets in Virgo give a conflict; whether Mercury wins depends on the house and on the degrees.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Mercury exalted and Venus debilitated in Virgo in the 4th (lagna Gemini): Mercury as lagna lord supports schooling but Venus drags it.
Derived: Mercury exalted and Venus debilitated in Virgo in the 10th (lagna Sagittarius): the clash shows in career instead of study.

ambiguity: Sign 6 is inferred from Mercury exalted and Venus debilitated together, since he does not say the sign number in this sentence.
classical_check: Mercury exalted and Venus debilitated in Virgo is classical; the study result is his own.

hindi: अब क्या काम करेगा सूर्य साथ में काम करेगा इनकी डिग्री इनकी भी डिग्रीज होती है
says: What will decide it? The Sun works along with them, and the degrees of each planet also matter in who wins.
ambiguity: None.
classical_check: Planetary degrees affecting strength is classical.

gist: Remarks that astrology is very complicated and heavy.

hindi: सूर्य पांच नंबर यानी कि इसको गैप देगा झटका एक पेपर रिपीट हो जाएगा कंपार्टमेंट आएगी छूटेगी और फिर निकल जाएगा क्लियर हो जाएगा
says: The Sun in sign 5 (Leo) will give a gap or jolt: one paper will be repeated, a compartment comes and is missed, but later it will be cleared.
cells_derived_method: The Sun in Leo delays but clears study results; which house Leo holds sets the area of the delay.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Sun in Leo in the 3rd (lagna Gemini): the delay comes through effort and exam stamina.
Derived: Sun in Leo in the 4th (lagna Taurus): the delay touches schooling and home study.
Derived: Sun in Leo in the 5th (lagna Aries): the jolt shows through intelligence and exams directly.

ambiguity: 'क्योंकि यह भी काम करेगा' (because this also works) refers to the Sun's effect.
classical_check: Sun in its own sign Leo is strong, so delay with eventual clearing is plausible; the compartment detail is his own.

hindi: छह नंबर का प्लूटो सात नंबर उच्च था संतान गजब की होगी धर्मराज इस बच्चे की जो संतान होगी ऐसी होगी जो धर्म स्थापित करेगा
says: Pluto (Yama, Dharmaraj) in sign 6 and exalted in sign 7 gives wonderful children: this child's own children will establish dharma.
cells_derived_method: Pluto exalted in Libra and sitting in the 5th gives dharmic children; in other houses the same Pluto would give strictness in that house's area.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Pluto exalted in Libra in the 5th (lagna Gemini): children who uphold justice and dharma.
Derived: Pluto in Virgo in the 5th (lagna Taurus): children who are exacting and dutiful.
Derived: Pluto exalted in Libra in the 9th (lagna Aquarius): dharma shows in the person's own fortune and beliefs.

ambiguity: 'सात नंबर उच्च था' is read as Pluto exalted in Libra; houses are inferred as 5th in both lagna 2 and lagna 3.
classical_check: Pluto is not part of classical Jyotish; the exaltation of Pluto in Libra is his scheme.

hindi: जेनुइन बात करेगा बच्चा इतनी लाजवाब और जेनुइन बात करेगा पूछो नहीं अत्याचार अन्याय नहीं सहेगा इसका बच्चा ही ऐसा होगा यही स्पर्म इसका फ्रूट फ्रूट देगा
says: The child will speak genuinely and superbly, will not tolerate oppression or injustice, and the child's nature will be like this because the lineage itself bears this fruit.
ambiguity: 'स्पर्म फ्रूट फ्रूट' is garbled; read as the seed producing fruit.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: सात नंबर आठ शनि नौ नंबर का लाजवाब था कायदे से नेप्चून नौ नंबर का लाजवाब था कायदे से लेकिन य नेप्चून आठ का भी काम कर रहा है
says: By the book Neptune in sign 9 (Sagittarius) is excellent, but in the MB chart this Neptune is also working as sign 8 (Scorpio), the neighbouring sign.
cells_derived_method: Neptune's good sign gets mixed with its neighbour, so Neptune's marriage effects change by lagna.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Neptune in Sagittarius in the 7th (lagna Gemini): spouse and partnership under a Neptune sign.
Derived: Neptune also in Scorpio in the 7th (lagna Taurus): the same partnership house gets a Scorpio colouring.

ambiguity: The first words 'सात नंबर आठ शनि' are garbled and may place Saturn too; only Neptune is clear.
classical_check: Neptune is not part of classical Jyotish, so this is his scheme.

hindi: कोई बड़ी बात नहीं है एक तलाक हो जाए और वो दिख नहीं रहा कुंडली में कहीं ये दिख नहीं रहा लेकिन आठ नंबर की राशि मुन्ना भाई की एक्टिवेटेड है नेप्चून तलाक करा के छोड़ेगा
says: A divorce can happen even though it is not visible anywhere in the normal chart, because in the Munna Bhai chart the sign 8 area is activated and Neptune will bring about a divorce. This is his tradition claim about marriage and not a diagnosis.
ambiguity: The sentence runs into the next chunk and continues with other outcomes if no divorce happens.
classical_check: Silent; Neptune is not classical.

hindi: मान लो तलाक नहीं हो रहा बाहर रिलेशन कराएगा पति है या पत्नी है उसकी कुंडली में नहीं है और उसने मान लिया बच्चों की खातिर तलाक नहीं देना तू अपना जीवन जी मैं अपना जिऊं
says: If the divorce does not happen, Neptune will cause an outside relationship, whether the person is the husband or the wife, even when it is not in the spouse's chart; the couple may agree not to divorce for the children and live separate lives.
ambiguity: Applies to either gender, and to the person with this placement even if the spouse's chart shows nothing.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: कौन सा होएगा इलिसिट सेक्सुअल यह भटका के ही छोड़ेगा करना ही पड़ेगा
says: The kind of outside relationship will be illicit and sexual; Neptune will lead the person astray and it will have to happen.
ambiguity: Strong deterministic wording; no probability given.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: इनको क्या करना चाहिए शादी वाली शादी नहीं करनी चाहिए
says: Remedy advice: such people should not enter a formal marriage, since the Neptune placement will break it.
ambiguity: 'शादी वाली शादी' is read as a formal wedding as opposed to a live-in arrangement; he comments on live-in next.
classical_check: Classical texts do not advise avoiding marriage on this basis.

gist: Social commentary on live-in relationships being promoted: 36,000 couples in Uttarakhand registered as live-in, and it has been made legal.

hindi: यह नौ नंबर यह पैर है एक पैर में चोट आएगी इस बंदे को दिखने को दिख नहीं रहा यहां पर लेकिन नौ नंबर एक्टिवेटेड मुन्ना भाई की कुंडली कहती है एक टांग तोडूंगी
says: Sign 9 (Sagittarius) is the leg (thigh) area; this person will get an injury in one leg although it is not visible in the normal chart, because sign 9 is activated in the Munna Bhai chart. This is a tradition claim about a body injury and not a medical diagnosis.
cells_derived_method: Sagittarius rules the thighs; which house it falls in changes the life area attached to the injury.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Sagittarius in the 7th (lagna Gemini): a leg injury touches partnership and travel with the spouse.
Derived: Sagittarius in the 12th (lagna Capricorn): the leg injury links with hospital, loss and foreign stay.
Derived: Sagittarius lagna: the leg trouble is felt in the body itself.

ambiguity: Which planet in sign 9 causes it is not stated; Neptune is the sign 9 planet in this example.
classical_check: Sagittarius as the thighs in kalapurusha is classical; the broken-leg claim is his own.

gist: Emphasis that the leg injury will definitely come, then a garbled run of numbers (10, 11, 12) with no clear statement.

hindi: गई कुंडली यह दो नंबर के हिसाब से मुन्ना भाई की कुंडली हो गई
says: That completes the Munna Bhai (MB) chart worked out from the sign 2 lagna side for this example person.
ambiguity: The sentence starts mid-way (the first word is the tail of the previous sentence).
classical_check: MB chart is not classical; it is his own overlay method.

hindi: अब यहां पर हमने देखा के इसी बंदे का कृष्ण मूर्ति पद्धति ग्रहों के परिपेक्ष में धरती पर ग्रहों की एक्चुअल पोजीशन क्या है तो यहां यही थी कुंडली
says: Now the same person's KP (Krishnamurti Paddhati) chart is looked at, which he describes as showing the actual position of the planets relative to the earth; this is that chart.
ambiguity: His description of KP as 'actual position' is loose; KP is a cusp-and-sub-lord system, not a different astronomy.
classical_check: KP uses the sidereal planets with its own house cusps (Placidus), not a different planetary position, so his description differs from standard KP.

hindi: अभी हम मुन्ना भाई का लगन नहीं ले रहे यह सूर्य बुध मंग शुक्र साथ है
says: We are not taking the MB lagna overlay at this moment; in this KP chart the Sun, Mercury, Venus (and apparently Mars) are together in one sign.
cells_derived_method: A Sun-Mercury-Venus group in Virgo moves into a different house for each lagna, so what it shows (study, marriage, career) changes.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: the group in Virgo in the 4th (lagna Gemini): home, mother and schooling carry the combined influence.
Derived: the group in Virgo in the 7th (lagna Pisces): partnership and marriage carry the combined influence.
Derived: the group in Virgo in the 10th (lagna Sagittarius): career carries the combined influence.

ambiguity: 'मंग' is a cut-off word, probably Mars (Mangal); later lines name only Sun, Mercury and Venus together. Virgo is inferred from Mercury exalted and Venus debilitated in the earlier lines.
classical_check: A Sun-Mercury-Venus conjunction is a recognised combination; Mars being part of it is uncertain.

hindi: वैसे यह कुंडली वह है शक वाली हस्बैंड वाइफ एक दूसरे के चरित्र पे शक करेंगे
says: This chart is of the suspicious type: husband and wife will doubt each other's character.
ambiguity: The planets or placements that cause the suspicion are not named in this sentence.
classical_check: Silent.

gist: Joke: tell whoever owns this chart that it is a lie, the chart was drawn at random, sir.
More banter: we escaped, or stones would have been thrown; if it were the male chart the wife would be ready with a stick; questions about how he knows and why he never tells about himself in class.

hindi: अब यहां देखेंगे आप सूर्य और शुक्र यह इस घर में काम ही नहीं कर रहे हैं यह तो लगन है लगन मीन स्टार्टिंग
says: In this house the Sun and Venus are not working at all; this is the lagna chart, and lagna only means the starting point.
ambiguity: 'इस घर में' is not located; it appears to be the first house in the plain lagna chart.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: भैया 10 लाख लोग पैदा हुए 10 लाख की यही रामायण है अब स्टार्टिंग के बाद उस बंदे की क्या रमायण है उसका केपी कुंडली कहती है
says: One million people share the same starting lagna chart; what differs after the start is each person's own story, which the KP chart tells.
ambiguity: None.
classical_check: The same-lagna problem is classical; resolving it by KP is his and KP's approach.

hindi: सूर्य और शुक्र ये काम ही नहीं करेंगे सूर्य शुक्र यहां काम करेंगे जैसे ही यह बंदा हायर स्टडीज में जाएगा फेल
says: The KP chart says the Sun and Venus will not work at the start, but they start working here as soon as the person goes into higher studies, and the result is failure.
cells_derived_method: Which house holds the Sun and Venus decides the area that starts failing; in the study houses it is exams, elsewhere it is something else.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Sun and Venus in Virgo in the 4th (lagna Gemini): failure in formal education.
Derived: Sun and Venus in Virgo in the 5th (lagna Taurus): failure in higher study and intelligence-based work.

ambiguity: No timing in years is given, only 'when he enters higher studies'.
classical_check: Silent.

gist: Look at the further complication, how much your head will spin; everyone says confusion; he says the confusion is only for lack of knowledge.

hindi: तीन नंबर लगन के बाद तीन दोबारा आ गया ये तो सीधी कुंडली है शरीफ यह तीन के बाद फिर तीन ही है यहां भी यह प्रमुख तौर पर कहता है तीन ही नंबर काम करूंगा
says: In this KP chart the lagna is again sign 3 right after the lagna chart's sign 3, a simple well-behaved chart; here too sign 3 is the main one that will work.
ambiguity: The listing 'after 3 comes 4, 5, 6...' is garbled; only that sign 3 repeats is clear.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: बृहस्पति केतु विपरीत गज केसरी नेगेटिव सत्यानाश सड़क पर बिठा देगा इसको रिश्तों को लेकर कंगाल है आदमी घर में बनती पड़ती नहीं किसी से
says: Jupiter with Ketu makes a reversed or negative Gajakesari yoga: it will ruin him and put him on the road; he is poor in relationships and gets along with no one at home.
cells_derived_method: Jupiter-Ketu together gives a reversed Gajakesari in whichever house they share; in Cancer Jupiter is exalted so the loss is not total, and the house decides which area suffers.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Jupiter exalted with Ketu in Cancer in the 2nd (lagna Gemini): family, speech and savings are hit.
Derived: Jupiter exalted with Ketu in Cancer in the 9th (lagna Scorpio): fortune and dharma are hit.
Derived: Jupiter exalted with Ketu in Cancer in the 5th (lagna Pisces): children and learning are hit.

ambiguity: Cancer and the 2nd house are inferred from the example chart (lagna 3, Jupiter and Ketu in sign 4); he says only Jupiter-Ketu.
classical_check: Jupiter-Ketu conjunction is known as a spiritual but troublesome pairing; calling it a reversed Gajakesari is his own term.

hindi: चंद्रमा मन का साफ है रिश्तेदार कमीने है यह ठीक है बंदा लेकिन चंद्रमा बुझा हुआ तीसरे घर का
says: The Moon gives a clean-hearted person while the relatives are mean; the person is fine but the Moon in the 3rd house is dull, as if extinguished.
cells_derived_method: A Moon in the 3rd gives a mild, low-energy mind; its sign changes this: own sign Cancer keeps it warm, debilitation in Scorpio makes it weaker.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Moon in Leo in the 3rd (lagna Gemini): kind but dull and low in courage, with unkind relatives.
Derived: Moon in its own sign Cancer in the 3rd (lagna Taurus): the mind is warmer and the dullness is less.
Derived: Moon debilitated in Scorpio in the 3rd (lagna Virgo): dull and anxious in effort.

ambiguity: 'बुझा हुआ' (extinguished) is figurative. The sign of the Moon (Leo) comes later.
classical_check: Moon in the 3rd is moderate in classical texts; calling it extinguished is his own wording.

gist: Closing remark of the analysis: this is how the analysis goes.

hindi: तीन नंबर दो जगह काम कर रहा है इसके अपोजिट वाला भी दो ही बार करेगा हमेशा ये नियम है
says: When a sign works in two places, the sign opposite to it will also work in exactly two places; this is always the rule.
cells_derived_method: The doubling is paired across the 1-7 axis of every opposite sign pair, so the rule applies to every pair of opposite signs, and the houses differ with the lagna.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Gemini in the 1st (lagna Gemini) doubled means its opposite Sagittarius in the 7th is doubled.
Derived: if Aries is doubled (lagna Aries), then Libra in the 7th is doubled too.
Derived: Sagittarius in the 7th (lagna Gemini) works twice because Gemini does.

ambiguity: 'दो जगह' means the sign appears twice in the sequence of charts; opposite of sign 3 is sign 9.
classical_check: Silent; opposite sign pairs are classical, doubling by pairs is his own.

hindi: अब हैरानी और मजे की बात इसमें आठ नंबर ही उड़ गया आठ नंबर कहां है भाई कंफ्यूज होना है समझ नहीं आ रहा
says: Surprisingly, sign 8 (Scorpio) has vanished altogether from this chart: where is sign 8? It is confusing.
ambiguity: The disappearance is of the sign in the actual-position KP chart, as the next chunk explains.
classical_check: A sign cannot vanish in a sidereal chart, so the claim is about how the cusp divisions are laid out and is not classical.

gist: This is a deep science, a deep ocean, it will take many years not months, and great grace is needed to learn it.

hindi: यहां हम आठ नंबर के तलाक करा रहे थे इसका पर आठ नंबर की राशि गायब ही है अंतरिक्ष में काम ही नहीं कर रही
says: We were going to produce a divorce through sign 8, but the sign 8 area is missing and is not working at all in this actual-position chart.
ambiguity: Which chart he means by 'space' is not clear, probably the actual-position (KP) chart.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: तीन नंबर राशि इतनी लंबी है इसकी इतना बड़ा एरिया घेरा रखा दो नंबर को खा गया दो नंबर खा ही गया
says: In this chart sign 3 is so long and covers such a large area that it has swallowed sign 2 completely.
ambiguity: He does not say why sign 3 is long in this chart; it seems to be the cusp-based or actual-sky span.
classical_check: Sidereal signs are equal 30 degrees; unequal spans occur only in cusp-based house systems or sky constellations, so this is not classical.

hindi: उसके बाद भी मुन्ना भाई की दो और आठ नंबर काम करेगी कितनी करेगी अब एक्सपीरियंस से अंश कम हो गई यानी कि तलाक नहीं होगा रिलेशन होगा अगर यह पूरा काम करती तलाक होता
says: Even so, the MB overlay makes sign 2 and sign 8 work, but only in a reduced share by experience; so there will be no divorce but an outside relationship, and had it worked fully there would have been a divorce.
ambiguity: 'अंश' (share) is garbled; the amount by which the share is reduced is not given and is learned by experience.
classical_check: Silent; the share weighting is his own.

hindi: आठ नंबर में बैठा हुआ ये मुन्ना भाई को हम यहां भी लगाएंगे दो से आठ यहां भी चलेगा आठ नंबर में शनि कह रहा है मैं भी दूंगा तलाक
says: For the planet sitting in sign 8, we apply the MB overlay here also, so sign 2 to sign 8 works here too; Saturn in sign 8 says that it too will give a divorce.
cells_derived_method: Saturn in Scorpio acts through the house Scorpio holds; in the 7th it hits marriage, elsewhere other areas.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Saturn in Scorpio in the 7th (lagna Taurus): delayed and strained marriage, with a push toward separation.
Derived: Saturn in Scorpio in the 6th (lagna Gemini): enemy, debt and service troubles, not marriage.
Derived: Saturn in Scorpio in the 8th (lagna Aries): long, hidden troubles in the person's own life.

ambiguity: The sentence is rough in the caption; it is read as Saturn being in sign 8.
classical_check: Saturn in the 7th is a classical delay for marriage; the divorce wording is his own.

hindi: शनि क्या कहता है तीन बाहर के दो रिश्ते और होंगे इसके रिलेशनशिप
says: Saturn also says there will be two more outside relationships for this person.
ambiguity: The 'तीन' (three) in the caption may be a stray word or may mean 'three outside, two relationships'; read as two more outside relationships.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: दो बिजनेस फेल होंगे इसके बिजनेस कि मानेगा नहीं इंसान लूटेगा चाहे मानेगा नहीं
says: Two of his businesses will fail, and someone close will cheat or loot him, whether he accepts it or not. This is a prediction and not business advice.
ambiguity: Whose business and which person loots is not stated.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: शुक्र ये एक संतान का मिसकैरेज अबॉर्शन 100% होगा ही होगा
says: Venus indicates that one pregnancy will end in miscarriage or abortion, which he calls 100 percent certain. This is his tradition claim and not a medical statement.
ambiguity: No placement or timing is given for the claim; the 100 percent wording is his emphasis.
classical_check: Silent; Venus is a karaka of reproduction but a certain miscarriage is not a classical rule.

hindi: स्पर्म क्वालिटी बहुत डाउन है अगर लेडी है तो फिलप इन टू ब्लॉक्ड है
says: Sperm quality is very low (if male), or the fallopian tubes are blocked (if female). This is his tradition claim and not a medical diagnosis.
ambiguity: The sentence starts at the end of the previous chunk; 'फिलप इन टू' is garbled and read as fallopian tubes.
classical_check: Silent; medical claims are outside what classical charts safely assert.

gist: Garbled remark about sign 6 and sign 7 (he says it was 7, what a headache, all changed); no clear statement.

hindi: कुछ चलेगा यही एक्सपीरियंस से समझ आएगा आपको कौन सी कुंडली घटती जा रही है घिस जा रही है छूटती जा रही है
says: Which of the overlaid charts is fading, wearing off or slipping away can only be understood through experience, and only then will you know what to say and what to do.
ambiguity: No rule is given for how to tell; he leaves it to experience.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: यहां पर चार नंबर उड़ गई गायब मंगल यहां स्थापित हो गया कर्जा लेकर खुश रहो कर्जे में रहना ही पड़ेगा कर्जे में रहने से जिंदगी सुखी होगी
says: Here sign 4 has vanished and Mars is established; so be happy while holding a loan, since he will have to live in debt and life will be happy through the debt. This is a claim about this chart and not financial advice.
ambiguity: Where Mars sits is not stated.

says: The path of knowledge and learning comes from the same centre: the intuitive path is given by Mars and the path of knowledge by Jupiter.
ambiguity: 'इंटू' is read as intuition; Mars as the giver of intuition is unusual.
classical_check: Jupiter as the karaka of knowledge is classical; Mars as intuition is his own.

hindi: वाणी से बोलने की क्षमता बुध देगा एक्सप्रेशन कितना खूबसूरत सुंदर और शब्द कितने
says: The ability to speak through the voice is given by Mercury, along with the beauty of expression and the choice of words.
ambiguity: The caption 'चबेमू' is garbled; read as chosen or well-picked words.
classical_check: Mercury as the karaka of speech is classical.

hindi: दम है क्या दम से बोला है भैया यह सूर्य देगा
says: The force and authority behind the words, the feeling that he spoke with real weight, is given by the Sun.
ambiguity: None.
classical_check: The Sun as authority and presence in speech is consistent with tradition.

hindi: आपका हर ग्रह कार्य कर रहा है नेप्चून वासनस देता है इंद्र देता है मस्ती
says: Every planet is working in how you speak: Neptune gives the desires (vasanas) behind the words and Indra (Uranus) gives the playfulness and fun.
ambiguity: 'वासनस' is read as vasanas (desires or lust).
classical_check: Neptune and Uranus are not classical planets; the karakas are his scheme.

hindi: धर्म से की हुई बात यह प्लूटो के पास है
says: Speech spoken in line with dharma belongs to Pluto (Yama).
ambiguity: The sentence runs into the next chunk.
classical_check: Pluto is not classical; Yama as dharma-raja fits his earlier use of Pluto for dharma.

hindi: केतु तो साम्राज्य उसका है यह जबानी केतु है अगर यह जबान बोलने दे रही है तो यह केतु है नहीं तो चलता ही नहीं इसके बिना
says: Ketu rules the tongue itself: if the tongue lets you speak that is Ketu, and without it nothing works, so the actual ability to speak depends on Ketu.
ambiguity: None.
classical_check: Classical texts put speech under Mercury and the 2nd house; the tongue under Ketu is his own claim, though Ketu is sometimes linked with speech defects.

hindi: सब ग्रहों का समावेश होकर के ही हम किसी निष्कर्ष पर आते हैं इसलिए ऐसी कुंडलियों के अंदर बहुत ज्यादा कुंडलियां देखनी पड़ती है
says: A conclusion is reached only when all the planets are included, so in such cases many charts have to be examined together.
ambiguity: None.
classical_check: Classical astrology also asks for synthesis of all planets and divisional charts.

gist: It will come as you keep understanding, so keep at it; encouragement to students.

hindi: मुन्ना भाई की कुंडली एक एक्स्ट्रा कुंडली है
says: The Munna Bhai (MB) chart is an extra chart added on top of the usual charts.
ambiguity: None.
classical_check: MB chart is not classical; it is his own overlay.

gist: Says this is the last point for the class today, after which he will take a break.

hindi: अगर यहां पर यह समस्या आ गई कि लगन ही 11 डिग्री 9 डिग्री 8 डिग्री का है वो बता देता है साइन कुंडली कंप्यूटर ही कैलकुलेट करके दे देता है तो आपके पास ये दो नंबर भी चल रहा है तीन भी चल रहा है चार भी चल रहा है
says: If the lagna is at 8, 9 or 11 degrees, the software gives only the single-sign chart, but in the MB reading signs 2, 3 and 4 all run, so the three neighbouring lagnas each contribute.
cells_derived_method: The same three-sign spread applies to any lagna: the previous and next signs join the rising sign; the example uses Gemini.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Leo lagna at 8 to 11 degrees would draw in Cancer and Virgo charts as well.
Derived: Capricorn lagna at 8 to 11 degrees would draw in Sagittarius and Aquarius charts as well.

ambiguity: The numbers 8, 9, 11 degrees are examples; why the next sign (Cancer) is included at 8 to 11 degrees is not explained, as in the earlier chunk.
classical_check: Software gives one sign, true; a three-sign spread for a lagna around 10 degrees is not in classical bhava chalit.

hindi: आप बताओ यहां पर आप 10 से कैलकुलेट कर रहे हो यहां 11 12 एक से भी कैलकुलेट कर रहे हो या 12 एक दो से भी कर रहे हो और यही सेम आप केपी कुंडली में भी कर रहे हो निर्ण में कर रहे हो चलित में कर रहे हो यह सब में कर रहे हो
says: So you must compute from sets of neighbouring signs (for example the ones starting at 10, at 11 and at 12) and do exactly the same in the KP, nir and chalit charts, in every chart.
ambiguity: The numbers 10, 11, 12, 1, 2 are garbled; they appear to be sets of three consecutive signs for different lagnas.
classical_check: Silent; his overlay method.

hindi: केपी और निर्ण में भी फर्क है एक ग्रह का आ जाएगा कभी नहीं भी आएगा और राशियां भी गायब हो जाएंगी
says: The KP and nir charts also differ from each other: a planet may come in or may not, and whole signs can vanish.
ambiguity: Link with the earlier example where sign 8 and sign 4 vanished.
classical_check: A sign being absent from a cusp-based house division is possible (interceptions), but a planet disappearing is not.

gist: It is so complicated that we badly need to recognise Sanatan again and revive gurukuls.
This land was the golden bird, Mughals and the British came to loot it, and it is becoming one again because of Sanatan.
50 to 60 crore people bathed in the Ganga in a small area; people complain of pollution but the pollution is in the head, and if the head is set there is nothing.
If we had gurukuls and educational institutions in Sanatan, awareness would come (sentence continues into the next chunk).

hindi: फिर एक बाबा जी गुरु जी कोई टीला बाला बाबा किसी जोशी को ढूंढ लो अपने बाबा जी को वो कर लो जिंदगी तर जाएगी मजा करो खत्म झगड़ा ही खत्म
says: Find a guru, a baba or an astrologer of your own and follow him, and life will be fine and the quarrels will end. This is his tradition claim.
ambiguity: No criterion for choosing the guru is given.
classical_check: Guru kripa as a remedy is classical, though choice of guru is not rule-bound.

hindi: यह ज्ञान है जितना बांटो उतना बढ़े यह शिक्षा है अपने जाने से पहले दे डालो आपको जितना पता बताते चलो और आशीर्वाद और कृपा लेते चलो
says: Knowledge grows the more you share it, so pass on whatever you know before you leave and keep taking blessings and grace from elders and teachers.
ambiguity: None.
classical_check: Vidya-dana (gift of knowledge) is a classical Jupiter remedy, so this agrees.

hindi: अगर वो नहीं ली बता भी नहीं ढंग से पाओगे अमल तो करने ही नहीं देगा ग्रह क्योंकि अमल भी यही करने देंगे यह हमारे जीवन का 12 पर है इसके विरुद्ध कुछ हो नहीं सकता
says: If you do not take that grace you will not even be able to explain properly, and the planets will not let you act, since action is allowed only by them; the 12 planets rule our life and nothing can go against them.
ambiguity: '12 पर' is read as the 12 planets in his scheme.
classical_check: A fatalistic view of grahas is common in tradition, though classical texts allow effort and upaya.

gist: Anecdote of a young woman who has come to the class for ten years; he told her long ago she would go abroad, she cried that her visa would not come, yet she went and came back.

hindi: यह ग्रह है ये चाहे तू ना चाहे तेरे पल्ले पैसे हैं ना है जो भेजेगा भेज के छोड़ेगा
says: The planets decide: whether you want it or not, and whether you have the money or not, what is meant to send you abroad will send you.
ambiguity: The topic is foreign travel from the anecdote just told; no house is named.
classical_check: Foreign travel is shown classically by the 12th and 9th houses; the claim here is general.

gist: Says there are 50 people in the group and he has examples of all of them, of what happened to each (the sentence is cut off).

hindi: है यह ग्रह छोड़ते नहीं यह हमारा कोटा है ये फिक्स है होके रहेगा बदलेगा नहीं जीवन में
says: Planets do not let go of the native: what the chart delivers is a fixed quota for this life, it will happen and it does not change. This is his fate (prarabdha) view of the chart.
ambiguity: 'ग्रह छोड़ते नहीं' could mean planets do not spare the native or that planets do not leave their placements; the next words (fixed quota) favour the fate reading.
classical_check: Agrees with the Parashari idea of prarabdha karma shown in the chart; classical texts also allow remedies to soften results, which he supports later in this slice.

hindi: इसीलिए यह सारा कुछ समझ के खिचड़ी निकाली जाती है उसके बाद झंझट आता है य बुध इसका अस्त है इसका शुक्र अस्त है
says: After all these fixed factors are understood, the mixed-up 'khichdi' of the chart has to be sorted out; the real trouble then comes when planets such as Mercury or Venus are combust (asta) because they sit too close to the Sun.
cells_derived_method: Combustion hurts the planet in whatever house topics it rules or occupies; Mercury is combust within about 14 degrees of the Sun and Venus within about 10 degrees (smaller when retrograde). The damage shows in different life areas by house: speech and skills for Mercury, relationships and comforts for Venus. Since Mercury and Venus stay close to the Sun, they usually share the Sun's sign.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Mercury combust in Gemini, a sign it rules itself, in the 3rd (Aries lagna): skills, writing and sales ability are present but overshadowed by the ego of the Sun.
Derived: Venus combust in its own sign Libra in the 7th (Aries lagna): the partnership significator is dimmed, so marriage or partnership matters need extra care.
Derived: Venus combust in Taurus in the 2nd (Aries lagna): money, family speech and food enjoyment are weakened despite the own sign.

ambiguity: He only says 'Mercury is asta, Venus is asta'; the degree limits and house effects are from standard practice, not from him.
classical_check: Combustion (asta) is classical (Surya Siddhanta and Parashara give the degree limits); his general point that it complicates reading agrees.

hindi: अबे जान भी छोड़ी है सूरज ने काम करने के लिए इतना कुछ घुमाना पड़ता है
says: The Sun has taken the life out of combust planets, so they hardly function on their own and you have to turn many things around (use other support) to make them work.
ambiguity: 'जान भी छोड़ी है' can be read as 'has the Sun even left their life' (a rhetorical complaint). I read it as the Sun draining the combust planets.
classical_check: Classical view is that a combust planet gives weak results; consistent in spirit, the colourful wording is his.

gist: Says that reading such a chart needs a lot of expertise and a lot of grace, otherwise it is not possible.
'Yes sir, question-answer time' and a music tag; he opens the Q and A.

hindi: जी राशि वही है जिसम पैदा हुए हो वही राशि है
says: Answering a naming question: the person's rashi is the sign in which he or she was born, meaning the birth Moon sign, and this stays fixed.
ambiguity: He says 'the sign you were born in'; he means the Moon's sign (the next sentence talks about the Moon).
classical_check: Rashi as the Moon sign is the standard Indian definition.

hindi: और अगर चंद्रमा आपका 6 आ 12 में है तो उस नाम से नाम मत रखो
says: If the Moon is in the 6th, 8th or 12th house (the caption shows '6 आ 12'; the 8th is clear from his repeat a minute later), do not give the child a name from that rashi.
cells_derived_method: The prohibition is tied to the house, not the sign, so every Moon sign in the 6th, 8th or 12th triggers it. The sign only changes how bad the Moon is: exalted or own-sign Moon is stronger than a debilitated one, yet by his rule the naming ban still applies in all of them.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Moon exalted in Taurus but in the 6th (Sagittarius lagna): sign is strong, house is a dusthana, so by his rule the name still should not come from Taurus.
Derived: Moon in its own sign Cancer in the 8th (Sagittarius lagna): comfortable sign but 8th-house Moon, so avoid naming from Cancer.
Derived: Moon debilitated in Scorpio in the 6th (Gemini lagna): doubly weak, strongest case for avoiding this rashi name.
Derived: Moon exalted in Taurus in the 12th (Gemini lagna): expenses and loss house, so the Taurus name is still to be avoided.

ambiguity: Caption '6 आ 12' is garbled; 8 is taken from his later words 'छ आठ 12'. House numbers counted from lagna.
classical_check: Classical naming uses the birth nakshatra pada; avoiding the Moon sign when the Moon is in a dusthana is his own rule, classical texts are silent.

hindi: केपी को छोड़ दो
says: Tells the audience to leave KP (Krishnamurti Paddhati) aside when deciding this rashi and naming question.
ambiguity: Very short fragment; it may mean 'drop KP for this question' or 'drop KP altogether'.
classical_check: Silent; KP is a modern system and he sets it aside here.

gist: Repeats that rashi is the one in which you were born (sentence finishes in the next chunk).

hindi: किसकी दृष्टि जहा बैठा वहां से होगी उससे कोई लेनदेन
says: Aspect (drishti) is counted from the house where the planet is sitting; the planet's seat decides which houses it looks at.
cells_derived_method: The houses a planet touches shift with its seat: house offset is counted from the planet's own house (7th from it, plus special aspects for Mars, Jupiter, Saturn). So the same planet influences different house topics from different houses.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Mars exalted in Capricorn in the 7th (Cancer lagna) looks at the 10th (Aries), the 1st (Cancer) and the 2nd (Leo) by its 4th, 7th and 8th aspects.
Derived: Jupiter exalted in Cancer in the 10th (Libra lagna) looks at the 2nd (Scorpio), 4th (Capricorn) and 6th (Pisces) by 5th, 7th and 9th aspects.

ambiguity: The opening 'किसकी दृष्टि' looks like an audience question; 'उससे कोई लेनदेन' is unclear. Which planet is meant is not said.
classical_check: Parashari aspect from the planet's own house is standard; agrees.

hindi: दृष्टि वहा भी चलेगी तभी तो एक ग्रह की मल्टीपल दृष्टि
says: The aspect also works at other places, which is why a single planet carries several aspects; he leaves the details for a coming class.
cells_derived_method: A planet with special aspects hits several houses at once, and which houses depends on its seat. Saturn in a given house touches the 3rd, 7th and 10th counted from there.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Saturn exalted in Libra in the 1st (Libra lagna) aspects the 3rd (Sagittarius), 7th (Aries) and 10th (Cancer).
Derived: Saturn in its own sign Capricorn in the 6th (Leo lagna) aspects the 8th (Pisces), 12th (Cancer) and 3rd (Libra).

ambiguity: He gives no list of aspects; examples use the standard Saturn aspects.
classical_check: Agrees with classical special aspects (Mars 4/8, Jupiter 5/9, Saturn 3/10).

gist: Next week's class is on Saturn (Shani Maharaj) and the audience should come.

hindi: हे भगवान इतनी तो दृष्टि है उसकी और अंधकार का देवता है सबसे पावरफुल है
says: Saturn has a great many aspects, is the god of darkness and is the most powerful of the planets.
cells_derived_method: Saturn's weight in a chart depends on its house and sign: strong in kendras and in its own or exalted signs, and its aspects fall on the 3rd, 7th and 10th from its seat.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Saturn in its own sign Aquarius in the 12th (Pisces lagna) looks at the 2nd (Aries), 6th (Leo) and 9th (Scorpio): loss house placement but aspects family, enemies and fortune.
Derived: Saturn exalted in Libra on the ascendant gives a heavy, disciplined self and aspects the 3rd, 7th and 10th.

ambiguity: 'उसकी' is taken as Saturn because the Saturn class was just announced; he gives no aspect number.
classical_check: Saturn as slow, powerful, linked with darkness (Chhaya putra) is traditional; 'most powerful' is his claim, classical texts differ.

gist: Guru and disciple tea joke (the guru is fixing the engine, tea gets drunk, 'something went wrong') then 'you carry on playing'.
Says how eager you are to learn decides how far you will get.

hindi: राशि वही रहेगी जो आपके जन्म की है लेकिन वो राशि सूट करती है नहीं करती कि चंद्रमा खिसक के कहीं छ आठ 12 में तो नहीं है
says: The rashi stays what it was at birth, but whether it suits the person depends on whether the Moon has moved into the 6th, 8th or 12th house from lagna.
cells_derived_method: The suitability test is the Moon's house, whatever the sign. The sign gives the nature of the trouble: a Moon in a fire or earth sign in a dusthana is dry and restless, a water sign more emotional.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Moon in Leo in the 8th (Capricorn lagna): mind proud and hidden, rashi does not suit by his test.
Derived: Moon in Pisces in the 12th (Aries lagna): dreamy, withdrawn mind; the Pisces rashi is unsuitable for naming.
Derived: Moon in Virgo in the 6th (Aries lagna): anxious, analytical mind tied to disease and enemies house; Virgo name to be avoided.

ambiguity: 'खिसक के' (slipped) hints at the Moon moving relative to lagna (for example in bhava chalit); he does not say which chart.
classical_check: Silent in the classics as a naming rule; Moon in dusthanas is generally weak (chandra in 6/8/12).

hindi: हां तो राशि बदल दो बच्चे का नाम उस राशि से रखना ही मत
says: Remedy: in that case change the rashi used for the child (use a different rashi's naming syllable) and never name the child from the troubled Moon sign.
ambiguity: 'उस राशि' refers to the previous condition (Moon in 6/8/12), but the sentence itself does not repeat the cells, so I list wildcard cells only.
classical_check: Changing the naming rashi is a modern remedy; classical naming rules do not mention it.

hindi: आते रहोगे तो हटा दोगे तभी चंद्रमा फलित करेगा नहीं तो सत्यानाश कर देगा
says: Only once the unsuitable rashi is removed will the Moon give good results; otherwise it will ruin things for the person.
ambiguity: The first clause ('if you keep coming you will remove it') is garbled audience talk; what is removed is probably the bad rashi name or the activation.
classical_check: Silent; this is his naming-and-activation theory.

hindi: जहां बटन दबा के एक्टिवेट वही काम करेगा
