says: Whichever 'button' you press to activate, that one is what will work: the rashi activated through the name is the one that operates in the person's life.
ambiguity: Button metaphor is unexplained; I link it to the naming activation just discussed.
classical_check: Silent; this is his own model of activation.

gist: Audience banter: two rashi parivartan (sign exchanges) in the chart and 'you are having fun'; ends with 'who is holding whom, whose fun'.
Joke that without fun they would be carrying a harmonium around; 'that is nice, they have a law too'.
A person becomes spiritual only after being beaten up by maya; those who got beaten talk about spirituality.
Says maya is the wife; speaking of those people only.
Men are beaten by their own desires, not by the wife; they expect everything from women and so their wishes stay unfulfilled.
A woman has no anger or shortcoming, she does her best from her side; the problem is our expectations.
'Yes sir, question-answer to play'.

hindi: मोबाइल से काम नहीं करेगा पा सा डिग्री का फर्क हो जाता है मोबाइल से चला लो एक्सपीरियंस बंदा होगा उससे भी बता देगा
says: A mobile app may show a few degrees of difference from the proper chart, but an experienced reader can still tell the answer even from a mobile-app chart.
ambiguity: The first words say mobile will not work, then he says run it on mobile; the two parts pull in opposite directions and the caption is noisy.
classical_check: Silent; it is a practical remark about software accuracy.

gist: Garbled numbers about degrees ('121 is very big', '11.25'); the meaning is not recoverable.

hindi: तो जोन बदल दिया आपने द्वारी बदल दि है सर
says: By moving or changing the door you have changed the Vastu zone in which the entrance falls.
ambiguity: Reads like a reply to an audience remark about changing a door; the earlier context is missing.
classical_check: Vastu entrance zone logic is traditional; the astrology texts are silent.

hindi: सर मत देखो अपने घर का दूसरे से दिवा खुद मत देखो जो नहीं आता क्यों देखते हो
says: Do not check your own house's Vastu yourself; get another knowledgeable person to inspect it, and do not attempt what you do not know.
ambiguity: 'दिवा' is probably 'दिखवा' (get it shown).
classical_check: Silent; a practical advice rather than a classical rule.

gist: Says he too gets tension and goes to the doctor with an offering; the offering can be money, pressing his feet, or a gift.

hindi: कुछ आपने दिया कुछ ग्रह का ट्रांजैक्शन है ना लेनदेन है ना
says: Dealing with planets is a transaction: you give something and get something back, so remedies need an act of giving.
ambiguity: What exactly is to be given is not said here (money, service or an item).
classical_check: Daan (giving) as remedy is classical; framing it as a planetary transaction is his.

hindi: लेनदेन करो कोशिश करोगे वैसे ही नहीं होगा पहले तो कोशिश नहीं झाव करो
says: Do the give-and-take; merely trying without exchange will not make it happen.
ambiguity: The last words ('कोशिश नहीं झाव करो') are garbled and not translated.
classical_check: Silent.

gist: Scolds that the listener has not given the command and body and mind are not in sync, which is why they have not succeeded.
Syllabus is not complete; graduation took twenty years, so the time spent on this subject is nothing.
You are in 4th class, so what will a 4th-class child do, keep playing; even a graduate is not fit for much.
Calls the study a tapasya that will come if you keep playing at it, perhaps in some birth.

hindi: हां जीसे सम रहे पहला पांचवा नौवा इसी की स्ट्रेंथ के लिए हम पहले क्लास कर चुके हैं
says: The first, fifth and ninth houses are the ones whose strength matters first; he has already taught a class on strengthening them.
cells_derived_method: The strength of the 1st, 5th and 9th is judged by sign: the sign sitting there gives the lord and the quality. For example Pisces in the 9th is Jupiter's own dharma house, Scorpio in the 5th is Mars-ruled and intense, Leo on the 1st gives the Sun as lagna lord.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Pisces on the 9th (Cancer lagna), Jupiter rules it, so luck and dharma strength flow through Jupiter's condition.
Derived: Scorpio on the 5th (Cancer lagna), Mars is the lord, so children and past merit read through Mars.
Derived: Leo on the 1st, Sun is lagna lord, so self-strength is read through the Sun.

ambiguity: Caption 'से सम रहे' is garbled; I read the three ordinals as house numbers (trikona).
classical_check: Houses 1, 5 and 9 are the trikonas, classically the most auspicious houses; agrees.

gist: Refers back to the earlier class on grace (kripa) and says grace is a very serious issue; the tail of the sentence is garbled.

hindi: दूसरा आपने धर्म स्थान का देखना है और तीसरा पित
says: Second thing to check is the dharma sthan (the place of worship or religious connection); third is the pitr (ancestors, father's line), the word being cut off in the caption.
ambiguity: 'पित' is cut off; I read it as pitr (ancestors) and not as pitta. He does not name the house for dharma sthan, though the 9th is likely.
classical_check: Pitra dosha and the 9th house for dharma are classical themes; the checking order is his.

hindi: यह तो मोस्ट इंपॉर्टेंट है स्टार्टिंग है एक लिवर है एक किडनी है एक हार्ट है
says: These three checks are the most important starting point, like the liver, kidney and heart of the chart.
ambiguity: 'यह' points to the three items just listed (houses 1/5/9 strength, dharma sthan, pitr).
classical_check: Silent; priority ordering is his own.

hindi: सबसे पहले तो डॉक्टर कहता है यही देख दो भैया भाड़ में गए बाकी सब ये मेजर तीन काम कर रहे हैं एक्सलेटर ब्रेक क्लच
says: Like a doctor who says check just these and forget the rest, these three are the major working parts, like accelerator, brake and clutch; once they are fit the person can be stood up again.
ambiguity: Analogy only; same three items as the previous row.
classical_check: Silent; analogy is his.

gist: Host reading questions: first question is what to do if a child has no mind to study.
Second audience question: what remedy for a person who does not believe which planet is bad.

hindi: जिसको विश्वास नहीं है उसका नाइंथ हाउस डिस्टर्ब है इसीलिए वो विश्वास ही नहीं करेगा
says: A person who has no faith has a disturbed 9th house, which is why he will not believe in remedies at all.
cells_derived_method: How the 9th is disturbed depends on the sign on it and its lord: Saturn or Rahu sign on the 9th gives doubt, Jupiter sign gives belief unless Jupiter is afflicted.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Aquarius on the 9th (Gemini lagna), Saturn rules, so rational and sceptical belief; disturbance shows as rejection of ritual.
Derived: Sagittarius on the 9th (Aries lagna), Jupiter lord; belief is natural unless Jupiter is afflicted.
Derived: Virgo on the 9th (Capricorn lagna), Mercury lord, so analytical doubt about faith.

ambiguity: 'डिस्टर्ब' is not defined (affliction, weak lord or malefic aspect).
classical_check: The 9th as house of faith and dharma is classical; faithlessness from its affliction is a reasonable reading, not a stated text.

hindi: पहले तो उसे धर्म स्थान के उपाय करा दो फी फंड के उसका विश्वास जमना शुरू होगा
says: Remedy for disbelief: first have him do the dharma sthan (temple or worship place) remedies; after that his belief will start to settle.
ambiguity: 'फी फंड के' is garbled (possibly 'फिर' plus something); cell 9 is inferred from the previous sentence, not said here.
classical_check: Temple and worship remedies for the 9th are traditional.

hindi: ग्रह वक्री मार्गी कोई उसका स्टोन पहनाओ
says: Whether the troubled planet is retrograde or direct, make the person wear that planet's gemstone.
ambiguity: Sentence runs into the next chunk; the retrograde-or-direct phrase means he does not treat vakri status as a barrier.
classical_check: Gemstone use is traditional; some authorities treat stones of retrograde planets with extra caution, so he differs.

hindi: कैसा पहनाना है ये सीखो समझो विश्वास हो जाएगा
says: Learn and understand how exactly a stone is to be worn; when you see how it is done, belief will come.
ambiguity: Details of how to wear it (metal, finger, day) are not given in this slice.
classical_check: Classical ratna shastra has wearing rules; he only points to learning them.

gist: Wives come and complain that the husband did this and that and does not listen.

hindi: मैं कहता हूं बहन तेरी सुनने का योग नहीं है पति को मत ला यहां तेरे कहने से लाके काम नहीं करेगा
says: He tells the wife that the yoga of being listened to is not in her chart, so there is no point bringing the husband; making him come on her word will not work.
cells_derived_method: A spouse not listening is read through the 7th house and its lord in the wife's chart: sign on the 7th sets the spouse's temperament.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Capricorn on the 7th (Cancer lagna), Saturn-ruled spouse, rigid and duty-bound, listens slowly.
Derived: Aries on the 7th (Libra lagna), Mars-ruled spouse, assertive and hard to direct.
Derived: Pisces on the 7th (Virgo lagna), Jupiter-ruled spouse, soft but evasive.

ambiguity: He does not name the 7th house or any planet; the 7th is a derived link.
classical_check: Silent on this specific claim; the 7th house is the classical spouse house.

gist: Wife's reply 'then what should I do'.

hindi: पहले पति का वशीकरण करा पहले उसके अपने उपाय कर तेरा पति तेरी सुने अगर योग तो
says: Remedy: do your own remedies first so that the husband begins to listen, if the yoga is there; do not start by trying to control him.
ambiguity: 'पहले पति का वशीकरण करा' could be the wife's request or his sarcastic echo; the answer 'do your own remedies' is clear.
classical_check: Silent; remedy-first-for-self is his stance.

hindi: अगर वो सुनेगा ही नहीं तेरी कुंडली में योग है तो बहन तेरी नहीं सुनेगा यह फाइट सबसे बड़ी है इसलिए पहले अपने उपाय करोगे
says: If the husband simply does not listen, the cause is in her own chart yoga and nothing else; this is the biggest fight, a fight with her own destiny, so her own remedies come first.
ambiguity: The sentence is long and the conditional is garbled (yoga present versus absent); I read it as: no yoga, no listening.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: मेरा बच्चा मेरी सुनता नहीं क्यों नहीं सुनता आपकी कुंडली में योग नहीं है बच्चा बुरा नहीं है और की तो सुनता है
says: When a child does not listen to the parent, the child is not bad; he listens to others, so the parent's own chart lacks the yoga of being heard.
cells_derived_method: Parent-child obedience is read through the 5th house in the parent's chart; the sign on the 5th sets how the child relates.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Gemini on the 5th (Aquarius lagna), Mercury-ruled child, talkative and argues, listens selectively.
Derived: Sagittarius on the 5th (Leo lagna), Jupiter-ruled child, principled and independent of parental orders.
Derived: Aries on the 5th (Sagittarius lagna), Mars-ruled child, strong-willed, resists commands.

ambiguity: He does not name the 5th house; this link is derived.
classical_check: Silent on this claim; the 5th as the children house is classical.

hindi: बाहर तो सबसे बात करता मेरा बच्चा बड़ा प्यारा बेबी है घर में उपद्रव मचा रखा है क्योंकि आपके भाग में उससे सुख लेना नहीं है
says: A child who is sweet outside and unruly at home is that way because happiness from that child is not in the parent's fortune (bhagya).
cells_derived_method: Parent's fortune is read through the 9th and the 5th; the sign on the 9th and 5th shows how the fortune comes.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Aquarius on the 9th (Gemini lagna), Saturn-ruled fortune, comes late and with effort, so child-related comfort is delayed.
Derived: Cancer on the 5th (Pisces lagna), Moon-ruled child, emotional and clingy outside the home but moody inside.

ambiguity: 'भाग' (fortune) is not tied to a house by him; 5th and 9th are my derivations.
classical_check: Silent on this specific wording.

hindi: वशीकरण वशीकरण नहीं होता वो बंगाली बाबा करते हैं उपाय किए जाते हैं ग्रह की करेक्शन की जाती है
says: Astrology does not do vashikaran (control of others), that is for Bengali babas; astrologers do remedies, which correct the planets.
ambiguity: The caption reads 'पहले बच्चे का वशीकरण वशीकरण नहीं होता'; I take it as 'it is not vashikaran'.
classical_check: Vashikaran is a tantra practice, not a Parashari remedy; he separates the two, which is consistent.

gist: 'Sir, but if there is no mind to study' (repeated question).
One should not even expect to feel like studying; study is a compulsion, do it by force, one feels like partying; it is a ladder to build standing.
Study something, any degree, for the social environment and for effect on others.

hindi: चमको सबसे पावरफुल वेपन है क्योंकि मल्टीपल लोगों के मुन्ना की जब पावर मिलती है तो चमको स्ट्रांग होता है
says: Social standing (the garbled word 'चमको', probably meaning a degree or glow before others) is the most powerful weapon, because it brings the combined power of many people's minds behind you.
ambiguity: 'चमको' and 'मुन्ना' are unclear in the caption; 'मुन्ना' is used later as a pet name for the mind.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: औरों की कृपा औरों के आशीर्वाद औरों की इच्छा से ही आपके काम हो जाते हैं इसलिए आप को बहुत जरूरी है
says: Your work gets done through the grace, blessings and wishes of other people, which is why gaining such support is very necessary.
ambiguity: No house or planet is named; the 11th house (gains from many people) is a possible link but not said.
classical_check: Silent; links with the kripa (grace) theme of the earlier class.

gist: If no mind to study, go and give the paper; tell Munna (the mind) 'you have to give the paper'; the command technique will be taught two classes later.
Says the question is very sweet: how to pass the paper when the mind does not stay on study.
Says to hand the contract over to Munna (the mind) to take care of it.

hindi: हम घर में कहते हैं नॉर्थ ईस्ट की वॉल पर पहले एलाई लगाओ वही देख लेगी सारा सर वो पास करेगा
says: Vastu remedy: in the house, first put the item he calls 'एलाई' on the north-east wall; it will take care of everything and the student will pass.
ambiguity: The caption 'एलाई' is unclear (alloy, a picture or some object); the north-east wall is clear.
classical_check: North-east (Ishanya) is the Vastu zone of knowledge and Jupiter; the object is unknown, so classical check is silent on the specific item.

hindi: लेकिन मेरिट आएगी कि मेरिट आएगी मेरिट के लिए पास करेगा जी मेरिट लिखी है तो हम जोशी के पास जाकर क्या अचार डालेगा
says: The remedy gets the student through, but a merit rank comes only if merit is written in destiny; if merit is written, it will come by itself.
ambiguity: The sentence is muddled by the audience; the pickle joke about the astrologer ('जोशी') makes my reading uncertain.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: अगर इसला कॉशसनेस उसकी तो उसका पढ़ने का मन ही कर जाएगा
says: If the consciousness of that place (the north-east wall) reaches the child, the child's own mind to study will arise.
ambiguity: 'इसला कॉशसनेस उसकी' is garbled; whose consciousness is meant is not clear.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: मन नहीं कर रहा मीस मुन्ना मुन्ना मीस प्रारब्ध उसके प्रारब्ध कुंडली में दोष है
says: If the child's mind will not study, it is his prarabdha, meaning a dosha in the kundali, and not simply the child being naughty.
ambiguity: 'मीस मुन्ना मुन्ना मीस' is garbled; I rely on 'प्रारब्ध कुंडली में दोष है'.
classical_check: Silent on this specific claim.

hindi: पत्थर पहनाओ दो चार उसे और क्या है
says: Remedy for lack of study mind: put a couple of gemstones on the child, nothing more is needed.
ambiguity: Which stones is not said.
classical_check: Gemstone remedy is traditional; wearing several without chart analysis is generally cautioned against by classical authors.

hindi: 100 साल चलते पत्थर दो घंटे में थोड़ी बदलने
says: A gemstone lasts a hundred years; it is not something you change within two hours, so do not swap it hastily.
ambiguity: Short, partly sarcastic line; the contrast with the next sentence shows he is arguing against frequent changes.
classical_check: Many astrologers prescribe periodic replacement; he disagrees.

hindi: पा साल में बदलो पंडित लोग कहते हैं पुखराज पुराना हो गया बदल दो
says: He quotes the pandits who say change the stone every few years because the yellow sapphire (pukhraj) has gone old; he mocks this, implying the claim is baseless.
ambiguity: 'पा साल' is garbled, probably 'पांच साल' (five years).
classical_check: Differs from common practice where stones are replaced when cracked or after a number of years.

hindi: नहीं 100 साल चलेगा हजार साल लाइफ है पत्थर की मर जाओ बच्चे को दे जाओ पोतो पोतियो को दे जाओ इतनी तगड़ी इन्वेस्टमेंट है वेस्ट नहीं होता
says: A gemstone does not wear out in a hundred years; its life is a thousand years, so it can be passed to children and grandchildren. He calls it a strong investment that is never wasted (his remark on lasting value, not financial advice).
ambiguity: 'इन्वेस्टमेंट' is used in the sense of lasting value, not a return on money.
classical_check: Classical texts say a gem keeps its power while intact; a thousand-year life is his figure, not found in standard texts.

gist: Audience asks: if someone wore a stone and after it gets old it breaks or cracks, what then.

hindi: ई बना लो दोबारा कर और क्या नहीं बना लो
says: If a stone breaks or cracks, simply have one made again (get a fresh stone prepared).
ambiguity: The caption 'ई बना लो दोबारा कर और क्या नहीं बना लो' is rough; I read it as 'make it again, what else'.
classical_check: Classical texts treat a cracked gem as unfit to wear and to be replaced; agrees.

hindi: किसी के पुराने पत्थर हो वो निकलवा के यूज कर
says: If someone has an old stone lying around, have it taken out of its setting and use it yourself.
ambiguity: Whether the stone should match the planet or be energised first is not said.
classical_check: Many classical authorities caution against wearing a stone previously worn by another person; he differs.

hindi: हां हा पुराना पत्थर बड़े मजे में यूज हो सकता है बहुत बढ़िया है काम तो चलेगा
says: An old, second-hand stone can be used without trouble; it is very good and it will do the job.
ambiguity: None beyond the caption's noise.
classical_check: Differs from the common caution against pre-worn gems.

gist: Analogy: reheated yesterday's food also gets the work done, it makes no difference.
New is better if you can afford it; expensive stuff, banter about taking money out of someone's pocket.
Hare Radhe Radhe, Hari Om Krishna, 'this too is Krishna's leela'; light religious chatter.

hindi: हां जी लाई गिफ्टेड वाली भी लगा सकते हां गिफ्टेड तो ज्यादा अच्छी होती है अपने पैसे भी नहीं लगे
says: A gifted gemstone can also be worn, and a gifted one is even better because you spent no money of your own.
ambiguity: 'लाई' is probably a fragment of 'like'; the gifted-stone meaning is clear.
classical_check: Classical texts mostly advise buying and energising your own stone; a gifted gem is acceptable to some astrologers, not to others.

gist: People study and collect so many degrees and the degrees do not (continues in the next line).

hindi: आती पढ़ लिख के डिग्री इकट्ठी करते हो डिग्री काम नहीं आती है काम तो कृपा और आशीर्वाद ही आता है
says: Degrees collected through study do not finally help; what actually works in life is grace (kripa) and blessings (ashirvad).
ambiguity: No house or planet is tied to grace in this sentence.
classical_check: Silent in the classics; matches his earlier kripa theme.

gist: Jokes that nobody gained from degrees; asks who is paying us, the degree-holders are, those who have earned money earlier.
For those who have nothing we serve free out of charity; banter about how long free service can go on.
Host reads the next question on loans: a person has an 8 lakh loan not being repaid; an astrologer told him to get 1.25 lakh Gayatri mantras chanted by a brahmin.
Second part of the question: asks him to break down the Gayatri mantra.

hindi: गायत्री मंत्र शाब्दिक रूप से बोलना नहीं चाहिए ये किले हुए मंत्र है ये शिव के द्वारा किले गए हैं
says: The Gayatri mantra should not be recited in its plain literal form because it is a sealed (keelit) mantra, sealed by Shiva.
ambiguity: 'शाब्दिक रूप से' could mean without the unlocking syllables or without understanding; the next lines support the first.
classical_check: Keelan (sealing) of mantras is a tantric idea; the Vedic Gayatri is traditionally chanted as it is, so he differs from the common view.

hindi: ओम ओम हिम भीम जो लगाते हैं ये बीज है खोला जाता है
says: The sounds added in front (the caption shows 'ओम ओम हिम भीम', probably Om and seed syllables like Hreem) are bija sounds, and they are what unlock the sealed mantra.
ambiguity: The exact seed syllables are garbled in the caption; only the idea that bija sounds unlock is certain.
classical_check: Bija mantras as unlocking keys belong to the tantra tradition; consistent with that tradition.

hindi: तत्स वितु वण भर्ग देवस्य धीमे धी तन्नो यह जो बोला जाता है यह मंत्र है लेकिन वो किले हुए मंत्र है कलयुग में कील दिए गए इन्हे खोल दिया जाता है
says: The Gayatri words as normally recited are the mantra, but in Kali yuga such mantras were sealed, and they have to be opened before they work.
ambiguity: None; only the caption spelling of the mantra is rough.
classical_check: The Kali-yuga sealing idea comes from tantra texts (shapa and keelan), not from Vedic sources; consistent with that tradition.

hindi: ये खोलने के लिए ओम एम हिंग ऐसे ऐसे लगाते हैं जो लगता है मंत्र तो ये सवा लाख करने से नहीं
says: To open the sealed mantra, seed syllables such as Om, Aim and Hring are attached to it; once that is set up the mantra works, and 1.25 lakh repetitions of the plain form is not what achieves it.
ambiguity: The end of the sentence is cut by the caption ('सवा लाख करने से नहीं ...'); the full thought follows in the next sentence.
classical_check: Bija prefixes are tantric; agrees with that tradition.

hindi: गायत्री का पूरा कहते इसे सिद्ध करना यह 24 लाख से होता है
says: To fully perfect (siddha) the Gayatri one needs 24 lakh repetitions, not 1.25 lakh.
ambiguity: None; the 24 lakh figure is stated clearly.
classical_check: Agrees: the traditional purashcharana of the Gayatri is 24 lakh japa (one lakh per syllable of the 24).

gist: Disclaimer that speaking against religious sentiment is wrong and he should not say it, but he is speaking literally.

hindi: आपको क्रोसिन की डोज चाहिए हर 6 घंटे में चाहिए तब बुखार हटेगा आपने एक ले ली वो हटेगा नहीं इसलिए करना तो पुरश्चरण करो
says: Using a Crocin-tablet analogy, a remedy needs its full regular course, and a single dose such as 1.25 lakh japa will not clear the problem; so do the full purashcharana (complete mantra course). The medicine comparison is only an analogy.
ambiguity: The fever example is an analogy for dose and course, not medical advice.
classical_check: Purashcharana as the complete mantra discipline is classical; agrees.

hindi: इन चक्र में ना पड़ो ऐसे किसी बाबा को पकड़ लो जिसने ऑलरेडी सेट कर रखा है उससे आशीर्वाद ले लो वो य छीट मार देगा काम हो गया
says: Avoid the whole cycle of rituals; instead find a baba who has already perfected the mantra and take his blessing, a sprinkle from him and the work is done.
ambiguity: 'ऑलरेडी सेट कर रखा है' means someone who has already done the 24 lakh siddhi, as the end of this slice confirms.
classical_check: Blessing from an accomplished mantra-siddha is a guru-kripa idea; the classical texts do not make it a substitute for japa.

hindi: क्यों थक रहे हो सवा लाख कराने में पैसा बहुत लगेगा लाख रुपये से कम नहीं लगेगा
says: Getting 1.25 lakh japa done by priests costs a lot of money, he says not less than a lakh of rupees, so why tire yourself.
ambiguity: Next sentence quotes 70 to 80 thousand; the two cost figures differ.
classical_check: Silent; this is a practical cost remark.

hindi: घंटे कमर तोड़ेंगे चार पाच सात पंडित तो एक हफ्ता लगाएंगे उनकी दक्षिणा वक्ष मिलाकर 70 8 हज से कम खर्चा नहीं है हवन तर्पण मार्जन सारा कार्यक्रम करते हु सस्ता काम नहीं है
says: Long hours of sitting, four to seven pandits working about a week, with dakshina and other costs plus havan, tarpan and marjan; the whole programme costs not less than about 70 to 80 thousand and is not cheap.
ambiguity: The amount is garbled ('70 8 हज'); I read it as 70 to 80 thousand.
classical_check: Havan, tarpan and marjan are the classical parts of a purashcharana; agrees.

hindi: अगर कोई कज में कर दूंगा झूठ बोल रहा है करेगा ही नहीं असंभव
says: If anyone says he will do the full japa cheaply, he is lying; he will not do it and it is impossible at that price.
ambiguity: 'कज में' is garbled; read as 'cheaply' from the next lines on cheap pujas.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: लोग नारायण बलि कर देते पवे के अंदर 4000 में पूजा होती ही नहीं व्यर्थ हो गया इसलिए उचित जब तक जानकार ज्ञानी नहीं मिलेगा
says: People get Narayan bali done for around 4000 rupees, but a real puja cannot be done at that price and it goes waste; so do it only when a truly knowledgeable person is found.
ambiguity: 'पवे के अंदर' is garbled, probably 'पैसे के अंदर' or 'within the price'.
classical_check: Narayan bali is a classical pitr-related rite requiring a knowledgeable priest; agrees on that point.

hindi: नारायण बलि छ घंटे आठ घंटे लगेंगे लोग तो भर भम भम 15 मिनट में खत्म कर देते
says: A proper Narayan bali takes six to eight hours, whereas people finish it in about 15 minutes with fast chanting, which makes it ineffective.
ambiguity: Some digits are garbled ('000 में'); the six to eight hours and 15 minutes are readable.
classical_check: Narayan bali is a multi-hour rite classically; agrees.

hindi: जो लोग डोर बेल लगा लेते हैं मंत्रों का उच्चारण होता रहता है टोटल टाइम वेस्ट है
says: Those who fit a doorbell or device that keeps playing mantras at home are totally wasting time; recorded recitation does not count as chanting.
ambiguity: The caption is garbled around 'डोर बेल'; I read it as a mantra-playing device.
classical_check: Silent; classical texts require the person to chant, so agrees in spirit.

hindi: सरीर में दर्द अलग होएगा और वो बस ये एक हिप्नोसिस है हिप्नोसिस क्रिएट किया जाता है
says: Such long rituals leave the body aching and are just hypnosis, a state that is created in the participants.
ambiguity: The body-pain remark belongs to long sitting, not a medical claim.
classical_check: Silent; this is his own explanation of why rituals seem to work.

hindi: ये हिप्नोसिस जैसे हमारे धर्म में जोड़ के लिए बहुत जरूरी है बहुत अच्छा होता है हिप्नोसिस लेकिन पर्सनल लेवल प व्यर्थ है
says: This hypnosis is useful in our religion for binding the community together, but at the personal level it is useless.
ambiguity: 'जोड़ के लिए' is read as joining people together (collective ritual).
classical_check: Silent.

gist: The great rishis said it is within; accomplished sadhus whose feet people touch live in forest huts, not temples, and God is with them in the hut.
Story of Dhanna Jat who worshipped a stone and found God in it.
One who has known through inner consciousness does not go outside (sentence continues).
Garbled lines about forests and 'as much as is understood'; meaning not recoverable.

hindi: नाम जप के लिए बोलते नाम जप हिप्नोसिस है हिप्नोसिस का मतलब अब आपके मुन्ना को बिजी कर दिया नाम जप
says: Naam japa (chanting a divine name) is also a form of hypnosis: it works by keeping your Munna, the restless mind, busy.
ambiguity: 'मुन्ना' is his pet word for the mind, as in the previous slice.
classical_check: Silent; mind-engagement is the usual explanation of japa, so consistent in spirit.

gist: Praises Premanand Maharaj, who also urges naam japa, is very famous and is doing great work for Sanatan.

hindi: क्योंकि ये उन लोगों के लिए है जिनको बुद्धि भ्रष्ट है समझ ही नहीं आ रहा तो उन्होंने इतना सुंदर प्रचार किया है नाम जप करो राधा नाम जाप करो
says: Naam japa is meant for those whose intellect is clouded and who do not understand; that is why Premanand Maharaj's promotion of chanting Radha's name or any name is so useful.
ambiguity: 'बुद्धि भ्रष्ट' is his bluntness about the stage of understanding, not a diagnosis.
classical_check: Naam japa is a bhakti-tradition remedy, classical texts for Kali yuga recommend it; agrees.

hindi: हमारा अपना एक मुद्दा है वो डिफरेंट है के नाम जप भी एक हिप्नोसिस है लेकिन जब तक आप ऊपर की सीढ़ी पर नहीं हो नाम जप करो आपका मुन्ना बिजी रहेगा
says: His own stand is different: naam japa is a kind of hypnosis, but until you reach a higher step, keep doing it so that your mind stays occupied.
ambiguity: 'ऊपर की सीढ़ी' is not defined here; he teaches it in later classes.
classical_check: Silent; his own ladder model.

gist: When you learn to command the Munna it becomes like an electron-proton; to be taught the week after next, God and Munna willing.

hindi: आपको नाम जप निचली सीढ़ी का खेल है लेकिन उस हिप्नोसिस में रहना है
says: Naam japa is a lower-step game, but until you move higher you should stay inside that hypnosis.
ambiguity: Sentence carries over into the next timestamp.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: आजकल य आ रहा है माता पिता के पैर धो लिए महाकुंभ हो गया
says: The current saying is that if you wash your parents' feet, that equals having done the Mahakumbh.
ambiguity: He quotes it as a trend, and it is unclear if he endorses it fully.
classical_check: Honouring parents as equal to pilgrimage is a common scriptural theme; consistent.

hindi: कुछ लोग बॉडी वहां ले जाकर के महाकुंभ कर रहे हैं उनका हिप्नोसिस है यह प्लेसिबो इफेक्ट है वो भी काम करता है
says: Some people physically take their body to the Mahakumbh; that is their hypnosis, a placebo effect, and it does work for them too.
ambiguity: 'प्लेसिबो इफेक्ट' is used as an explanation, not a dismissal.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: लेकिन जिसने इसके आगे की सीढ़ी जान ली वो यही कर लेगा
says: One who has understood the step beyond this will achieve the same result right where he is, without travelling to the pilgrimage.
ambiguity: 'यही कर लेगा' could mean at home or in the same way; I read it as at home.
classical_check: Silent.

gist: Describes Shiva's form with matted locks, kamandal and hair bun, says the Aghori smoking is not bhang but something inside the brain, covered in his earlier cancer-and-brain class.
Says DMT (dimethyltryptamine) is secreted in the brain and links that to the form of Shiva.
Asks whom Shiva himself worships; answers self-born, Shambhu.
Says they have drifted away from astrology and will discuss this later, then returns to the astrology question.

hindi: और 24 लाख जिसने कर रखे उनकी कृपा ले
says: Take the grace of a person who has already completed 24 lakh Gayatri japa; his blessing replaces your own large chanting.
ambiguity: The mantra is not named here, but 24 lakh refers to the Gayatri discussed above.
classical_check: Guru-kripa from a siddha is traditional, though not a substitute for japa in the texts.

gist: Host begins 'but sir, for an ordinary man' (follow-up question).

hindi: कैसे पता चलेगा सामने वा सबके लेते चलो कोई ना कोई सही मिल जाएगा सबके लूट लो
says: You cannot tell in advance which holy person is the real one, so take blessings from everyone; one of them will turn out to be right.
ambiguity: Answers the question of how to find a person who has really done the 24 lakh japa; the opening words are cut off.
classical_check: Silent; classical texts urge careful choice of a guru, so he differs.

gist: We need not do anything, only surrender; we do not know in whose lap Ram resides, perhaps a fool's.
Great people hold the power but do not manifest it because they know there is nothing in it.
We build up a lot, even buildings, and at the time of death more will be left behind; we cannot drop tension and do not know how to enjoy.
Host passes on a viewer's question: what is Gayatri really, and where does a mantra work.

hindi: पास्ट लाइफ कर्मा पर काम करता है मुन्ना पर काम करता है बॉडी पर काम करता है
says: A mantra works on three levels: on past-life karma, on the Munna (mind), and on the body.
ambiguity: Answer to 'where does a mantra work'.
classical_check: Silent; mantra acting on sanchita karma is a common claim, the three-level split is his.

hindi: गायत्री बृहस्पति की शनी के लिए है बस
says: Gayatri belongs to Jupiter's power; the caption word 'शनी' is probably 'शक्ति', and the next lines confirm the link with Jupiter.
ambiguity: 'शनी' could be Saturn, but the following sentences say Jupiter's strength, so I read it as shakti.
classical_check: Differs: classically the Gayatri is Savitri, a Sun (Savita) mantra; linking it with Jupiter is his own.

hindi: स्त्री शक्ति रूप में पुरुष और प्रकृति प्रकृति रूप में पुरुष का कार्य पुरुष मेल बॉडी की बात नहीं हो रही है पुरुष इज द स्लीप मोड एनर्जी
says: Purusha does not mean a male body; it is the sleep-mode (resting) energy, and Prakriti is its working feminine aspect.
ambiguity: The first half of the sentence is jumbled in the caption; the sleep-mode definition is clear.
classical_check: Purusha as passive consciousness and Prakriti as active energy is Samkhya; agrees.

hindi: पैसिव एक्टिव एनर्जी उसका जो स्वरूप है उसे हम प्रकृति कहते हैं वो स्त्री रूप में गायत्री माता है
says: Active energy, as opposed to passive, is what we call Prakriti, and in feminine form that is Gayatri Mata.
ambiguity: 'पैसिव' at the start is the end of the previous sentence.
classical_check: Identifying Gayatri as the goddess aspect of Prakriti is consistent with Shakta tradition.

hindi: ऐसे ऐसे पितांबरा माता है ये देवी है बगलामुखी ऐसे देवी दुर्गा है चंडी है ये वर्किंग है मूवमेंट वाली
says: The same working, moving energy appears as other goddesses too: Pitambara (Baglamukhi), Durga and Chandi.
ambiguity: None; the goddess names are clear.
classical_check: Baglamukhi is a Mahavidya often linked with Mars (some say Jupiter); here he links her with the same Jupiter-type force.

hindi: तो ये जो है बृहस्पति ही है जिसकी पावर के लिए ये किया जाता है जुपिटर की स्ट्रेंथ के लिए है आपको वाक् शक्ति दे देता है
says: This is Jupiter itself: the Gayatri japa is done to strengthen Jupiter, and it gives the person power of speech (vak shakti).
cells_derived_method: Where Jupiter sits in the chart decides which area the speech power shows in; Jupiter in the 2nd gives family speech and teaching, in the 10th gives authority through words.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Jupiter strengthened in its own sign on the 2nd (Scorpio lagna): speech, family values and income through advice improve.
Derived: Jupiter exalted in Cancer on the 10th (Libra lagna): words carry authority at work, speaking and teaching careers benefit.
Derived: Jupiter in Pisces on the 6th (Libra lagna): speech power useful in service, law or counselling but conflicts arise through words.

ambiguity: 'वाक् शक्ति' is taken as ability to speak with effect; he gives no house.
classical_check: Jupiter as karaka of speech and teaching is classical; the Gayatri-for-Jupiter link is his own.

gist: Audience: sir, you had said sealed (keelit) mantras just now.
Says leave it, why get into this cycle.

hindi: बगलामुखी का भी इतने थे यार ओम हि बगलामुखी सर्व दुष्ट वाचम मुखम पदम स्त जीवा दु ऐसे
says: He recites the Baglamukhi mantra (Om Hlreem Baglamukhi, sarva dushtanam, vacham mukham padam stambhaya, jihvam keelaya) as an example of a mantra that carries an opening seed syllable.
ambiguity: The caption spells the mantra roughly; I restate the standard form of the Baglamukhi mantra.
classical_check: The mantra is the standard Baglamukhi mantra; the word 'keelaya' in it is part of the tradition.

hindi: तो वो जो ओम हि सता लिंग ये खोले जाते हैं मंत्र इसके द्वारा उससे ओपन किया गया दरवाजा खुलेगा नहीं
says: The seed sounds such as Om and Hlreem are what open (unlock) the mantra; without that opening the door will not open and the mantra will not work.
ambiguity: The caption is very noisy around the seed names; only the idea that the opening sounds are required is clear.
classical_check: Consistent with tantric keelan and utkeelan.

hindi: शिवजी क्या आता ना महामृत्युंजय में ओम हौं ओम जूं सः भूर्भुवः स्वः त्र्यम्बकं यजामहे सुगंधिं पुष्टिवर्धनम
says: Another example of the opening syllables: in the Mahamrityunjaya mantra of Shiva, Om Haum Om Joom Sah are placed in front of the Bhur Bhuvah Svah Tryambakam verse.
ambiguity: The caption garbles the seed syllables; I use the standard Haum Joom Sah form.
classical_check: The Haum Joom Sah prefix to Tryambakam is the standard sampuṭ form; agrees.

hindi: बीज मंत्र त्र्यम्बकं पुष्टि जो खोला गया है शुरू में लास्ट में कहते हैं जूं हौं रिवर्स ये ओपन अनओपन है
says: The seed syllables used to open the mantra at the start are said in reverse order at the end (Joom Haum), which closes it; so the mantra is opened and then un-opened.
ambiguity: 'शरा में' in the caption is probably 'शुरू में' (at the start).
classical_check: Agrees with the sampuṭ method where the bija are repeated in reverse at the end.

gist: Host reads the next question: does a planet at a low or a high degree also give its effect.

hindi: हाई डिग्री का सूर्य आग की तरह बरस रहा है लो डिग्री का सूर्य बहुत ज्यादा पावरफुल है
says: A Sun at a high degree rains down like fire, but a Sun at a low degree is the very powerful one.
cells_derived_method: Degree strength is added to the sign and house effect: the same Sun in the 10th gives different weight at 3 degrees than at 28 degrees.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: exalted Sun in Aries on the 10th (Cancer lagna), at a low degree it is strongest and gives clear authority; at a high degree it burns hot and may give harsh results.
Derived: Sun in its own sign Leo on the ascendant, at a low degree the self and vitality are very powerful, at a high degree ego flares.

ambiguity: The comparison is a bit odd ('fire raining' for high degree); I read it as high degree = burning, low degree = strong.
classical_check: Classical baladi avastha makes the early degrees of a planet weak (bala) in odd signs and the later degrees weak, so he differs from the usual scheme.

hindi: बृहस्पति 5 डिग्री तक युवा है उसके बाद बूढ़ा हो गया है 25 डिग्री बूढ़ा ही है वो इसलिए युवा बृहस्पति वो है जो 5 डिग्री के अंदर अंदर का है भयंकर पावरफुल
says: Jupiter is young only up to 5 degrees, after that it is old (at 25 degrees it is plainly old); so a young Jupiter, within 5 degrees, is extremely powerful, and beyond that it is only fair in strength.
cells_derived_method: The degree test applies in every house and sign; the house tells where the extra strength lands.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Jupiter at 3 degrees of its own sign Sagittarius in the 5th (Leo lagna), the young and strong case: children, mantra and learning benefit strongly.
Derived: Jupiter at 26 degrees of Pisces in the 9th (Cancer lagna), old by his rule: dharma and fortune results are slower and milder.

ambiguity: He does not say what happens between 5 and 25 degrees besides 'old'.
classical_check: Differs from baladi avastha, which gives infant 0-6, young 12-18 and old 18-24 degrees for odd signs and the reverse for even signs; his 5-degree rule is his own.

hindi: बाकी बृहस्पति स्वभाव से है ही वृद्ध सफेद दाढ़ी है बाबा जी की तरह है शिक्षक है गुरु है पेट निकला है थोड़ा सा ज्ञानी है
says: Jupiter by nature is elderly: a white-bearded baba-like teacher and guru with a slight paunch and plenty of knowledge; that is Jupiter's form, and so he is strongest only in his young degrees.
ambiguity: None; the 5-degree conclusion follows in the next sentence.
classical_check: Jupiter as teacher, elder and slightly stout is consistent with classical significations.

hindi: चंदा मामा शनि जो है 23 डि पाफ मंगल 27 डिग्री तक पफुल ऐसे अलग अलग ग्रहों का अलग अलग है
says: Each planet has its own degree range of power: Mars is powerful up to 27 degrees and another planet (Saturn or the Moon, the caption is mixed) up to about 23 degrees.
cells_derived_method: Same degree test in every house; a planet inside its strong range gives the house topics fully.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Mars in own sign Aries in the 3rd (Aquarius lagna) at 20 degrees is inside its strong range, so courage and effort results arrive fully.
Derived: Mars exalted in Capricorn on the 10th (Aries lagna) at 28 degrees is past the 27-degree limit, so strong sign but weakened power.

ambiguity: The caption mixes 'चंदा मामा' (Moon), Saturn and 23; I cannot say which planet gets which number. 'पाफ' and 'पफुल' are 'powerful'.
classical_check: Silent; classical texts do not give planet-wise power degrees of this kind.

hindi: बाकी ग्रह तो ढीले ढाले हो जाते हैं
says: Outside those strong degree ranges the planets become loose and weak.
ambiguity: Unclear whether 'बाकी ग्रह' means the other planets or the same planets in their remaining degrees.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: जान का करना चाहिए जो ब कंडक्टर आप कुशा के आसन पर कंबल के ऊपर बैठे ताकि धरती उसको चूस ना ले
says: For mantra japa, sit on a kusha mat placed over a blanket so that the earth, acting as a conductor, does not drain away the energy built up.
ambiguity: The first words ('जान का करना चाहिए जो ब') are garbled; the rest is clear.
classical_check: Seat of kusha over a blanket or deer skin is the classical asana for japa; agrees.

gist: Do it cheerfully, party and enjoy, all is fine.

hindi: इससे ऊपर निकल जाओ हिप्नोसिस से ऊपर निकल जाओ नाम जप करना एक हिप्नोसिस है जो सुंदर और आवश्यकता है हमारे सनातन के लिए ताकि हम जुड़े
says: Rise above hypnosis eventually; naam japa is a beautiful hypnosis that Sanatan needs so that people stay connected to each other.
ambiguity: Repeats his earlier naam japa point, adding the community-binding role.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: जिस व्यक्ति को उसके आगे की ज्ञान होता जा रहा है वह उसके ऊपर चला जाता है
says: A person who is gaining the knowledge that lies beyond naam japa rises above it and no longer needs it.
ambiguity: 'उसके ऊपर' is read as above naam japa.
classical_check: Silent.

gist: Says the word Radha is the reverse of dhara (flow): the flow of Krishna consciousness that went out and flowed returned inside as Radha.
Radha is Krishna's shakti; when the shakti merges back in the source it becomes Radha-Krishna.

hindi: तो ऐसा भी है जी कुछ आधी रात के बाद जैसे न बजे से लेकर 530 बजे तक 6 बजे तक ये तंत्र साधना में होता है
says: Some practices are done after midnight, from the small hours until 5:30 or 6 in the morning; this timing belongs to tantra sadhana.
ambiguity: The start hour is garbled ('न बजे'); only 'after midnight' and the end at 5:30 to 6 are clear. Answering an audience point.
classical_check: Tantra sadhana at night and before dawn is a standard tantric claim; agrees.

gist: Repeats that it happens in tantra sadhana; audience says yes sir.
Host asks: if the atmakaraka planet is retrograde, what is its result.
Says let it be, it is a very long topic.

hindi: आत्मकारक सबसे ज्यादा डिग्री वाला है अब उसकी डिग्री में वो जान भी बची है ये भी तो देखना
says: The atmakaraka is the planet with the highest degree, and one should also check whether it still has life (strength) in that degree.
ambiguity: 'जान भी बची है' is not defined; it suggests a degree-strength test like the Jupiter rule above.
classical_check: Highest degree within the sign for atmakaraka is Jaimini's rule; agrees. The extra 'life in the degree' test is his own.

hindi: बृहस्पति पता लगा 3 डिग्री का है जान नहीं उसमें बची हुई क्या चार डालोगे उसका आत्मकारक होगे बेकार वर्थ है वो
says: If the planet with the highest degree turns out to be one that has no life left in its degree (he gives Jupiter as the example), it is a useless atmakaraka.
ambiguity: Caption says Jupiter at 3 degrees, which contradicts his own rule that Jupiter within 5 degrees is young and powerful; the number is probably mis-heard (for example 29).
classical_check: Silent on a 'worthless atmakaraka'; classically any planet with highest degree is atmakaraka.

hindi: वो आत्मकारक अमात्यकारक दारा कारक भ्रातृ कारक ये फिर और आगे चलती जाएगी तो एंडलेस है जैमिनी है ये जैमिनी के अनुसार देखा जाता है
says: Atmakaraka, amatyakaraka, darakaraka, bhratrikaraka and so on continue down the list, which is endless; this scheme comes from Jaimini and is read by Jaimini's method.
ambiguity: He calls the list endless, but classical Jaimini has seven (or eight) chara karakas.
classical_check: Chara karakas are from Jaimini Sutras; the list is limited to seven or eight, so 'endless' is loose speech.

hindi: तीन नंबर की राशि थी उसमें डिग्री 15 डिग्री है आएगी कोई सी भी लगा लो 15 डिग्री है तो अगला चला जाएगा
says: Taking sign number 3 (Gemini) at 15 degrees as the example, he says that however you set it up, the influence of the lagna spills over from one sign to the next, so the next sign comes in.
cells_derived_method: If a house spans 30 degrees measured around the lagna degree, a lagna at 20 degrees of Gemini makes the 1st house run from 5 degrees Gemini to 5 degrees Cancer, so both Gemini and Cancer touch the 1st; the same overlap applies to every other house.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: first house with lagna at 20 degrees Gemini, the larger part of the house lies in Gemini and carries Mercury's influence.
Derived: the remaining 5 degrees of the same first house fall in Cancer and add the Moon's influence.
Derived: seventh house opposite that lagna begins in Sagittarius and carries Jupiter, with a smaller share in Capricorn.

ambiguity: The caption for this sentence is very rough; whether the 15 degrees is the lagna degree or a sign midpoint is not clear. The multi-sign reading is supported by the next sentences.
classical_check: Equal-house or bhava madhya division (lagna degree in the middle of the house) is classical; agrees in effect.

hindi: एक ग्रह कभी भी एक राशि एक लग्न हो ही नहीं सकता दो ही चलेंगे ऑलवेज
says: A planet or a lagna can never be one sign alone; two signs always work together at a time, and you must take both.
cells_derived_method: Every house or lagna has a major sign and an adjacent minor sign; judge a rule in both signs, not one. A lagna at the end of Taurus also carries Gemini; a house at the start of Leo also carries Cancer.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna late in Taurus: the first house reads as Taurus plus Gemini, so Venus and Mercury both matter.
Derived: tenth house starting in Leo with part in Cancer: career reads through the Sun mainly and the Moon secondarily.
Derived: fourth house in Scorpio with part in Libra: home life reads as Mars and Venus together.

ambiguity: 'एक ग्रह ... एक राशि एक लग्न' is garbled; it may mean a planet cannot sit in one sign only, or a lagna cannot be one sign only. It is also unclear whether 'दो' means exactly two or at least two.
classical_check: Parashari equal and bhava-chalit division makes a house spill into two signs; consistent. The 'always two' absolute is his own strong claim.

hindi: जिन लोगों का ये होता है कस्प होता है कि 12:42 पर पैदा हुए 12:43 पर कुंडली बदल गई पंडित जी कहते हैं कोई 12:43 है कोई कहता है 12:42
says: For people born at a cusp, the chart changes within a minute (12:42 versus 12:43) and different pandits argue which time and chart is right.
ambiguity: '12:42' and '12:43' are an example, not a rule; the time reading is from the caption '1242' and '1243'.
classical_check: Birth-time sensitivity at a lagna change is accepted classically; arguing between minutes is common.

hindi: हम कहते हैं स्यापा खत्म दोनों है पैदा होने में बच्चे को 5 मिनट लग गए उतनी देर में लगन भी बदल गया कौन सा करोगे
says: His answer: stop the fuss, both charts are valid, because birth took the child five minutes and the lagna changed in that time; so there is no need to choose just one.
cells_derived_method: If birth spans a lagna change, both lagnas apply. For example a lagna change between Taurus and Gemini means the first house reads as both Taurus and Gemini.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: child born as the lagna changes from Taurus to Gemini, one chart has Taurus on the 1st, so Venus rules the self.
Derived: the second chart has Gemini on the 1st, and Mercury becomes lagna lord.

ambiguity: 'कौन सा करोगे' is rhetorical; the answer is both.
classical_check: Classical practice picks one lagna; his use of both is his own method, in line with his multi-sign view.

hindi: फिर वो चेक करना पड़ता उसके जीवन के अनुसार कौन सी घटना से कौन सी कुंडली मैच कर रही है कुछ घटना इससे मैच कर जाती कुछ इससे दोनों ही लेनी पड़ती है
says: Then check against the person's life events which chart matches which event; some events match one chart and some the other, so both charts have to be used.
ambiguity: Which events and how many matches are needed is not said.
classical_check: Event-based rectification is classical practice; using both charts together instead of picking one is his own approach.

hindi: हमने तो शुरू से दो तीन कुंडली ली है एक ली नहीं कभी
says: From the beginning he has always taken two or three charts for a person and never just one.
ambiguity: None.
classical_check: Differs from classical single-chart practice.

gist: Audience: 'like in this, you took the 2nd and 4th'.

hindi: तीन कुंडलियां लेनी पड़ती अगर फोर नंबर की कुंडली है तो 3 फ हो सकती है फाइव नंबर है तो फर फ आगे पीछे की एक एक हो सकती है
says: Sometimes three charts are needed: the one before and the one after the main lagna. If the lagna is sign number 4, the charts of sign 3 and 4 and 5 can apply; if it is number 5, then 4, 5 and 6.
cells_derived_method: A planet keeps its sign but changes house when the lagna shifts, so each neighbouring lagna gives a different house for the same planet.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: a planet in Cancer, in the Gemini-lagna chart (sign 3) it is in the 2nd house, wealth and speech.
Derived: the same planet in the Cancer-lagna chart (sign 4) is in the 1st house, self and body.
Derived: and in the Leo-lagna chart (sign 5) it is in the 12th house, loss and foreign lands.

ambiguity: The caption mixes digits ('फर', 'फ') but the pattern is neighbours of the main lagna sign; cells list lagna 4 (Cancer) and 5 (Leo) as the signs on the 1st.
classical_check: Silent; this three-chart method is his own.

hindi: अच्छा पर दो और तीन ही होंगी एक तो हो ही नहीं सकती उसके बाद ये खिचड़ी अलग है
says: Only two or three charts will be active, never just one, and after that comes a further khichdi of its own to sort out.
ambiguity: The 'khichdi' that follows is explained next (planets jumping signs).
classical_check: Differs from classical single-chart rule.

hindi: कौन सा ग्रह कहां जंप कर गया तो वो हम कितने डिग्री के हिसाब से देखते हैं कि ये तो कंप्यूटर बता देगा आपको सब सॉफ्टवेयर में
says: When the lagna shifts, some planet near a sign boundary may jump to another sign in the second chart; this is judged by degrees, and the software tells it all, so he need not explain it.
cells_derived_method: A planet at the last or first degrees of a sign flips sign when the time or ayanamsa shifts a little, which changes its house in the alternate chart.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: a planet at 29 degrees of Virgo on the 6th (Aries lagna) would move into Libra, the 7th, in a slightly later chart.
Derived: a planet at 0 degrees of Aquarius on the 11th (Aries lagna) would sit in Capricorn, the 10th, in the earlier chart.

ambiguity: 'जंप कर गया' is read as a planet changing sign between the two charts; cause is not stated.
classical_check: Planets changing sign at boundaries is a known sensitivity; his use of two charts is not classical.

gist: Says he himself does not know how to compute this by hand, looks at what the software gives, and even checks nakshatras from a book; why bother with what one cannot do.
Recites Ashwini, Bharani, Krittika as an aside while talking about nakshatras.
Host reads the next question: you had said that the teacher's intelligence gets corrupted.

hindi: राइट उपाय टीचर शिक्षक नहीं बुद्धि नहीं होती हम कर देते हैं
says: Confirming the earlier claim: the remedy works on the teacher or examiner, who loses the (critical) intelligence when marking, and 'we do it'; this is his claim about a remedy influencing an examiner.
ambiguity: The sentence is garbled ('टीचर शिक्षक नहीं बुद्धि नहीं होती'); I read it as the examiner's strict judgement being dulled.
classical_check: Silent; influencing an examiner by remedy has no classical support, and it is ethically doubtful.

gist: Audience: but sometimes the computer checks the papers, an OMR sheet; what then.

hindi: यह परा शक्तिया है बड़ी विचित्र शक्तिया हैं
says: These are para-shaktis (higher, subtle powers), very strange powers; so the remedy can work even when a computer marks the sheet.
ambiguity: He does not say how; the word 'para-shakti' is his explanation.
classical_check: Silent.

gist: Anecdote about a free gift (a machine) that broke for free at first and then was fixed; says machines also change nature, life is strange.
Mentions an Osho story about Edgar Cayce, that whatever he believed became true; a long story for another place.

hindi: आपने सिखाया था इलेक्ट्रॉनिक से प्रेम करो उसको रिगार्ड दो उसको नमस्कार करो आपको रेसिप्रोकेट करेगा
says: Treat electronic devices with love and regard, greet them respectfully, and they will reciprocate by working well for you.
ambiguity: Said by the questioner as a recap of his teaching; he does not object.
classical_check: Silent; this is his own consciousness-in-matter view.

gist: Anecdote: he told the old TV the same, the TV answered like a big father, 'I'll arrange it', and it started working, pleasure.
Host reads the next question: what is the secret of getting all-India rank one in a competitive or government exam.

hindi: कोई सीक्रेट नहीं है इसके पीछे चाहो मत हां बताओ खुद को नहीं पता कैसे आया इसे खुद नहीं पता कैसे आया था
says: There is no secret behind topping an exam; ask the toppers themselves and they do not know how it came to them.
ambiguity: 'चाहो मत हां बताओ' is garbled; I read it as 'do not ask for a secret, ask them'.
classical_check: Silent; this is a general grace-over-effort claim.

gist: Jokes that we run on such people, otherwise where would these free-of-cost visitors come from here.

hindi: ऐसे ही आ जाते हैं नंबर आ जाते हैं ये एग्जांपल है ना पढ़े ना लिखे पता नहीं ज्यादा बोल दिया मजे मजे चले गए हो गया काम हो गया ऐसे ही होता है
says: Some students get top marks without studying or writing much; they just went cheerfully and the work was done, and that is how it happens.
ambiguity: The first words ('काड ओए') are garbled; the rest is clear. 'ज्यादा बोल दिया' is an aside that he may have exaggerated.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: ये सब ग्रहों का खेल है सब करेक्शन है सही तरीके का कार्यक्रम
says: All of it is a game of the planets and everything can be corrected; what is needed is a programme done in the right way.
ambiguity: 'सही तरीके का कार्यक्रम' is not described in this slice.
classical_check: Planetary causation plus remedies is the standard astrological view; agrees.

hindi: कैसे परमात्मा कृपा करे यह संसार भरा पड़ा है ऐसे लोगों से जो चौथी फेल है शायद मेहनत भी नहीं आती शायद इस लायक भी नहीं लेकिन परमात्मा ने चुन लिया तो उस लायक हो गए
says: When God's grace falls, the world is full of people who failed in 4th class, may not even work hard or look fit, yet God chose them and they became fit and successful.
ambiguity: The start 'कैसे परमात्मा कृपा करे' is a question-like phrase and is read as 'see how grace works'.
classical_check: Silent; links to his earlier kripa theme.

hindi: जकरबर्ग जैसा बंदा तो शायद बीए के बाद ही नहीं पढ़ा वन टाइम दुनिया का रिचेस्ट आदमी क्यों बन गया यानी कि पढ़ाई लिखाई के ऊपर की चेतना है जो सब करती है
says: Someone like Zuckerberg barely studied beyond a degree and was once among the richest men; so there is a consciousness above education that does everything.
ambiguity: The facts are loose (he left college, and 'richest in the world' is an exaggeration); the point is only the principle that chetna works above study.
classical_check: Silent.

gist: Gives Elon Musk and Trump as examples of people who have gone far through drive.
Garbled lines about not knowing the future, the present, and 'this is our shop'; the meaning is not recoverable.

hindi: हमारी चेतना प्रजेंट में क्या विचार रहे बस वो लेके हर पल पल आपकी चेतना
says: What matters is which thought your consciousness holds in the present, taken moment by moment.
ambiguity: The sentence is clipped and the second half ('आपकी चेतनानंद') is garbled; read as the present-moment thought.
classical_check: Silent; this is his manifestation teaching, previewed for a later class.

hindi: मैराथन रनर जो होता है उसका एक गुरु होता है वह गुरु ही दौड़ने लायक बनाता है उसको आप दूसरे की चेतना से कनेक्ट करेंगे तभी होगा अपनी चेतना के बस की होती तो हो ही जाता
says: The one formula is connection: a marathon runner has a guru who makes him fit to run; success comes only when you connect to another's consciousness, since if it were within your own it would already have happened.
ambiguity: 'एक ही सूत्र है' just before this is read as announcing this formula.
classical_check: Guru as a channel of grace is traditional; agrees.

hindi: बस वो कनेक्शन एक्टिवेट करनी है बस वही है
says: All that has to be done is to activate that connection with the guru's consciousness; nothing else is needed.
ambiguity: How the connection is activated is not described here.
classical_check: Silent.

gist: Says he is very fond of touching feet but gets troubled by it because ego arises; asks what he has done, and says he has been trained since childhood.
Banter about going to Bangkok; says everything, Bangkok and New York, is right here for him.
Host begins another question with 'sir, if' (continues in the next chunk).
Question: in a job needing constant learning one gets into a flow state, and a call, a bell or a ping breaks it; why does it happen and what should one do.

hindi: ऐसे में हमारे को कुछ करने की लड़ाई नहीं है हमारे को जैसे हैं वैसे ही रहो दशाएं बदलती रहती है किसी समय हो सकता है आपका फेलियर होना उसे होने दो
says: There is nothing to fight against; stay as you are, because dashas keep changing and at some time failure may come to you; let it happen.
ambiguity: He does not say which dasha causes failure; it is a general acceptance statement.
classical_check: Dasha periods bringing ups and downs is classical; his advice to simply allow failure is his own.

hindi: जिन चौथे और पांचवें घर की बात हो रही है वहीं से आपके मित्र हैं वहीं माता है वहीं आपका प्रॉपर्टी है असट है जायदाद है आपकी कमर है आपकी किडनी है आपका लिवर है आपके बॉडी के ऑर्गन्स है आपका घुटना है
says: The 4th and 5th houses carry friends, the mother, property and assets, and also body parts such as the waist, kidney, liver, other organs and the knee (a list of house significations, not a medical statement).
cells_derived_method: The topics are read through the sign on the house and its lord: Moon-ruled 4th stresses mother and comforts, Saturn-ruled 4th stresses slow property and knees, Sun-ruled 5th stresses liver and heart-level strength, and Jupiter-ruled 5th stresses liver and growth.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Cancer on the 4th (Aries lagna), Moon rules mother, home and property, so these topics are emotional and tied to nurturing.
Derived: Capricorn on the 4th (Libra lagna), Saturn rules property and mother, so results are slow and rigid, and knees are a Saturn topic.
Derived: Leo on the 5th (Aries lagna), Sun rules children and intelligence, with the heart and liver region as body links.
Derived: Pisces on the 5th (Scorpio lagna), Jupiter rules children, intelligence and liver, softening Mars's lagna.

ambiguity: 'जिन चौथे और पांचवें घर की बात हो रही है' ties to an earlier thread I do not have; the list mixes many topics under the two houses.
classical_check: Partly agrees: the 4th is mother and property, the 5th liver and intelligence; friends (11th), kidney and waist (7th) and knees (10th) differ from classical assignments.

hindi: एक चीज जाएगी तो कहीं और प्रोटेक्शन होएगी होएगी कोई टेंशन नहीं है
says: If one thing is lost, protection happens somewhere else in life, so there is no need for tension.
ambiguity: He is speaking of the topics of the 4th and 5th houses just listed.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: फेलियर इज गुड ग्रह बली ले रहा है अपने आप ले लेने दो इट्स गुड बहुत अच्छा है फेलियर होना
says: Failure is good: the planet is taking its sacrifice (bali) in the form of a failure, so let it take it by itself, since failing is very good for you.
ambiguity: No particular planet is named here; the next sentence names Saturn.
classical_check: Silent; a small loss taking the place of a larger one is a folk-astrology idea.

hindi: ये सारी शनि की क्लास में अगले हफ्ते होगा फेलियर लेना कि शनि ऑटो करेक्शन कैसे करके देता है
says: How Saturn gives automatic correction through failure will be covered in next week's Saturn class.
ambiguity: The first words are probably the host speaking; the statement itself is still his topic announcement.
classical_check: Saturn as corrector through hardship is classical in spirit.

gist: 'This is the Munna, right' and 'yes sir'; light banter before the next question.
Question: a child's exam is at 2 pm and sign number 7 is in the 5th house; how can the child stay without salt until 2; also Mars is number 4 (second condition).

hindi: क्यों रहे बिना नमक के उसमें नींबू साथ डाल के नमक को भी चेंज कर लो नींबू नमक साथ ले लो चीनी साथ ले लो अकेला सॉल्ट नहीं लेना
says: Why stay without salt: instead change the salt by combining it, take it with lemon or with sugar, and never take plain salt alone.
cells_derived_method: This is for sign 7 (Libra) on the 5th; for other signs on the 5th the item to avoid would follow that sign's lord, and the same trick of pairing the item with a partner food would apply.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: with Scorpio on the 5th (Cancer lagna) the avoided food would follow Mars rather than Venus, and the same pairing method would be used.
Derived: with Capricorn on the 5th (Virgo lagna) the avoided item would follow Saturn, mixed with a partner item instead of dropped.

ambiguity: Libra on the 5th comes from the audience question, not from his own sentence; the link between Libra and salt is from an earlier class I do not have, and I marked Venus only because Libra is a Venus sign. Lagna for Libra on the 5th is Gemini.
classical_check: Silent; food-based planetary remedies are folk or Lal Kitab style.

hindi: अच्छा कॉमिनेशन आपने दही लेनी है दही ले लो दही में कलर चेंज करो कलर दही आती है दूध पीना हल्दी डाल के पी लो कॉमिनेशन से
says: Use combinations: if you want curd, change its colour by adding something to it, and if you drink milk, add turmeric to it, so the pairing changes the item's nature.
ambiguity: What colour to add to curd is garbled; turmeric in milk is clear.
classical_check: Silent; food-pairing remedy is his own.

hindi: चाय कॉफी भी पीनी है तो दूध डाल दो उसमें अगर आपका राहु का दोष आ रहा है और चौथे पांचवे में दिक्कत है और चाय पीने की तलब है बच्चे को सिर दर्द है तो दूध वाली पी लो ब्लैक नहीं पीनी
says: If you have a Rahu fault and trouble in the 4th and 5th houses and still need tea or coffee, take it with milk and never black; this is a remedy tied to Rahu and those two houses, not a headache treatment.
cells_derived_method: The milk rule applies when Rahu afflicts the 4th or 5th house, whatever the sign; the sign only decides how strong the fault is.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Rahu in Gemini on the 4th (Pisces lagna), Rahu is strong in this sign so tea and coffee should always be taken with milk.
Derived: Rahu in Taurus on the 5th (Capricorn lagna), exalted by some views, so black coffee still to be avoided under his rule.

ambiguity: 'बच्चे को सिर दर्द है' is mentioned as part of the situation; he gives no medical claim.
classical_check: Silent; tea or coffee with milk as a Rahu remedy is his own folk remedy.

hindi: यह परिवर्तन करो तासीर बदल जाती है
says: Make this change of combination, because mixing changes the nature (taseer) of the item and so changes its effect.
ambiguity: 'तासीर' is the Ayurvedic and folk term for warming or cooling nature.
classical_check: Silent; Ayurveda uses taseer, the planetary reading is his.

gist: 'Last two questions, sir'; asks whether placing ancestors' photos in the SW is a universal remedy or depends on the kundali.
Continuation of the question: some people have pitru dosha, so will placing the photo give a negative effect.

hindi: डब्ल्यू व पित्रों का स्थान है
says: The south-west (the caption writes 'डब्ल्यू व') is the place of the ancestors in the house.
ambiguity: 'डब्ल्यू व' is read as SW; later he mentions south-south-west for the toilet and ancestors' own area, supporting this reading.
classical_check: Agrees: the Pitra deity sits in the south-west part of the Vastu grid.

gist: Memory aid in English words, 'bachelor, maid, police, DSP, very angry'; says when we reach police DSP, the P is our ancestors' place.
Calls it a very powerful question and says the ancestors have an established place, this is their place.

hindi: फिर आप उसे वेस्ट में भी लगा सकते हैं नॉर्थ में पितर बहुत काम करते हैं आपके लिए वेस्ट में भी करते हैं
says: You can also put the ancestors' photo in the west; ancestors work a lot for you from the north, and also from the west.
ambiguity: 'वेस्ट' and 'नॉर्थ' are the compass sides of the house, not houses of the chart.
classical_check: Differs from the common Vastu rule which keeps ancestors in the south or south-west and avoids the north; he allows north and west.

hindi: टॉयलेट जो है साउथ साउथ वेस्ट में जैसे होना चाहिए लेकिन नहीं है तो और जगह भी बनता ही है उपाय हो जाते हैं पर अपना स्थान है उसका जैसे किचन साउथ ईस्ट में होनी चाहिए
says: A toilet is ideally in the south-south-west and a kitchen in the south-east; if they are not there, they can be made elsewhere and remedies fix the problem, but each has its own proper place.
ambiguity: None; the zones are said clearly.
classical_check: Kitchen in the south-east is classical Vastu; a toilet in the south-south-west is accepted by many but not by all.

hindi: नहीं है तो कोई कसम थोड़ी है और जगह भी बनती है ऐसे पित्रों का स्थान है
says: If an ideal zone is not available it is not a vow, other places also work; ancestors' place follows the same logic: SW is their place but other spots can serve too.
ambiguity: None.
classical_check: Flexible-zone attitude is his own; strict Vastu is stricter.

hindi: मान लेते हैं आपके घर में आपको चेस्ट की प्रॉब्लम हो गई है भावना लानी पड़ेगी फीलिंग लानी पड़ेगी अपने ऐसे किसी पित्र की फोटो ढूंढो जिसको हार्ट की प्रॉब्लम कभी हुई नहीं हार्ट अटैक ही नहीं हुआ
says: Say someone has a chest problem; one must bring feeling and faith, and find the photo of an ancestor who never had a heart problem or heart attack (this is his remedy claim and not medical advice or a substitute for a doctor).
ambiguity: Health is mentioned only as an example for the photo remedy; no diagnosis is made.
classical_check: Silent; this is his own ancestor-photo remedy.

hindi: पूर्ण श्रद्धा से गोल्डन फ्रेम में उसकी फोटोग्राफ डब्ल्यू व में लगा दो और मानसिक प्रणाम करते रहो हमेशा आपकी हार्ट हमेशा सुरक्षित रहेगी
says: Put that ancestor's photograph with full faith in a golden frame in the south-west and keep bowing mentally; he claims the heart will remain safe always (a tradition claim, not medical advice).
ambiguity: 'हमेशा सुरक्षित' is absolute; flagged as his claim.
classical_check: Silent; ancestor-photo remedy is modern Vastu practice.

hindi: और अगर उसी इंसान को पित ऐसे ही पढ़ा लिखा कोई बहुत ज्ञानी विद्वान है उस पित्र की फोटो डब्ल्यू व में लगा दो और उसे मानसिक प्रणाम करो पेपरों से ठीक पहले आपके अंदर पढ़ाई का जज्बा अपने आप बन जाएगा
says: If the same person has an ancestor who was well-read and a scholar, put that ancestor's photo in the SW and bow mentally before exams, and the urge to study will arise by itself.
ambiguity: None.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: ऐसा कोई पितर है आपका जिसके बच्चे हुए हैं आपके नहीं है ऐसे पितरों का जोड़े का फोटोग्राफ डब्ल्यू व में लगा दो उनको मानसिक
says: If you have no children but have an ancestor who did have children, put a photograph of that ancestor couple in the SW and bow mentally; this is a remedy claim for childlessness.
ambiguity: The sentence is garbled ('आपके नहीं है') and the sentence is cut off at the end; childlessness reading is inferred.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: ये सब फीलिंग का खेल है तो पितर लायक हो तो क्या करें पितर नालायक हो तो उनको नमस्ते कर दो
says: It is all a game of feeling; if the ancestors are worthy use them as above, and if they are unworthy just say namaste to them and move on.
ambiguity: 'तो क्या करें' is an aside to the audience.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: नहीं नहीं मेरे से किसी ने पूछा कि दारू पीते हैं वो जो राष्ट्रपति बने मैं बता रहा हूं अब्दुल कलाम थे उनकी लगा दो बहुत सुंदर चलेगा चलेगा
says: When someone's ancestors are unfit (he mentions the drinking case), he says put the photograph of a worthy person such as President Abdul Kalam in the SW, and it will work.
ambiguity: The caption says 'नालायक अब्दुल कलाम'; I read it as 'लायक' (worthy), since he recommends putting his photo.
classical_check: Silent; a substitute for an actual ancestor is his own idea.

hindi: मेरे से किसी ने पूछा कि जी ड्रिंक करते हैं छूटती है नहीं क्या करें मैंने कहा कुछ नहीं कोई दारू बारू पीता था खानदान के अंदर पितर तो बोले
says: Someone asked what to do about a drinking habit that does not leave; he said do nothing special, because some ancestor in the family used to drink, and the ancestors would speak on it (the sentence is cut off). This records his claim that a stubborn habit can trace to an ancestor.
ambiguity: The sentence is cut at the chunk end; what the ancestors say is not captured.
classical_check: Silent; hereditary habit tied to pitr is a folk claim.

gist: Continues the drinker story: the man said the ancestors were like that, and he replied they never failed in anything, do not curse them from now on, they are ancestors and they will strike you.

hindi: मैंने कहा श्रद्धा लाओ उनकी फोटो लगा के रखो
says: Remedy told to the man: do not abuse the ancestors, bring faith to them and keep their photographs.
ambiguity: The sentence is short; the photos are meant for the ancestors' place discussed earlier.
classical_check: Reverence for pitr is classical; the photo practice is modern.

hindi: तुम्हारा लिवर साइट है छूटता नहीं क्यों कुंडली में दोष हैं वो दारू पिलवा जाएंगे ऐसे योग हैं
says: A habit like heavy drinking does not leave because of doshas in the kundali: such yogas make a person drink. He mentions the man's liver trouble only as background and gives no medical judgement.
ambiguity: 'लिवर साइट है' is garbled (liver affected); which yoga or planet is not stated.
classical_check: Classical texts link addictions to afflicted Moon, Venus, Rahu and Neptune-type influences; he names none here.

hindi: माता-पिता में बड़ा प्रेम है बच्चे पैदा होने के बाद उनके भी शत्रुता हो गई यह बच्चे की कुंडली में योग होता है यह बहुत टेक्निकल है
says: Parents who loved each other can turn hostile after a child is born, and the cause is a yoga in the child's own kundali, which he calls very technical.
ambiguity: He does not say which yoga; he goes on to moola births next.
classical_check: Classical texts do say a child's birth stars (gand-mool) can affect the parents; consistent.

hindi: ऐसे ऐसे मूलों के अंदर बच्चे पैदा हो जाते हैं के मामो का सत्यानाश हो जाता है माता-पिता अलग हो जाते हैं तलाक हो जाता है बाप मर जाता है मां मर जाती है बड़े भयंकर होते हैं
says: Children born in certain moola (gand-mool) nakshatras bring ruin to maternal uncles, separation or divorce of the parents, and even the death of a parent; he calls these births very fearsome. This is a general tradition warning, with no specific person or date.
ambiguity: 'मूलों' means the moola group of nakshatras; he does not name which ones.
classical_check: Agrees with the classical gand-mool effects on parents and maternal uncle (Moola, Jyeshtha, Ashlesha and others); the strength of his wording is extreme.

hindi: इसलिए साउथ वेस्ट एक बहुत ज्यादा पावरफुल एरिया है उसके अंदर आप ऐसे पितरों की कृपा लेकर चलेंगे तो आपके मानसिक शारीरिक कई किस्म की कृपा देक चलेंगे
says: So the south-west is a very powerful area: if you carry the grace of such ancestors from there, you receive many kinds of help, mental and physical.
ambiguity: The caption writes 'डब्लू व'; I read it as south-west as in the previous slice.
classical_check: South-west as the ancestors' zone is classical Vastu; agrees.

hindi: पर अगर दोष है पितृ दोष तो वो करेक्ट होगा पितृ दोष भी करेक्शन होगी वो वही से पित्रों की कृपा लेनी है
says: If there is pitru dosha, it too gets corrected from the same place: take the ancestors' grace from the south-west.
ambiguity: This answers the audience worry that photos might hurt someone with pitru dosha.
classical_check: Silent; classical pitru dosha remedies are shraddha and tarpan, not photographs.

hindi: आपका इसलिए डब् बंद होना चाहिए पित्रों के पास द्वार डब् का दरवाजा नहीं होना चाहिए
says: The south-west should therefore be kept closed; the ancestors' area should not have a door or gate in it.
ambiguity: 'डब्' is a clipped 'डब्ल्यू व', read as south-west.
classical_check: Agrees with the classical caution against a south-west entrance.

hindi: पति पत्नी खत्म पित बन जाएंगे मार ही देता है यज में जान से भी मार देता है
says: A door in the south-west ruins the couple: husband and wife may end up as ancestors, it can even kill. This is a severe tradition claim and not a prediction for any person.
ambiguity: 'यज में' is garbled; the threat of loss of life is stated plainly.
classical_check: Classical Vastu calls a south-west entrance very harmful to the householder, but not usually in this lethal wording.

hindi: इसलिए साउथ वेस्ट एंट्री नहीं होनी चाहिए घर के अंदर टॉयलेट नहीं होना चाहिए
says: So there should be no south-west entry, and no toilet inside the house in that zone.
ambiguity: Earlier in this class he said a toilet is ideally in the south-south-west; here he says no toilet in the south-west, so the two statements differ.
classical_check: Classical Vastu forbids a toilet in the south-west; it conflicts with his earlier south-south-west placement.

gist: Question: you said bow mentally to ancestors; if an ancestor had good knowledge in some subject but also some illness, will that illness come along too.

hindi: वो तो पित्र इवोक कर रहे हो अपने अंदर पूरी आएगी पैकेज मिलेगा थोड़ी सिलेक्शन में मिलेगा पूरी प्लेट आएगी
says: When you evoke an ancestor within you, the whole package arrives, not a selection; his qualities and his weaknesses come together, the full plate.
ambiguity: Whether the illness actually transfers is not explained; it is his answer to the audience worry.
classical_check: Silent.

gist: Says there is one more question but they will not take it up today and will do it another time.
Question about in which direction the ancestors' photo should face, north or east, so that it looks to north and east (the caption has garbled words around 'filter').
Asks which ancestors to include, for example a mother who has only just passed away.

hindi: इमीडिएट डिसीज जो है उनकी फोटोग्राफ भी पित स्थान में लगा दो गुजर चुके हैं वो
says: Photographs of immediate deceased relatives, such as a parent who has just passed, also go in the ancestors' place, since they have crossed over.
ambiguity: None.
classical_check: Silent; keeping a deceased parent's photo in the pitr zone is common practice.

hindi: वेस्ट की तरफ पीठ और ईस्ट की तरफ पीठ का कोई लिंक नहीं है उनका स्थान डव में है चाहे आप कहीं भी लगा दो
says: Which way the photo's back faces, west or east, has no link; the ancestors' place is the south-west and it works wherever in that zone you place it.
ambiguity: 'डव' is read as south-west.
classical_check: Classical Vastu usually cares about the direction the photo faces; he says it does not matter.

hindi: अगर समझ नहीं आ रहा कहीं भी घूम फिर फेस कहां है भूल जाओ वो स्थान है
says: If this facing business confuses you, forget which way the face points; what matters is that it stands in that place.
ambiguity: Caption is partly garbled in the middle.
classical_check: Differs from strict Vastu direction rules.

hindi: ये हमारे लिए फोटो लगी है कि हम देख के हमारा जो चित्रगुप्त है सबकॉन्शियस वो याद करे
says: The photo is put up for our own sake: when we see it, our Chitragupta, the subconscious, remembers the ancestors.
ambiguity: He equates Chitragupta with the subconscious mind, which is his own usage.
classical_check: Chitragupta is the keeper of deeds in Puranic belief; calling it the subconscious is his reading.

hindi: पितरों को थोड़ी लेन देन है फोटो थोड़ी है की
says: The ancestors themselves have no dealing with the photograph; it is not for their benefit but a prompt for the living.
ambiguity: The caption ends abruptly ('फोटो थोड़ी है की'); I use the sense from the previous sentence.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: ये गलत है सीढ़ियों के अंदर बन नहीं सकते
says: It is wrong to make the ancestors' place under the staircase; it cannot be built there.
ambiguity: The words before it ('ल में अप ाल') are garbled, so I cannot be sure he is speaking of the ancestors' place and not of a general placement.
classical_check: Classical Vastu discourages worship items under stairs; agrees.

gist: Garbled phrase about putting and searching ('ए में डालो ए ढूंढो'); the meaning is not recoverable.
Audience asks if this means we need not remember God's name at all.

hindi: ईश्वर लेना देना नहीं पित्रों का पित्र की एप्लीकेशन अलग है ईश्वर की अलग है
says: God has no give-and-take with us, and the use of ancestor remedies is different from the use of God: the ancestors' application and God's are separate things.
ambiguity: 'लेना देना नहीं' could mean God has no dealing, or that God is not a business partner; I read it the second way, but the first clause is not clear.
classical_check: Silent; separating pitr kriya from devata upasana is traditional.

hindi: हम य तीसरी बात कर रहे कि ना पूजा करो ना पाठ करो ना पढ़ाई करो भगवान थोड़ी पास करेगा आपको सही देवता को पकड़ा नहीं तो फेल हो जाओगे
says: A third point: if you do no puja, no path and no study, God will not pass you; and if you have not held the right deity you will fail.
ambiguity: The sentence can also be read as a rhetorical question; I take it as a statement that the right deity plus effort is needed.
classical_check: Silent; the idea of an ishta devata matched to the chart is traditional.

gist: Garbled lines about the 'best calculation', God being very complicated and 'the guru is finished'; the meaning is not recoverable.

hindi: कितना बढ़िया किया बृहस्पति होता है ग्रंथ धर्म ग्रंथ बृहस्पति
says: Jupiter stands for scripture; the dharma granth (religious book) is Jupiter's department.
cells_derived_method: Jupiter's house and sign show which kind of scripture or teaching gets the weight: Jupiter in the 9th gives formal scripture and temples, in the 3rd gives books written or published by oneself.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Jupiter in its own sign Sagittarius on the 9th (Aries lagna): strong link to scripture, dharma and a guru.
Derived: Jupiter in Aquarius on the 3rd (Sagittarius lagna): scripture appears through writing, study groups and media.

ambiguity: None; 'कितना बढ़िया किया' is a filler.
classical_check: Jupiter as karaka of dharma, scriptures and the guru is classical; agrees.

hindi: गीता हमारा धर्म ग्रंथ है कुरान धर्म ग्रंथ है बृहस्पति आपको जो सूट करता है कुंडली अनुसार वो करो
says: The Gita is our scripture and the Quran is also a scripture; follow whichever of these Jupiter, by your kundali, shows as suiting you.
ambiguity: How Jupiter's placement picks the scripture is not given.
classical_check: Silent; classical texts recommend the ishta devata, not another religion's book, so this goes beyond the tradition.

gist: Host: yes sir, your last question.
Last question: if things keep getting stuck in life, is there a general remedy that applies to all.

hindi: कोई जनरल रेमेडी नहीं है लाइफ में स्टक हो रहा है क्या हो रहा है क्यों हो रहा कौन जानता है मल्टीपल रीजन होते हैं ये एक कारण हो ही नहीं सकता
