says: There is no general remedy for getting stuck in life; who can know why it is happening, there are multiple reasons and it cannot be a single cause.
ambiguity: None.
classical_check: Classical practice also says remedies must be chosen from the specific chart; agrees.

hindi: यह बहुत कॉम्प्लिकेटेड है कुछ भी ऐसा नहीं कह सकते जैसे बीमार व्यक्ति है उसकी जनरल रेमेडी है तुलादान पर पता नहीं उसके बाद भी अगर पूरा ठीक ना हो तो क्या करें
says: It is too complicated to say anything general; for a sick person the general remedy is tuladan (donating his weight in grain or goods), but even then he does not know what to do if the person is not fully well. He gives no medical claim.
ambiguity: Tuladan is named as a general remedy for illness; whether it cures is left open by him.
classical_check: Tuladan as a daan for illness and ill-health is classical; agrees.

hindi: लेकिन तुलादान के बाद जैसे बहुत भयंकर बीमार आदमी है यह पक्का है कि उसकी रास्ता निकल आएगा बीमारी सामने आ जाएगी क्या है
says: After tuladan, for a very seriously ill person it is certain that a path will open and the actual illness will come into the open; this is a tradition claim, not medical advice.
ambiguity: 'यह पक्का है' is a strong certainty claim that I flag as his.
classical_check: Silent on diagnosis-revealing effects; classical texts only say daan lessens affliction.

hindi: ठीक नहीं होगा तो तुलादान तो वेस्ट है नहीं वेस्ट नहीं हुआ पोटेंसी चाहिए उसने यह बता दिया बीमारी है नहीं तो बीमारियां गुप्त रहती हैं
says: If the person does not recover, the tuladan is still not wasted: it needs potency and it at least revealed that the illness exists, since illnesses otherwise stay hidden.
ambiguity: 'पोटेंसी चाहिए' is unclear (the daan needs potency, or the person needs strength to bear it).
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: ऐसे कहने का मकसद है कि दान करो जो जो कर सकते हो कुंडली बताएगी ये केस स्पेसिफिक खेल है
says: The point is to donate whatever you can, and the kundali will tell which donation fits; it is a case-specific matter.
ambiguity: None.
classical_check: Chart-specific daan is classical; agrees.

hindi: सब मनुष्य हैं सबका भोजन सेम खाने के बाद भी किसी की बॉडी में डी की कमी है किसी का पोटेशियम आउट है किसी का क्लोराइड आउट है अलग अलग हिसाब किताब है
says: Analogy for why remedies are personal: all humans eat the same food, yet one body lacks vitamin D, another is out of potassium, another out of chloride; each body keeps its own account. This is only an analogy, not a medical claim.
ambiguity: The analogy is from the body, used for kundali individuality.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: कैल्शियम अप डाउन हो रखा है सेम खाना खाते फिर भी तो हर एक की बॉडी अलग बिहेव कर रही है अलग अलग पोर्टल से हम काम करते हैं
says: Calcium goes up and down in some and not in others on the same diet, so every body behaves differently; likewise astrologers work through different portals (different entry routes) for different people.
ambiguity: 'अलग अलग पोर्टल' is unexplained; I read it as different routes of approach per person.
classical_check: Silent.

gist: 'Okay sir, and south-west...' a follow-up question on the south-west entry.

hindi: कोई रेमेडी नहीं साउथ वेस्ट घर बेच दो छोड़ दो किराए पर चले जाओ बंद कर दो नया गेट बनाओ मतलब कसम खाके उपाय करो सेटिंग वाला नहीं पूरी बढ़िया फिक्स क्लीन होना चाहिए
says: For a south-west entrance there is no simple remedy: sell the house, leave it, rent it out and move, close that gate or build a new gate, that is, swear to do a complete clean fix and not a half 'setting'.
ambiguity: 'सेटिंग वाला नहीं' means a quick adjustment is not enough.
classical_check: Classical Vastu allows pyramid and other corrective measures for a south-west gate; his advice is stricter and says none works.

hindi: साउथ वेस्ट एंट्री डर्टी एंट्री बहुत गंदी एंट्री है
says: A south-west entry is a 'dirty entry', a very bad entrance.
ambiguity: None.
classical_check: Agrees with classical Vastu on the south-west gate being among the worst entrances.

gist: Question: if the house is turned or rotated in direction, which north-east do we take, the house's or the normal one.

hindi: घर में नॉर्थ धरती का नॉर्थ चलेगा आपका घर जैसे मर्जी बनाओ उससे कोई लेना देना नहीं है जो सर्र्र अर्थ के हिसाब से
says: Use the earth's north, not the house's own alignment: build the house however you like, it does not matter; directions follow the earth.
ambiguity: The end of the sentence is garbled ('जो सररा अर्थ के हिसाब से').
classical_check: Most Vastu practice uses true or magnetic directions of the earth; agrees with the standard view.

gist: Hypothetical: suppose north-east falls in the east direction of the house.

hindi: नहीं आता ना ईस्ट में नॉर्थ ईस्ट कैसे आएगा ईस्ट में ईस्ट ही आएगा धरती का एक ही डायरेक्शन है
says: It does not happen: north-east cannot fall in the east, east is only east; the earth has one fixed set of directions.
ambiguity: None.
classical_check: Consistent with true-direction use.

hindi: ग अर्थ समझोगे समझ जाओ कोने होने से फर्क नहीं है वही आ कोने में आता है कोने में आ जहां मर्जी आ डायरेक्शन एक ही रहता है
says: Understand it from the globe: being in a corner of the plot makes no difference, wherever you stand the direction stays the same.
ambiguity: 'ग अर्थ' is read as 'globe' or 'earth'; the middle words are repetitive.
classical_check: Consistent with using true directions.

hindi: उत्तरी ध्रुव में दक्षिणी ध्रुव में डायरेक्शन सेम रहेगा
says: Even at the north pole or the south pole the directions would stay the same.
ambiguity: Physically the compass directions break down at the poles, so this is a loose argument.
classical_check: Differs from geography at the poles, though irrelevant to normal Vastu.

gist: Question: you once said there is a curtain; if the curtain is removed all knowledge comes directly.

hindi: हां जी पदा होता है केतु का पर्दा होता है जाए तो पूरी नॉलेज वहम का पर्दा होता है
says: Yes, there is a curtain and it belongs to Ketu; if it goes, complete knowledge comes. It is the curtain of vaham (delusion or false belief).
cells_derived_method: Where Ketu sits shows which area of life the curtain of false belief covers; its sign says how it covers.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Ketu in Gemini on the 9th (Libra lagna): the curtain covers belief and dharma, doubt about faith.
Derived: Ketu in Sagittarius on the 5th (Leo lagna): false notions about learning, children and mantra.
Derived: Ketu in Pisces on the 4th (Sagittarius lagna): delusion around home and inner peace, or detachment from them.

ambiguity: 'पदा' is 'पर्दा' (curtain); 'वहम' (delusion) is his word for what the curtain is made of.
classical_check: Ketu as karaka of moksha and also of illusion and confusion is traditional; agrees.

hindi: जिस लड़की के जीवन के अंदर यह शुरुआत से कमांड होती है के बहुत गंदी बात है बुरी नजर होती है लड़कों की खराबी होती है उसकी वही वाइब्रेशन चलती है वो उसी को अट्रैक्ट करती है और सप्तम भाव डिस्ट्रॉय कर लेती है
says: A girl who is told from the start that it is a very dirty thing, that boys have bad eyes and are bad, runs that same vibration and attracts exactly that, and so destroys her own 7th house (partnership).
cells_derived_method: The damage to the 7th shows through the sign on the 7th: the planet that rules it is the one whose partner-matters get distorted by the learned fear.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Aries on the 7th (Libra lagna), Mars rules the partner, so the fear brings conflict and aggressive partners.
Derived: Capricorn on the 7th (Cancer lagna), Saturn rules the partner, so delay and coldness in marriage follow the learned distrust.
Derived: Pisces on the 7th (Virgo lagna), Jupiter rules the partner, so confusion and idealised or evasive partners.

ambiguity: 'कमांड' is used as conditioning or programming. No planet is named by him.
classical_check: Silent; this is a psychological reading of the 7th house, not a classical rule.

hindi: जिस बच्चे को कहते हैं पढ़ेगा लिखेगा नहीं तो बर्बाद हो जाएगा किसी लायक नहीं है बेटा पढ़ना जरूरी है अगर उसने ये आत्मसात कर लिया और कुंडली ने साथ नहीं दिया तो उसकी बैंड बज जाती है
says: A child who is repeatedly told he will be ruined unless he studies and is fit for nothing may absorb this, and if the kundali does not support him as well, he collapses.
ambiguity: No house or planet is named; he links conditioning with chart strength only in general.
classical_check: Silent.

gist: Asks what hypnosis lies over us and what curtain of sanskar (conditioning) has been drawn; that is what spoils our mind.
Says it is fanaticism that causes today's fighting and the big wars of religious strife (sentence cut at the end).
Continuing the religious strife talk: mentions the film Chhava and says Aurangzeb had one obsession, that non-Muslims are to be killed whoever they are.
Story that the victim, in reply to the threat to kill him, took a curse that the Mughal empire would end, and it did end.

hindi: उसका भी कॉस्मस सबकी सुन रहा है उसे कोई लेन देन नहीं है अल्लाह को पूज रहा है राम को पूज रहा है यह हिंदू है कि मुसलमान उसे कोई लेनदेन नहीं उसने दोनों की कमांड कह दी
says: The cosmos listens to everyone and has no dealing with the person's religion: whether he worships Allah or Ram, Hindu or Muslim, it answers the command given to it.
ambiguity: This is his manifestation principle, not a planet, house or sign rule; 'कमांड कह दी' means the wish or command he gave.
classical_check: Silent; it sits outside classical Jyotish and belongs to his coming class on wishing.

gist: Story that before leaving, a mother, described as corrupt and harmful, wished that her small child become king; the cosmos was told it would be so and the child did become king.
Repeats that the cosmos is hearing everyone and that being Hindu or Muslim makes no difference to it.
Says the real trouble is that people do not know how to ask, and announces a coming class on 'How to Wish' (some words before it are garbled).
Closing of the class: thanks, namaste and farewell to all who joined.
Music only, end of the class.
Music only, with a stray word 'और'.
Music only.
Music only, ending with stray syllables.
